n-m-h2-explog-07.title: Uma sazi inani le-logarithm eyodwa, singathola yini log₆12?
n-m-h2-explog-07.goal: Hlola ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo ukuthola i-logarithm oyifunayo, bese uthola wena isibalo ngokuya ngenani elilodwa p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.material: U-Eunseo ufuna ukuthola log_6 12 ngaphandle kwekhalkhuleyitha. Uma etshelwa linye nje lamanani angezansi, ufuna ukuhlola ukuthi angayiveza yini log_6 12 ngalelo nani usebenzisa kuphela izakhiwo ze-logarithm nezenzo ezine zezibalo. (log_6 12 yi-logarithm ye-12 ngesisekelo 6.)
n-m-h2-explog-07.thinking.1: Ukunciphisa kube yinani elifanayo ngokushintsha isisekelo
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amanani lapho ukwazi inani elilodwa nje kukuvumela ukuthi uveze u-log_6 12 ngalo usebenzisa kuphela izakhiwo ze-logarithm nezenzo ezine zezibalo.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zama ukushintsha isisekelo se-log_6 12 sibe ngu-2 noma 3, noma ukubhala u-12 no-6 njengeziphumo ze-2 no-3, ubone ukuthi iyiphi i-logarithm eyodwa engayiveza.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngalunye ukuthi ukukhetha ngakunye kuphethe ulwazi olufanayo nalena logarithm eyodwa yini (ingabe lungaguqulwa lube yiyo ngefomula).
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.a: Nge-log_10 2 yodwa, awukwazi ukwazi u-log_10 3, ngakho awukwazi ukuveza kokubili u-12 no-6.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.b: Ushiye ulwazi oluguqulela ku-logarithm eyodwa, njengo-log_2 6=1+log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye ukuthi ukusebenzisa u-log_6 3=1−log_6 2 kukuvumela ukuveza u-log_6 12.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.f: Ushiye ukuthi ukushintsha u-log_6 12 ube nesisekelo 2 kushiya u-log_2 3 kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.explain: log_6 12=log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+log_2 3)/(1+log_2 3), ngakho p=log_2 3 yodwa iyanela. log_2 6=1+p, log_3 2=1/p, ne-log_6 2=1/(1+p) nazo zingaguqulwa zisuswe ku-p. I-log_10 2 ayisebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi wazi i-log_10 3, futhi i-log_5 7 ayinaxhumano ne-2 no-3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.0: Shintsha isisekelo sibe ngu-2 bese ubhala inombolo ephezulu nephansi ngayinye njengamanani e-log_2.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala i-log_2 12 ne-log_2 6 njengemiphumela ye-2 no-3, bese usebenzisa izici ze-logarithm ukuzivezwa ngo-p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Esishweni sakho esinamathele ku-p, ingabe usibeke inombolo ephezulu nephansi ohlangothini olulungile?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ufake p=1.585 bese uhlola ukuthi i-log_6 12≈1.387?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.model.1: Ukushintsha isisekelo sibe ngu-2 kunikeza i-log_2 12 / log_2 6 = (2+p)/(1+p).

n-m-h2-explog-09.title: Ukunquma ukulingana phakathi kwamagrafu emisebenzi ye-exponential ne-logarithmic
n-m-h2-explog-09.goal: Hlola izimangalo zokulingana phakathi kwamagrafu amaningana usebenzisa amafomula ukuze unqume ukuthi iziphi eziyiqiniso nezingelona, bese ukhombisa isizathu sesimangalo esisodwa ngefomula eyodwa.
n-m-h2-explog-09.material: USeungwoo ufingqe ubudlelwano bokulingana phakathi kwamagrafu emisebenzi ye-exponential ne-logarithmic enezisekelo ezi-2 no-1/2. I-logarithm enesisekelo esingu-1/2 ibhalwa log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.1: Ukushintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwamagrafu sibe yizifomula
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izitatimende ezilungile phakathi kwalezo uSeungwoo azifingqile.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kubhangqa ngalinye lamagrafu, khetha iphoyinti elilodwa uthole ama-coordinate alo, bese uhlola ukuthi leliphoyinti kumele lihanjiswe kanjani ukuze lehlele kwenye igrafu.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ubhale ukuthi ukulingana nge-y-axis nokulingana nge-line y=x kushintsha kanjani ama-coordinate eliphoyinti ngalinye.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.a: Njengoba (1/2)^x=2^(−x), kuyigrafu enophawu luka-x oluguquliwe. Uphutha isitatimende esilungile.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.b: Amagrafu e-y=log_2 x ne-y=log_{1/2} x alingana nge-y-axis
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.b: Imisebenzi ye-log ichazwe kuphela ku-x>0, ngakho ayikwazi ukulingana nge-y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.c: Amagrafu e-y=2^x ne-y=log_2 x alingana nge-line y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.c: Imisebenzi ephambene, ngakho alingana nge-y=x. Uphutha isitatimende esilungile.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.d: Amagrafu e-y=2^x ne-y=log_{1/2} x alingana nge-line y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.d: Umsebenzi ophambene we-2^x yi-log_2 x, hhayi i-log_{1/2} x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.explain: Njengoba (1/2)^x=2^(−x), i-y=2^x ne-y=(1/2)^x zilingana nge-y-axis. I-y=2^x ne-y=log_2 x yimisebenzi ephambene, ngakho zilingana nge-y=x. I-log_{1/2} x inesizinda x>0, ngakho ayikwazi ukulingana nge-y-axis, futhi akulona umsebenzi ophambene we-2^x nakanjani.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala i-line amagrafu e-y=log_2 x ne-y=log_{1/2} x alingana ngayo, bese ukhombisa isizathu ngefomula.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala kabusha i-log_{1/2} x njenge-logarithm enesisekelo esingu-2. Qhathanisa amanani ka-y ezifomula ezimbili ku-x ofanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi amanani ka-y ahlobene kanjani, bese usho ukuthi lobo budlelwano buhambisa iphoyinti ngasiphi isiqondiso se-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uthole i-log_{1/2} x=−log_2 x ngokushintsha isisekelo?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Usebenzisa ama-coordinate amaphoyinti, ingabe uthe ku-x ofanayo amanani amabili ka-y ahluka ngophawu kuphela?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uthe ukulingana nge-x-axis kuhambisa kanjani iphoyinti?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.0: log_{1/2} x=log_2 x / log_2(1/2)=−log_2 x. Ku-x ofanayo amanani ka-y ahluka ngophawu kuphela, ngakho amagrafu alingana nge-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.1: Alingana nge-x-axis. Ukushintsha isisekelo kuguqula i-log_{1/2} x ibe ngu-−log_2 x, ngakho iyigrafu lapho iphoyinti (x, y) lihanjiswe liye ku-(x, −y).
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.2: Alingana nge-x-axis. I-y=log_{1/2} x ifana ne-y=−log_2 x, ngakho amanani ka-y emagrafu amabili anezimpawu eziphambene.

n-m-h2-explog-05.title: Ukuchazela umngane ukuthi kungani silahla u-t=−1
n-m-h2-explog-05.goal: Uma uxazulula isibalo se-exponential ngokufaka esikhundleni, sebenzisa ibanga lelẹta elifakiwe ukubeka isizathu sokulahla isixazululo emazwini umngane angawaqonda.
n-m-h2-explog-05.material: Nawa amanothi ka-Jiho axazulula 4^x−3·2^x−4=0. "Vumela 2^x=t. Khona-ke t²−3t−4=0, (t−4)(t+1)=0, ngakho t=4 noma t=−1. t=−1 ayivumelekile, ngakho siyayilahla, futhi kusuka ku-2^x=4, x=2." U-Sora ubone la manothi wabuza, "Kungani ulahla nje u-t=−1? Ngicabanga ukuthi kungase kube khona u-x onge-2^x=−1."
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.1: Ukuguqula umusho wesixazululo oqinile ube ngamazwi alula
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.prompt: Uma uvumela 2^x=t, khetha ibanga elilungile lamanani u-t angawathatha.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.0: Faka izinombolo eziphelele, izinombolo ezingekho kahle, no-0 esikhundleni sika-x bese ubhala amanani ambalwa u-2^x awathathayo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi amanani owabhalile awela kuliphi ibanga, bese ucabanga ukuthi kukhona u-x onika u-0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi u-0 nawo uyenzeka. Cabanga ukuthi kukhona u-x onge-2^x=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.b: Wawazi ukuthi u-2^x uthatha kuphela amanani amakhulu kuno-0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye amacala lapho u-2^x emncane kuno-1 uma x ingekho kahle.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.d: Ushiye ukuthi umsebenzi we-exponential awukwazi ukuthatha amanani angekho kahle.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.explain: Kunoma yiyiphi inombolo engempela x, 2^x ithatha kuphela amanani amakhulu kuno-0. Uma x iba incane kakhulu, 2^x isondela ku-0 kodwa ayikaze ibe ngu-0. Ngakho ibanga lika-t=2^x ngu-t>0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.prompt: Bhala impendulo ku-Sora. Bhala kabusha "t=−1 ayivumelekile, ngakho siyayilahla" ukuze u-Sora ayiqonde, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani kungekho u-x onge-2^x=−1. (Cishe imishwana engu-3)
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngamazwi u-Sora awaziyo. Kuthiwani ngokunikeza izibonelo zamanani oyawathola uma ufaka amanani ambalwa ka-x ku-2^x?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.1: Esikhundleni segama elithi "ayivumelekile," beka emshweni wakho ukuthi yiliphi ibanga lamanani u-2^x angawathatha.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usebenzise amagama u-Sora awaziyo (isibonelo, amanani owathola ngokufaka amanani ambalwa ka-x ku-2^x)?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe unikeze isizathu esithile esikhundleni segama elithi "ayivumelekile"?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uphinde wakhomba ukuthi kungani u-t=4 ungasetshenziswa?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.0: Sora, uma ufaka x=1, 0, −3 ku-2^x, uthola 2, 1, 1/8, futhi wonke makhulu kuno-0. Noma ushintsha u-x kanjani, u-2^x akaze abe ngekho kahle, ngakho akukho u-x onge-2^x=−1. Ngakho silahla u-t=−1 futhi sisebenzisa u-t=4 kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.1: Noma ngabe uphindaphinda noma uhlukanisa u-2 kangaki, uhlala uthola inombolo enhle. U-2^x uthatha kuphela amanani amakhulu kuno-0, ngakho 2^x=−1 akunakwenzeka. t=4 inhle, ngakho inika x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.2: t=2^x ihlala inhle. Ngakho uma uthola inombolo engekho kahle njengo-t=−1, alukho u-x onjalo nje. Lokho akuyona iphutha ekuxazululeni, kungenxa yemvelo ye-2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.0: Vumela 3^x=t, uxazulule isibalo ku-t, bese uthola onke amanani ka-t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kunani ngalinye lika-t olitholile, hlola ukuthi kukhona u-x ogculisa 3^x=t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.b: Ushiye icala lapho u-t enhle. Hlola amanani ka-t owatholile ngalinye.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.c: Uqaphele ukuthi u-t=−1 akanikeli sixazululo futhi u-t=3 kuphela osetshenziswayo.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.d: Bala futhi ubudlelwano phakathi kwenani lezixazululo ze-t nenani lezixazululo ze-x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.explain: Uma sivumela 3^x=t, khona-ke t²−2t−3=(t−3)(t+1)=0. t=3 inika x=1 kusuka ku-3^x=3, futhi t=−1 ayinikeli sixazululo ngoba 3^x>0. Ngakho kunesixazululo esisodwa kuphela esingempela, x=1.

n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu o-1 ngesikhathi. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo ngokususelwa kuphela kulokho owaziyo kuze kube manje.
n-m-h2-diff-04.title: Inani lezimpande ezingempela linqunywa kanjani?
n-m-h2-diff-04.topic: Isimo segrafu yomsebenzi we-cubic nezimpande ezingempela zesibalo
n-m-h2-diff-04.goal: Njalo uma kwengezwa ulwazi, buyekeza isinqumo sakho mayelana nenani lezimpande ezingempela ezihlukile zesibalo se-cubic, bese uchaza umkhawulo lapho izimpawu nenani lamanani eyivelakancane kushintsha khona.
n-m-h2-diff-04.material: Cabanga ngenani lezimpande ezingempela ezihlukile zesibalo se-cubic x³−3x²+k=0 (k iyinombolo engaguquki). Vumela f(x)=x³−3x²+k, bese wenza isinqumo njalo uma kuvezwa ucezu lolwazi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.1: Ukufunda inani lezimpande ezingempela kusukela esimweni segrafu
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ngokwehlukana amanani omkhawulo lapho inani lishintsha khona
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.0: I-local maximum ne-minimum yomsebenzi we-cubic nesimo segrafu yawo
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.1: Izimpande ezingempela zesibalo namaphoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, cabanga ukuthi isinqumo sakho sidinga ukushintsha yini.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi igrafu inqamula i-x-axis kangaki ngokuya ngezimpawu ze-local maximum ne-local minimum.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=x³−3x²+k ungumsebenzi we-cubic one-leading coefficient enhle, futhi inani lika-k alikaziwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Isibalo f(x)=0 sinezimpande ezingempela ezihlukile ezingaki?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Iziphetho ezimbili zegrafu ye-cubic zinqunyiwe, eyodwa iya phezulu enye iya phansi, ngakho ihlangana ne-x-axis okungenani kanye. Kodwa ukuthi ihlangana kangaki kuncike lapho amanani e-local maximum ne-local minimum akhona.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ihlala ingu-3, noma ngabe k iyini
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ixubanise iqiniso lealgebra lokuthi isibalo se-cubic sinezimpande ezi-3 nenani lezimpande ezingempela ezihlukile.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ibone ukuthi inani lezikhathi igrafu ehlangana ngazo ne-x-axis lingahluka no-k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Isitshele ukuthi igrafu inqamula i-x-axis kanye kuphela.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Asikwazi ukusho lutho ngoba asiyazi i-k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ayizange ibeke ngisho uhla olungenzeka lwenombolo. Kukhona okungaziwa ngokubukeka komsebenzi we-cubic.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.info: f'(x)=3x(x−2), ngakho kukhona i-local maximum ku-x=0 ne-local minimum ku-x=2. Inani le-local maximum yi-f(0)=k futhi inani le-local minimum yi-f(2)=k−4.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Uma k=1, zingaki izimpande zangempela ezihlukene?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma k=1, inani le-local maximum ngu-1 (lihle) futhi inani le-local minimum ngu-−3 (alihle). Igrafu iqala ekupheleni kwesobunxele iyakhuphuka, inqamule i-x-axis, ifinyelele i-local maximum, yehle, inqamule i-x-axis, ifinyelele i-local minimum, bese iphinda ikhuphuke inqamule i-x-axis, ngakho kunezimpande zangempela ezihlukene ezi-3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ibone kuphela ukuthi inani le-local maximum u-1 lihle futhi yacabanga ukuthi igrafu ihlangana ne-axis kanye.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Icabanga ngelicala lapho igrafu ithinta khona i-x-axis. Lokho kusebenza kuphela uma inani elivelele lilingana no-0 ncamashi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ibone ukuthi i-local maximum ihle futhi i-local minimum ayihle, ngakho igrafu inqamula i-x-axis kathathu.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uma k=1, inani le-local maximum nenani le-local minimum zombili ziyaziwa.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukushintsha i-k kuhambisa igrafu iye phezulu noma phansi, ngakho izimpawu zenani le-local maximum k nenani le-local minimum k−4 zincike ku-k, futhi kukhona izikhathi lapho elilodwa kuzo lingaba yi-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngani inani le-k kunezimpande zangempela ezi-2 ezihlukene ncamashi?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Uma k=0, f(x)=x²(x−3), ngakho izimpande ngu-x=0 (indawo yokuthinta) no-x=3; uma k=4, f(x)=(x+1)(x−2)², ngakho izimpande ngu-x=−1 no-x=2 (indawo yokuthinta). Kuzo zombili izimo kunezimpande zangempela ezi-2 ezihlukene. Igrafu ithinta i-x-axis ncamashi lapho inani elivelele liyi-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ibheke kuphela icala lapho inani le-local maximum liyi-0. Kukhona nelicala lapho inani le-local minimum liyi-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ibheke kuphela icala lapho inani le-local minimum liyi-0. Kukhona nelicala lapho inani le-local maximum liyi-0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Lolu hla yilapho amanani avelele enezimpawu eziphikisanayo, ngakho kunezimpande zangempela ezi-3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, ngoba singayazi i-k, sasazi kuphela ukuthi inani lezimpande zangempela lingahluka. Uma sesithole amanani avelele, sakwazi ukunquma inani ku-k=1, futhi sabona umkhawulo lapho inani lishintsha lisuka ku-3 liya ku-2 ngesikhathi inani elivelele lithi liyi-0. Inani lezimpande zangempela zesibalo linganqunywa yigrafu nezimpawu zamanani avelele.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ukuthi i-k kumele ibe kuluphi uhla ukuze kube nezimpande zangempela ezintathu ezihlukene, futhi chaza ukuthi kungani amanani omkhawulo k=0 no-k=4 engafakiwe.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi inani le-local maximum nenani le-local minimum kumele ngalinye libe nophawu luni ukuze igrafu inqamule i-x-axis kathathu.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hlukanisa i-f(x) ngezinto uma k=0 nalapho k=4, bese uthola izimpande ngqo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale isimo sophawu senani le-local maximum nesenani le-local minimum?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlole ngqo ukuthi zingaki izimpande ezikhona ngempela emanini omkhawulo?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.0: Inani le-local maximum k kumele libe lihle futhi inani le-local minimum k−4 kumele libe lingalihle, ngakho 0<k<4. Uma k=0 noma k=4, inani elivelele liyi-0, ngakho igrafu ithinta i-x-axis futhi kunezimpande zangempela ezi-2 kuphela ezihlukene.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.1: 0<k<4. I-local maximum kumele ibe ngaphezu kwe-x-axis futhi i-local minimum ibe ngaphansi kwayo ukuze igrafu inqamule kathathu. Emanini omkhawulo angu-0 no-4, kuvela impande ephindwe kabili futhi kunezimpande ezimbili kuphela ezihlukene, ngakho zishiyiwe.

n-m-h2-limit-03.title: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwezimpawu zamanani omkhawulo nempande ngaphakathi kwesikhala
n-m-h2-limit-03.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: i-converse ye-Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-03.goal: Hlukanisa lokho i-Intermediate Value Theorem ekunikezayo (isimo esanele) nalokho engakunikezi, bese wakha futhi uhlola isibonelo lapho i-converse ye-theorem ingasebenzi.
n-m-h2-limit-03.material: Kumsebenzi oqhubekayo f, i-Intermediate Value Theorem ithi, "Uma f(0)f(4)<0, bese kukhona x esikhaleni (0, 4) onokuthi f(x)=0." UDoyun uthi, "Khona-ke uma f(0)f(4)>0, ngeke kube khona impande ku-(0, 4)."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukukhombisa ukuthi isimangalo sikaDoyun asilona iqiniso, kumele ufune umsebenzi oqhubekayo onjani?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala isimangalo sikaDoyun sihlukaniswe sibe "isisusa → isiphetho."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isisusa nesiphetho kumele ngasinye sibe yini ukuze isimangalo singabi yiqiniso.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.a: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo onokuthi f(0)f(4)<0 futhi ongenampande ku-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.a: Ngenxa ye-Intermediate Value Theorem, umsebenzi onjalo ongeke ube khona. Uma i-theorem ilungile, ngeke uthole oyedwa.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.b: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo onokuthi f(0)f(4)>0 futhi ongenampande ku-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.b: Lesi sibonelo sivumelana nesimangalo sikaDoyun, ngakho asiphuli isimangalo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.c: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo onokuthi f(0)f(4)<0 futhi onempande ku-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.c: Leli yicala i-theorem ekuqinisekisayo, ngakho alinasixhumanisi nesimangalo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.d: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo onokuthi f(0)f(4)>0 futhi onempande ku-(0, 4)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.explain: Ukukhombisa ukuthi isimangalo sesimo esithi "uma ..., bese ..." asilona iqiniso, udinga isibonelo esifeza isisusa kodwa singafezi isiphetho, okungukuthi, isibonelo esinempande ku-(0, 4) noma i-f(0)f(4)>0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.prompt: Vumela i-f(x)=(x−a)(x−b). Faka amapheya amabili ahlukene (a, b) lapho f(0)f(4)>0 futhi i-f(x)=0 inezimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene esikhaleni (0, 4). (a<b)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-f(0) ne-f(4) ngo-a no-b, bese ubona ukuthi izimpande kumele zibe kuphi ukuze amanani amabili abe nophawu olufanayo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha impande eyodwa esikhaleni (0, 4), inombolo eyiphelele noma idesimali, bese ukhetha enye impande phakathi kwaleyo mpande nonqenqema lwesikhala, bese uyihlola ngokubala ngqo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.explain: f(0)=ab ne-f(4)=(4−a)(4−b), futhi uma zombili izimpande ziphakathi kuka-0 no-4, zombili zilungile. Ngakho nakuba f(0)f(4)>0, kunezimpande ezimbili ku-(0, 4). Igrafu yehlela ngaphansi kwe-x-axis bese iphinda ikhuphuke.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ngisho nangesibonelo esinjalo, i-Intermediate Value Theorem ayiphutha. Chaza ukuthi kungani ngomusho owodwa noma emibili.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala kabusha ukuthi i-theorem isho ngasiphi isiqondiso: yini ebonisa yini.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umusho onesiqondiso siphendukisiwe usho into efanayo yini.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho kahle ngamagama isiqondiso se-theorem?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombisile ukuthi isibonelo asiphikisani ne-theorem?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.0: I-Intermediate Value Theorem isho kuphela ukuthi uma izimpawu zehlukile, kukhona impande. Ayisho ukuthi ayikho impande uma izimpawu zifana, ngakho igrafu enqamula i-x-axis kabili ayiphikisani ne-theorem.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.1: I-converse ye-theorem ayiqinisekiswanga. Noma amanani omkhawulo enezimpawu ezifanayo, igrafu ingaphinda inqamule i-x-axis maphakathi bese ibuya, ngakho impande ingaba khona.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.2: I-theorem isho kuphela ukuthi "uma izimpawu zehlukile, kukhona impande." Ayisho ukuthi "uma kukhona impande, izimpawu ziyahluka."
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.3: Lokho i-theorem ekushoyo kuyaphela ku-"uma izimpawu zehlukile, kukhona impande." Akusho ukuthi lokho yiyona kuphela indlela impande engaba khona ngayo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi engezansi lapho i-Intermediate Value Theorem yodwa ikuvumela ukuthi uphetha ngokuqinisekile ukuthi kukhona x esikhaleni (0, 4) onokuthi f(x)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamunye, hlola izimpawu ze-f(0) ne-f(4) nokuthi ngabe kukhona ukuphuka ku-[0, 4].
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala phansi ukuthi iyiphi imibili i-theorem ekudingayo ukuze iqinisekise impande, bese uqhathanisa inketho ngayinye nayo.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.a: f(0)=4 no-f(4)=4 banophawu olufanayo, ngakho isisusa se-theorem asifezwanga. Noma x=2 iyimpande, le-theorem ayikuqinisekisanga lokho.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.c: Izimpawu ze-f(0) ne-f(4) ziyehluka, kodwa i-f ayiqhubeki ku-x=2, ngakho i-theorem ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa. Eqinisweni, ayikho nempande.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.explain: Ku-b, f(0)=−1 ne-f(4)=3, futhi umsebenzi we-polynomial, ngakho uqhubeka, ngakho i-theorem iqinisekisa impande. Okufanayo kusebenza ku-d, lapho f(0)=−3 no-f(4)=5 futhi i-f iqhubeka. Ku-a, f(0)=4 no-f(4)=4 banophawu olufanayo, ngakho i-theorem ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa (impande x=2 ikhona, kodwa i-theorem ayiyiqinisekisi). Ku-c, izimpawu ziyehluka, kodwa i-f iyaphuka ku-x=2 futhi ayiqhubeki, ngakho i-theorem ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa.

n-m-h2-trig-10.title: Osayizi bamakhona nosayizi bezilinganiso ze-trigonometric kunxantathu
n-m-h2-trig-10.goal: Ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi A, B, C ayizinhlangothi zamakhona angaphakathi konxantathu, hlulela ukuthi ukuqhathanisa osayizi bamakhona kudlulela ngakuphi ekuqhathaniseni amanani e-sin, cos, tan, futhi unikeze izizathu usebenzisa umthetho we-sines namakhona e-obtuse.
n-m-h2-trig-10.material: Abafundi abane benze izimangalo ezilandelayo mayelana namakhona amathathu angaphakathi A, B, C konxantathu ABC. Cabanga ngamacala lapho amanani ezilinganiso ze-trigonometric echaziwe kuphela.
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.0: Hlulela ukuthi isitatimende siyiqiniso noma amanga ngaphakathi kwezimo zaso
n-m-h2-trig-10.prereq.1: Isakhiwo sokuthi uhlangothi oluphambene nekhona elikhulu luyihlangothi elide
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izimangalo ezihlala zilungile konxantathu ABC.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.0: Faka amakhona athile (30°, 100°, njll.) esikhundleni sika-A no-B esimangalweni ngasinye.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa umthetho we-sines ukuguqula u-sinA no-sinB zibe ubude bezinhlangothi, bese ubhala ukuthi ukuqhathanisa usayizi kuphuma kanjani.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuhlulela ukuthi ikhona elikhulu linenani le-sine elikhulu. Ungakuhlola ngokuqhathanisa ubude bezinhlangothi eziphambene namakhona amabili usebenzisa umthetho we-sines.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kuhlulela ukuthi i-cosine enkulu isho ikhona elikhulu. Bheka ukuthi inani le-cosine lishintsha kanjani njengoba ikhona likhula kusukela ku-0° kuya ku-180°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.c: Uguqule usayizi wamanani e-sine abe ubude bezinhlangothi ukuze uqhathanise futhi wasebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi uhlangothi olukhulu lusephambene nekhona elikhulu.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.d: Ushiye ukuthi ikhona likanxantathu lingaba le-obtuse. Qhathanisa amanani amabili e-tan uma A=30° no-B=100°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.explain: Ngomthetho we-sines, a=2R·sinA no-b=2R·sinB, ngakho sinA>sinB kulingana no-a>b, futhi njengoba uhlangothi olukhulu luphambene nekhona elikhulu, kulingana nokuthi A>B. Ngakho a no-c zombili zilungile. Uma cosA>cosB, khona-ke A<B, ngakho b iphenduke, futhi tan ayinhle ekhoneni le-obtuse, ngakho uma A=30° no-B=100°, tanA>tanB kodwa A<B, okwenza d ibe yamanga.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani "uma sinA>sinB, khona-ke A>B" kusebenza konxantathu (c), futhi unikeze isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo esikhombisa ukuthi (d) ayisebenzi.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala kabusha u-sinA no-sinB njengobude bezinhlangothi usebenzisa umthetho we-sines.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.1: Thatha elinye lika-A no-B njenge-obtuse bese ucabanga ngophawu lwenani le-tan.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.placeholder: isb. Ngomthetho we-sines ... Isibonelo esiphikisayo: A=..., B=...
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uguqule ukuqhathanisa kwamanani e-sine kwaba ukuqhathanisa kobude bezinhlangothi?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uqhathanise ngempela amanani ka-tan A no-tan B?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ukhombise esibonelweni sakho esiphikisayo ukuthi A<B kodwa tanA>tanB?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.0: Ngomthetho we-sines, a=2R sinA no-b=2R sinB, ngakho uma sinA>sinB khona-ke a>b. Uhlangothi olukhulu lusephambene nekhona elikhulu, ngakho A>B. Isibonelo esiphikisayo: A=30°, B=100°. tan30° inhle futhi tan100° ayinhle, ngakho tanA>tanB kodwa A<B.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.1: Uma sinA>sinB, khona-ke ngomthetho we-sines uhlangothi a lude kunohlangothi b, bese A inkulu kuno-B. tan ayinhle ekhoneni le-obtuse, ngakho isibonelo uma A=45° no-B=120°, khona-ke tanA=1>tanB=−√3 kodwa A<B.

n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala onephutha esixazululweni sika-Jiho.
n-m-h2-diff-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esithola umugqa we-tangent i-perpendicular emgqeni
n-m-h2-diff-01.topic: Isibalo somugqa we-tangent: i-slope yomugqa we-perpendicular
n-m-h2-diff-01.goal: Esixazululweni esithola i-tangent ekhebulini i-perpendicular emgqeni onikeziwe, thola umugqa wokuqala ophosile, ulungise, futhi uhlole usebenzisa umphumela wama-slope.
n-m-h2-diff-01.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaJiho sokuthola, phakathi kwemigqa ye-tangent edwetshwe emaphoyintini asekhebulini u-y=x²−4x+5, leyo eyi-perpendicular emgqeni u-y=x/2+1. (U-x² usho u-x isikwele, futhi u-x/2 usho u-x phezu kuka-2.)
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isixazululo umugqa ngomugqa ukuthola umugqa wokuqala ophosile
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.1: Ukuguqula isimo se-perpendicular sibe ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-slope
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kwama-slope uma imigqa emibili iyi-perpendicular
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ngalunye ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uvele kanjani emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thola ukuthi igama elithi "perpendicular" lenziwe kanjani ubudlelwano ezibalweni.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.1: Njengoba iyi-perpendicular emgqeni y=x/2+1, i-slope yesithinteli ingu-−1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.3: Iphoyinti lokuthinta ngu-(7/4, 17/16), futhi isithinteli ngu-y=−(1/2)(x−7/4)+17/16.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uwo wokuqala ophutha. Uma imigqa emibili iyi-perpendicular, isiphumo sama-slope ayo singu-−1. I-slope yomugqa o-perpendicular emgqeni one-slope 1/2 akuyona u-−1/2, eshintsha uphawu kuphela, kodwa inombolo isiphumo sayo no-1/2 singu-−1. Ukubala emigqeni 3 no-4 kulandela umugqa 2, ngakho ukubala ngokwakho kulungile, kodwa umphumela uyashintsha.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa onephutha bese uthola i-x-coordinate yephoyinti lokuthinta nesibalo sesithinteli.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba umugqa o-perpendicular emgqeni one-slope 1/2, bese ukhetha izinombolo ezimbalwa ezingaba yileyo slope uzihlole ngokubala no-1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.1: Beka i-slope entsha ilingane no-f'(x) uthole u-x, bese uthola i-y-coordinate yaleyo phoyinti kusuka ku-f(x).
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale isimo se-perpendicular njengesiphumo sama-slope?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthole i-y-coordinate yephoyinti lokuthinta kusukela esibalweni sejika?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubeke isibalo sesithinteli ngefomu elithi y=…?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.0: Uma imigqa iyi-perpendicular, isiphumo sama-slope singu-−1, ngakho (1/2)×m=−1 no-m=−2. Kusuka ku-2x−4=−2, x=1, no-f(1)=2, ngakho iphoyinti lokuthinta ngu-(1, 2) futhi isithinteli ngu-y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.1: Umugqa o-perpendicular emgqeni one-slope 1/2 une-slope −2. U-x onge-f'(x)=−2 ungu-1, futhi iphoyinti lokuthinta ngu-(1,2). Ukwenza lula u-y−2=−2(x−1) kunika y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.prompt: Esixazululweni sika-Jiho, yiluphi uhlolo olungabamba leli phutha ngokushesha?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ukhumbule isibalo esisebenza phakathi kwama-slope emigqa emibili ye-perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.1: Faka ukukhetha ngakunye ngqo kuma-slope amabili ka-Jiho, 1/2 no-−1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.a: Engeza ama-slope amabili bese uhlola ukuthi enza u-0 yini
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.a: Ukwengeza kube ngu-0 ubudlelwano lapho ama-slope enezimpawu eziphambene kuphela. Kusondele kakhulu ekubonakaliseni kuma-x-axis kunokuba i-perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.b: Hlola kuphela ukuthi ama-slope amabili anezimpawu eziphambene yini
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.b: Izimpawu eziphambene ziyadingeka kodwa azanele. Usayizi wama-slope kufanele nawo ufane ukuze imigqa ibe yi-perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.c: Phindaphinda ama-slope amabili bese uhlola ukuthi enza u-−1 yini
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.c: Lokhu kuhlola ngqo incazelo ye-perpendicular usebenzisa ukuphindaphinda.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.d: Hlola ukuthi i-y-coordinate yephoyinti lokuthinta ilele kujika yini
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.d: Noma iphoyinti lokuthinta lisejikeni, lolu hlolo alukwazi ukusho ukuthi i-slope igculisa isimo se-perpendicular yini.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.explain: (1/2)×(−1/2)=−1/4, okungeyona u-−1. Ukuhlola ukuthi isiphumo singu-−1 kudalula iphutha emugqeni 2 ngokushesha.

n-m-h2-diff-02.title: Uma izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha linhle, ingabe umsebenzi uhlala ukhuphuka ebangeni?
n-m-h2-diff-02.goal: Qinisekisa, ngomsebenzi we-quadratic owakhayo, ukuthi noma izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha ebangeni linhle, ingxenye yomsebenzi ngaphakathi kwaleli banga ingase ibe iyehla.
n-m-h2-diff-02.material: U-Youngwoo uthi, "Uma izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha lomsebenzi f ebangeni [0, 4] linhle, khona-ke f iyakhula kuleli banga." Ufuna ukuhlola lokhu ngemisebenzi yefomu f(x)=x²−bx (b iyinombolo engaguquki).
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlukanisa ukuqhathanisa iziphetho ezimbili nokushintsha ngaphakathi kwebanga
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.prompt: Ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende sika-Youngwoo siyamanga, yiluphi uhlobo lomsebenzi okufanele siluthole?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa isitatimende sika-Youngwoo sibe yifomu elithi "uma hypothesis, khona-ke isiphetho" bese usibhala.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi i-hypothesis nesiphetho ngasinye kufanele sibe yini ukuze isitatimende siyamanga.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.a: Umsebenzi onezinga eliphakathi lokushintsha elingekho kahle futhi okhulayo ebangeni lonke
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.a: Umsebenzi onjalo ongeke ubekhona. Awunakho nokwenza nesitatimende.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.b: Umsebenzi onezinga eliphakathi lokushintsha elinhle futhi onengxenye ehlayo ngaphakathi kwebanga
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.c: Umsebenzi onezinga eliphakathi lokushintsha elinhle futhi okhulayo ebangeni lonke
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.c: Lesi yisibonelo esivumelana nesitatimende, ngakho asikwazi ukusiphula.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.d: Umsebenzi onezinga eliphakathi lokushintsha elingu-0 futhi ongaguquki ebangeni lonke
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.d: Izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha alinhle, ngakho aligculisi i-hypothesis yesitatimende.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.explain: Ukukhombisa ukuthi isitatimende sefomu elithi "uma ~, khona-ke ~" siyamanga, udinga isibonelo esigculisa i-hypothesis (izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha linhle) kodwa esingagculisi isiphetho (ukukhula ebangeni).
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.prompt: Ku-f(x)=x²−bx, faka u-b no-p ukuze izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha ku-[0, 4] libe lihle, futhi endaweni ethile p ngaphakathi kwe-(0, 4) f'(p)<0 (f iyehla eduze kwaleyo phoyinti). Yenza izibonelo ezi-3 ezinamanani ahlukile ka-b.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uveze u-f(0) no-f(4) ngokuya ku-b, bese uthola ibanga lika-b lapho izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha linhle.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha inani elilodwa lika-b bese ucubungula ukuthi ngaphakathi kwebanga u-f'(x)=2x−b ungekho kahle kuphi.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c2: p kufanele ibe nkulu kuno-0 futhi ibe ncane kuno-4.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.ok.c3: f'(p)=2p−b ayinhle, ngakho f iyehla eduze kuka-p.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.explain: f(4)−f(0)=16−4b, ngakho izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha ngu-4−b. Ukuze lokhu kube kuhle, b<4, futhi ukuze f'(x)=2x−b ibe ngekho kahle ndawo ethile ebangeni, b>0 iyadingeka. Ngakho wonke u-b onge-0<b<4 unika isibonelo esiphikisayo. Isibonelo, uma b=2, khona-ke f(x)=x²−2x iyehla ku-[0, 1] futhi ikhula ku-[1, 4].
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Noma izibonelo ezinjalo zikhona, iqiniso lokuthi izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha linhle akulona ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Chaza emishweni eyodwa noma emibili lokho ongakusho nongakusho ngezinga eliphakathi lokushintsha elinhle.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Hlola futhi ukuthi yiziphi izindawo zamanani ebanga ezisetshenziswa uma kubalwa izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa amanani ka-f(1), f(0), no-f(4), bese udweba ukuthi igrafu ihambe kanjani.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi amanani kuphela asetshenziswa yizinga eliphakathi lokushintsha yiziphetho ezimbili?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise ushintsho ngaphakathi kwebanga nokuqhathanisa kweziphetho?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha livela ngokuqhathanisa kuphela amanani eziphethweni ezimbili, ngakho likutshela kuphela ukuthi f(4)>f(0). Noma igrafu yehla ndawo ethile phakathi, linhle uma ikhuphuka kakhulu ekugcineni.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha linhle, ungasho ukuthi inani esiphethweni likhulu kunenani lokuqala, kodwa awukwazi ukusho ukuthi lehla kafushane phakathi nebanga yini.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.prompt: Uma konke okwaziwayo ukuthi izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha lika-f ku-[0, 4] linhle, yini engasho ukuthi iyiqiniso ngokuqinisekile?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ifomula yezinga eliphakathi lokushintsha bese ucabanga ngophawu lwesihlukanisi.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ukukhetha ngakunye kuyiqiniso noma amanga ngokukufaka ezibonelweni ozenze ku-s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.a: Noma izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha linhle, f' ingaba ngekho kahle ndawo ethile ebangeni.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.b: Ingaba nengxenye ehlayo, njengesibonelo osenze ku-s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.c: Izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha likhombisa inani lokushintsha, hhayi uphawu lwamanani omsebenzi.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.explain: Uma izinga eliphakathi lokushintsha (f(4)−f(0))/(4−0) linhle, isihlukanisi sinhle, ngakho f(4)−f(0) inhle. Konke ongakwazi ukuqhathanisa kweziphetho.

n-m-h2-diff-03.title: Kusho ini ukuthi amajika amabili aphethwe endaweni eyodwa
n-m-h2-diff-03.goal: Cubungula ukuthi isimo esithi "amajika amabili athinta endaweni eyodwa" sinika izibalo ezingaki, bese uhlukanisa ukuthi izimo azanele nini futhi zanele nini.
n-m-h2-diff-03.material: Ijika y=f(x)=x³ nejika y=g(x)=x²+ax+b (a no-b bayizinombolo ezingaguquki) kuyathinta eduze kwephoyinti (1, 1). (Lokhu kusho ukuthi amajika amabili adlula ephoyintini elilodwa futhi anesithinteli esifanayo lapho.) Ufuna ukuthola u-a no-b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.2: Ukuqhathanisa inani lezinto ezingaziwa nenani lezibalo
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izibalo ze-g okufanele uzisethe ukunquma u-a no-b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala njengezibalo amaqiniso amabili (indawo, i-slope) adingekayo ukuze amajika amabili athinte endaweni eyodwa.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.1: Faka x=1 ku-f(x)=x³ ukuthola i-y-coordinate yephoyinti ne-slope yesithinteli.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.a: Isimo sokudlula ephoyintini (1, 1) silungile, kodwa g(0)=0 yisimo esingekho enkingeni.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.b: Isimo sokudlula ku-(1, 1) silungile, kodwa i-slope kufanele ibhekwe endaweni yokuthinta x=1, hhayi x=0.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.d: Ishintshe amanani ka-f(1) no-f'(1). Kufanele uhlukanise i-y-coordinate yephoyinti ne-slope yesithinteli.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.explain: Ijika g kufanele lidlule ephoyintini (1, 1), ngakho g(1)=1, futhi ukuze izithinteli zifane, ama-slope ku-x=1 kufanele nawo alingane, ngakho g'(1)=f'(1)=3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola amanani ka-a no-b, bese ubhala emgqeni owodwa ukuthi uhlolile kanjani ukuthi amanani owatholile agculisa izibalo ezimbili ezisethwe ku-s1.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthole u-g'(x), bese ubeka inani lawo ku-x=1 lilingane no-3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-a owutholile esibalweni sokudlula ephoyintini ukuthola u-b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale isimo se-slope nesimo sephoyinti ngasinye njengesibalo?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubuyisele u-a no-b owabathola ezibalweni zombili?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.0: g'(x)=2x+a, ngakho g'(1)=2+a=3 inika a=1. Ukufaka a=1 ku-g(1)=1+a+b=1 kunika b=−1. Ngokuhlola, g(1)=1 no-g'(1)=3, ngakho kulungile.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.1: Kusuka esimweni se-slope 2+a=3, a=1, futhi kusuka esimweni sokudlula ephoyintini, 1+1+b=1, ngakho b=−1. Ngihlolile ngokubuyisela ezibalweni zombili.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.prompt: Kulokhu awuyazi indawo yokuthinta, futhi wazi kuphela ukuthi amajika amabili y=x³ ne-y=x²+ax+b "athinta endaweni ethile." Kuleli cala, ingabe u-a no-b banqunyiwe?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.0: Vumela u-t abe yi-x-coordinate yephoyinti lokuthinta bese ubhala izibalo ezimbili zokuthinta.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.1: Bala inani lezinto ezingaziwa nenani lezibalo bese uziqhathanisa.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.a: Aqunyiwe. I-x-coordinate t yephoyinti lokuthinta nayo ayaziwa, ngakho kunezinto ezingaziwa ezi-3 nezibalo ezi-2 kuphela
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.b: Anqunyiwe. Isimo sokuthinta sinika izibalo ezimbili, ngakho u-a no-b bangatholakala
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.b: Ushiye ukuthi njengoba iphoyinti lokuthinta lingaziwa, i-x-coordinate yalo iba into entsha engaziwa.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.c: Anqunyiwe. Isimo sokuthinta sinika isibalo esisodwa kuphela
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.c: Isimo sokuthinta sinika indawo ne-slope, okungukuthi, izibalo ezimbili. Ubale izibalo ngephutha.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.d: Anqunyiwe. Ukuthinta b kufanele ibe ngu-0, bese a nayo inqunywa ngokukhethekile
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.d: Akukho sisekelo enkingeni sokuthi b kufanele ibe ngu-0. Uma iphoyinti lokuthinta lingaziwa, b nayo ingaguquka.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.explain: Uma i-x-coordinate yephoyinti lokuthinta ingu-t, khona-ke t³=t²+at+b no-3t²=2t+a, ngakho kunezibalo ezimbili nezinto ezingaziwa ezintathu, a, b, no-t. Isibonelo, t=1 inika (a, b)=(1, −1) futhi t=2 inika (a, b)=(8, −12); njalo uma t ishintsha, kuphuma (a, b) ehlukile.

n-m-h2-diff-05.title: Ingabe ulayini othinta ihlangana nejika kuphela endaweni yokuthinta?
n-m-h2-diff-05.goal: Linga isimangalo esithi "Ulayini othintayo uhlangana nejika kuphela endaweni yokuthinta" ngejika y=x³, futhi lungisa incazelo yolayini othintayo njengolayini ogudla ongu-slope wawo uyinani le-derivative.
n-m-h2-diff-05.material: UHajun uthi, "Ulayini othintayo ulayini ohlangana nejika kuphela endaweni yokuthinta. Uma udweba ulayini othintayo futhi uhlangana nejika futhi kwenye indawo, ubudweba ulayini othintayo ngephutha." Ufuna ukulinga lesi simangalo ngejika y=x³. (x³ kusho u-x we-cube.)
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.1: Ukuthola amaphoyinti okuhlangana kolayini othintayo nejika ezindaweni eziningana zokuthinta
n-m-h2-diff-05.prereq.1: Ukuhlukanisa izibalo ze-cubic ngezinto (izimpande eziphindwe kabili)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela efanele kakhulu yokulinga isimangalo sikaHajun?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.0: Chaza ngamagama ukuthi isibonelo esephula isimangalo sasizobukeka kanjani.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uthatha indawo yokuthinta njenge-(a, a³), ungabhala isibalo solayini othintayo ngo-a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.a: Dweba ulayini othintayo kuphela ku-origin (0, 0) bese uhlola lapho uhlangana khona nejika
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.a: Ukuhlola iphoyinti elilodwa kungakhombisa kuphela izibonelo ezifanelana nesimangalo. Ukulinga kumele kubheke izibonelo lapho isimangalo singaphuka khona.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.b: Phenya ulayini othintayo kuphela endaweni lapho i-slope yawo iyi-0
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.b: Iphoyinti elinentambo engu-0 liyindawo eyodwa ekhethekile, ngakho alimeleli indawo evamile yokuthinta.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.c: Dweba isithombe bese uhlola ngeso ukuthi ulayini othintayo nejika kubukeka kunamathele yini
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.c: Isimo esibonwa ngeso kuphela asikwazi ukuthi ngabe bahlangana futhi kude.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.d: Thola izinhlamvu zolayini abathintayo ezindaweni eziningana zokuthinta (a, a³) bese uhlola amanye amaphoyinti okuhlangana
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.explain: Uma isimangalo singesona iqiniso, kumele kube khona ulayini othintayo ohlangana nejika nasephoyintini elingelona indawo yokuthinta. Ukuthola oyedwa, kumele usethe isibalo solayini othintayo ezindaweni eziningana zokuthinta, hhayi eyodwa noma ezimbili kuphela, bese usixazulula kanye nejika.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.prompt: Thola futhi ufake amapheya aphelele angu-3 (a, b), anamanani ahlukene ka-a, lapho ulayini othintayo endaweni yokuthinta (a, a³) uhlangana khona nejika y=x³ futhi ephoyintini (b, b³) elingelona indawo yokuthinta. (a isuka ku-−5 kuya ku-5)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-slope nesibalo solayini othintayo endaweni yokuthinta (a, a³) ngo-a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yisiphi isibalo ku-b okumele sibe yiqiniso ukuze iphoyinti (b, b³) libe kulolo layini othintayo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.2: Faka inani elilodwa eliphelele ka-a ngesikhathi bese uthola u-b, futhi uzobona iphethini ka-b.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele ngaphakathi kohla.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a kumele ibe inombolo eyiphelele kusuka ku-−5 kuya ku-5, futhi b kumele ibe inombolo eyiphelele nayo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma b ilingana no-a, iyindawo yokuthinta uqobo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Iphoyinti (b, b³) alikho kulayini othintayo y=3a²x−2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.explain: Ulayini othintayo endaweni yokuthinta (a, a³) uyi-y=3a²x−2a³. Ukuwuxazulula kanye nejika kunikeza x³−3a²x+2a³=(x−a)²(x+2a)=0, ngakho x=a (indawo yokuthinta, impande ephindwe kabili) no-x=−2a. Uma a≠0, bese −2a yehlukile ku-a, ngakho ulayini othintayo uhlangana nejika futhi endaweni engeyona indawo yokuthinta.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.prompt: Phendula uHajun. Ingabe isimangalo sikaHajun silungile? Chaza usebenzisa isibonelo esingenhla njengobufakazi, futhi usho kahle ukuthi ulayini othintayo uyini.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha isibonelo esisodwa osenzile ku-s2 bese ubhala wonke amaphoyinti lapho ulayini othintayo uhlangana khona nejika.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.1: Sho ukuthi "othintayo" ngokwe-slope, hhayi inani lamaphoyinti okuhlangana.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unikeze isibonelo esithile (indawo yokuthinta nephoyinti elihlukile lokuhlangana)?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ugwemile ukukuqonda lokhu njengokwenzeka kuphela kulelijika?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.0: Akulungile. Isibonelo, ku-y=x³, ulayini othintayo y=3x−2 ku-(1, 1) uhlangana nejika futhi ku-x=−2. Ulayini othintayo ulayini one-slope eyinani le-derivative endaweni yokuthinta, futhi usalokhu ungulayini othintayo noma uhlangana nejika futhi kwenye indawo.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.1: Cha. Ulayini othintayo ulayini othinta ijika eduze nendawo yokuthinta (i-slope yawo iyi-derivative kuleyo ndawo), ngakho ungaphinda unqamule ijika kude. Isibonelo, ulayini othintayo ku-(1, 1) udlula nasephoyintini (−2, −8).

n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele ngaphakathi kohla.
n-m-h2-diff-06.title: Ukwakha umsebenzi we-cubic onamanani awo amabili avelele zombili zenzeka ku-x>0
n-m-h2-diff-06.topic: Amanani avelele omsebenzi we-cubic nezimpande ze-derivative yawo
n-m-h2-diff-06.goal: Shintsha isimo ngezindawo zamanani avelele sibe yisimo ngezimpande ze-derivative, futhi wakhe wena imisebenzi eminingana ye-cubic efeza zonke izimo.
n-m-h2-diff-06.material: Ufuna ukwakha umsebenzi f(x)=x³+ax²+bx (a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele) onakho kokubili i-local maximum ne-local minimum, lapho amanani ka-x anikeza lawo manani avelele zombili ezilungile. (ax² kusho u-a ephindwe ka-x isikwele.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.0: Ukuhumusha isimo segrafu sibe yisimo sezimpande ze-derivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.1: Ukuthola ukuthi kungani isimo esisodwa sodwa singanele
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.1: I-discriminant yesibalo se-quadratic nezimpawu zezimpande zaso
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.prompt: Lesi simo sibe yini uma sishiwo njengesimo ku-derivative f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi i-derivative ithatha lithini inani ku-x lapho kwenzeka khona inani elivelele, nokuthi uphawu lwayo lwenza kanjani ngaphambi nangemva.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi mangaki ama-x anjalo adingekayo ukuze kube khona i-local maximum ne-local minimum.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.a: Isibalo f'(x)=0 sinezimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene ezilungile
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.b: Isibalo f'(x)=0 sinempande eyodwa yangempela elungile okungenani
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.b: Uma kukhona impande eyodwa yangempela elungile kuphela, kunenani elivelele elilodwa kuphela, noma enye impande ingase ingabi lilungile.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.c: Khona-ke i-f iqhubeka nokukhula esikhaleni esilungile futhi ayinawo amanani avelele.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.d: Isibalo f'(x)=0 sinempande elungile ephindwe kabili
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.d: Ngempande ephindwe kabili, uphawu lwe-derivative alushintshi, ngakho akukho nani elivelele elenzekayo.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.explain: I-x enikeza inani elivelele iyimpande ye-f'(x)=0 lapho uphawu lwe-f' lushintsha ngaphambi nangemva. Ukuze kube nakho kokubili i-local maximum ne-local minimum, kudingeka izimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene, futhi zombili lezo zimpande kumele zibe zilungile.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka amapheya aphelele ahlukene angu-3 (a, b) lapho ku-f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, f'(x)=0 inezimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene ezilungile. (Amanani aphelele ka-a no-b angu-20 ngobukhulu.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala isamba nomphumela wezimpande ezimbili zesibalo se-quadratic 3x²+2ax+b=0 ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi izimpawu zesamba nomphumela kuphela zanele yini ukusho ukuthi izimpande ziyizangempela.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.2: Khetha u-a ongalona kuqala, bese ushintsha u-b futhi uhlole ngqo ukuthi ngabe kukhona izimpande.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kumele bayizinombolo eziphelele ezinenani eliphelele elingaphezu kuka-20.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Izimpande ezimbili ze-3x²+2ax+b=0 zinombolo zangempela ezihlukene.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c2: I-3x²+2ax+b=0 ayinazo izimpande zangempela ezimbili ezihlukene.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Isamba nomphumela wezimpande ezimbili zombili zilungile.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Isamba (−2a/3) nomphumela (b/3) wezimpande ezimbili akuzona zombili ezilungile.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.explain: Ukuze izimpande ezimbili ze-3x²+2ax+b=0 zibe yizinombolo ezilungile ezihlukene, i-discriminant kumele ibe lilungile (a²−3b>0), isamba sezimpande −2a/3 kumele sibe silungile (a<0), futhi umphumela wezimpande b/3 kumele ube lungile (b>0). Isibonelo, (a, b)=(−3, 1), (−4, 2), (−6, 3).
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.prompt: (a, b)=(−1, 1) ine-a<0 ne-b>0 kodwa ayifezi isimo. Chaza ukuthi kungani, usebenzisa i-f'(x) nesimo se-f.

n-m-h2-diff-08.title: Ngomzuzu lapho ukusheshisa kungu-0, ingabe iphoyinti liyashintsha indlela?
n-m-h2-diff-08.topic: Isivinini nendlela yokunyakaza: ushintsho esikhundleni nebanga elihanjiwe
n-m-h2-diff-08.goal: Hlukanisa izikhathi lapho indlela yokunyakaza yephoyinti elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ishintsha nezikhathi lapho ukusheshisa kungu-0, bese unquma usebenzisa ushintsho lophawu lwesivinini.
n-m-h2-diff-08.material: Isikhundla sephoyinti u-P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo ngesikhathi t (0≤t≤4) ngu-x(t)=t³−6t²+9t. Isivinini singu-x'(t) futhi ukusheshisa kungu-x''(t). UJimin uthi, "Ku-t=2 ukusheshisa kungu-0. Ngomzuzu lapho ukusheshisa kungu-0, u-P ushintsha indlela." (t³ kusho t ku-cube.)
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa isikhathi lapho ukusheshisa kungu-0 nesikhathi lapho indlela ishintsha

n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.prompt: Ukuze uhlole ukuthi isimangalo sikaJimin silungile yini, yini okufanele uyicwaninge kuqala?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi uphawu lwesivinini luhluke kanjani lapho iphoyinti liya kwesokudla nalapho liya kwesobunxele.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa u-x(t) ukuze uthole isivinini, bese ufaka amanani ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kwe-t=2.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.a: Hlola ukuthi isilinganiso sokushintsha esikhathini [0, 4] siyinani eliyipositive yini
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.a: Isilinganiso sokushintsha naso siqhathanisa nje izikhundla ezimbili zokugcina, ngakho asitsheli lutho ngokunyakaza okuphakathi.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.b: Thola ukuthi isikhundla u-x(2) ku-t=2 siyini

n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.c: Bheka ukuthi izimpawu zesivinini v(t)=x'(t) ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kwe-t=2 ziyahluka yini
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.d: Phinda ubale kanye ukuthi ukusheshisa x''(2)=0 kulungile ngempela yini
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.d: Ukuthi ukusheshisa kungu-0 sekunikeziwe kakade. Okudingeka kuhlolwe ukuthi lokho kusho ukushintsha kwendlela yini.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.explain: Indlela iphoyinti elihamba ngayo inqunywa uphawu lwesivinini. Ukuze indlela ishintshe, uphawu lwesivinini kufanele luhluke ngaphambi nangemva, futhi ukuthi ukusheshisa kungu-0 kuphela akusitsheli lokho.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke izikhathi ku-0≤t≤4 lapho indlela yokunyakaza yephoyinti u-P ishintsha khona.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.0: Thola wena ngokwakho isivinini v(t)=x'(t) bese ubala uphawu lwaso ku-t=0, 2 no-4.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi uphawu luyashintsha yini ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kwezikhathi lapho isivinini singu-0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.b: Ku-t=2 ukusheshisa kungu-0, kodwa isivinini singu-−3, ngakho iphoyinti liqhubeka lihamba lisiya kwesobunxele. Indlela ayishintshi.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.d: Isikhathi sokugcina sesikhawu, futhi isivinini ngaleso sikhathi singu-9, okuyipositive. Asisona isikhathi lapho indlela ishintsha khona.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.explain: x'(t)=3t²−12t+9=3(t−1)(t−3), ngakho isivinini singu-0 ku-t=1 no-3, futhi uphawu luyashintsha ngaphambi nangemva kwalezo zikhathi (kusuka kupositive kuya kunegative kuya kupositive). I-t=2 yisikhathi nje lapho ukusheshisa x''(t)=6t−12 kulingana no-0.

n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bala wena ngokwakho inani lesivinini v(2) ku-t=2.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.1: Thola izikhathi lapho isivinini singu-0 bese uqhathanisa ukuthi uphawu lwesivinini luhluke kanjani ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kwazo.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubale wena ngokwakho isivinini ku-t=2 futhi wahlola uphawu lwaso?
