n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uchaze ngamanani ukuthi kungani isimangalo singalungile?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.0: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ukusheshisa kungu-0 ku-t=2, kodwa isivinini v(2)=3·4−12·2+9=−3 siyinegative, ngakho u-P uqhubeka ehamba eya kwesobunxele. Indlela ishintsha lapho uphawu lwesivinini lushintsha, futhi njengoba v(t)=3(t−1)(t−3), ishintsha ku-t=1 no-t=3.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.1: Uma ukusheshisa kungu-0, kungumzuzu nje lapho isivinini singehli futhi singakhuli. Ku-t=2 isivinini singu-−3, ngakho indlela ayishintshi, futhi indlela ishintsha ku-t=1 no-t=3, lapho isivinini sibe ngu-0 futhi uphawu lwaso lushintsha.

n-m-h2-diff-09.title: Ububanzi bika-a lapho umsebenzi uhlala ukhula
n-m-h2-diff-09.topic: Ama-derivative nokukhula: umkhawulo lapho ukulingana kufakiwe
n-m-h2-diff-09.goal: Lapho uguqula umgomo wokuthi umsebenzi ukhula kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela ube umgomo ngophawu lwe-derivative, hlola amanani omkhawulo (lapho i-derivative ingu-0 ephoyintini elilodwa) ngokuhlukile, bese ubhala umphumela njengenothi eliya kumfundi omncane.
n-m-h2-diff-09.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaSoeun, umfundi omncane, owathola ububanzi be-constant a lapho umsebenzi f(x)=x³+ax²+3x ukhula kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela. USoeun waziqhenya ekubonisa lesi sixazululo. (x³ kusho x ku-cube futhi ax² kusho a izikhathi x isikwele.)
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.0: Ukuthola umugqa lapho umgomo usetshenziswe ngokweqile esixazululweni
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha ukuze umfundi omncane akwazi ukulandela
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.1: Umgomo (i-discriminant) wokuthi ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kubambe kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala olahlekile esixazululweni sikaSoeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umugqa ngamunye ukuthi uvela kuphi emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo ngqo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi "ukhula" no"i-derivative iyipositive" kusho into efanayo yini.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.1: Ukuze i-f ikhule kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela, f'(x)>0 kufanele kubambe kuzo zonke ama-x angempela.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.2: Uma i-D iyi-discriminant ye-f'(x)=0, kudingeka D/4=a²−9<0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 ungowokuqala ohamba kabi. Ukuze umsebenzi ukhule, f'(x)≥0 iyanele; akudingeki ibe f'(x)>0. Uma f'(x) ingu-0 ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela futhi iyipositive kwamanye, umsebenzi usakhula kuleli phoyinti. Imigqa 3 no-4 ilandela umugqa 2, ngakho umkhawulo awukho ebubanzini obuphumayo.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukuhlola ukuthi i-f ikhula kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela yini lapho a=3, okungumkhawulo. Iyiphi indlela ehambisana kakhulu?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.0: Faka a=3 ku-f(x) bese wenza izinto zayo, noma uyibhale kabusha ngesimo se-perfect-square noma se-perfect-cube.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi uphawu lwe-f' luyini ngaphambi nje nangemva nje kwephoyinti lapho f'(x) ingu-0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.a: Nquma ukuthi ayikhuli, ngoba ku-a=3 kunei-x ene-f'(x)=0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.a: Nakuba i-derivative ingu-0 ephoyintini elilodwa, umsebenzi uyakhula uma uphawu lwawo lungashintshi ngaphambi nangemva. Kufanele uhlole ngaphambi kokunquma.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.b: Cabanga ukuthi akudingeki ukuhlola okuhlukile, ngoba inani langaphandle kwe-−3<a<3
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.b: Ukuthi liwumkhawulo yini yiyona nto ebuzwayo, ngakho ukuhlola kuyadingeka.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.c: Uphawu ephoyintini elilodwa alukwazi ukunquma ukuthi i-f ikhula kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela yini.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.d: Faka a=3, wenze i-f(x) ibe lula, bese ubheka isimo segrafu
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.explain: Uma a=3, khona-ke f(x)=x³+3x²+3x=(x+1)³−1. Igrafu yesimo se-(x+1)³ inenslayidi engu-0 ku-x=−1 kodwa iqhubeka ikhula. f'(x)=3(x+1)²≥0, futhi iphoyinti kuphela lapho ingu-0 ngu-x=−1.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala inothi eliya kuSoeun. Sho into eyodwa enhle ngomsebenzi kaSoeun, bese uchaza ukuthi yiliphi ingxenye okufanele ilungiswe nokuthi kanjani, usebenzisa isibonelo a=3, ukuze unike ububanzi obulungile bika-a.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.0: Qala uthole into eyodwa uSoeun ayenze kahle.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.1: Uma ubhala enothini ukuthi f'(x) ithatha siphi isimo lapho a=3, kuzoba lula kuSoeun ukuqonda.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uchaze ngokucacile ukuthi yini eyenziwe kahle?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubonise ukuthi ngumuphi umugqa owawungalungile nokuthi kungani, usebenzisa isibonelo a=3?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.0: Soeun, kwakuhle ukuthi ubhale i-discriminant! Kodwa f'(x)≥0 iyanele, hhayi f'(x)>0. Uma a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, ngakho f'(x)=0 ephoyintini elilodwa kuphela, x=−1, futhi umsebenzi uyaqhubeka ukhula. Ngakho −3≤a≤3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.1: Ubhale impendulo ngokuthi −3<a<3, akunjalo? Hlola ukuthi iziphetho a=±3 nazo ziyasebenza yini. Uma ufaka a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, okuwumsebenzi okhulayo. Nakuba i-f' ingu-0 ephoyintini elilodwa, umsebenzi usakhula inqobo nje uma uphawu lungashintshi eceleni kwalo, ngakho kufanele ufake uphawu lokulingana ubhale −3≤a≤3.

n-m-h2-diff-10.title: Singayithola yini inani eliphakeme lasendaweni uma sazi i-derivative kuphela?
n-m-h2-diff-10.topic: Esingakwazi nesingakwazi ukukufunda ngolwazi lwe-derivative: indima yeqembu elingaguquki
n-m-h2-diff-10.goal: Hlola ukuthi ukwazi i-derivative kuphela kukutshela isimo somsebenzi (lapho ukhula noma wehla nalapho kwenzeka khona amanani anqamulayo) kodwa hhayi isikhundla sawo esithambekile (usayizi wamanani anqamulayo), bese uchaza ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo.
n-m-h2-diff-10.material: I-derivative yomsebenzi we-cubic f(x) yaziwa ngokuthi f'(x)=3x²−12. Sifuna ukuthola inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lika-f, kodwa asiyazi i-f(x) ngokwayo. (3x² kusho 3 izikhathi x isikwele.)
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa lokho i-derivative esitshela khona nalokho engasitsheli khona
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.1: Ukwahlulela ukuthi ulwazi olwengeziwe lunosizo kangakanani
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa ulwazi ukuthola inani eliphakeme lasendaweni
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.0: Uphawu lwe-derivative namaphoyinti aphakeme naphansi asendaweni
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imibono yolwazi lapho, uma wazi owodwa wayo ngaphezu, ungathola inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lika-f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kusuka ku-f'(x), bhala ukuthi i-f(x) ithatha siphi isimo. Ingabe kukhona ingxenye engazange inqunywe?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola, inketho eyodwa ngesikhathi, ukuthi inquma leyo ngxenye engazange inqunywe yini.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.a: Uma wazi inani elilodwa lomsebenzi, ithemu elingaguquki liyanqunywa, ngakho yonke i-f iyanqunywa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.d: Uma wazi inani elilodwa lomsebenzi, ithemu elingaguquki liyanqunywa, ngakho yonke i-f iyanqunywa.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.b: Leli nani selingatholwa kakade ngokufaka x=1 ku-f'(x)=3x²−12, ngakho akulona ulwazi olusha.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.c: Lolu lwazi nalo selungatholwa kakade ku-f'(x)=3x²−12 kuphela, ngakho akulona ulwazi olusha.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.explain: Uma f'(x)=3x²−12, khona-ke f(x)=x³−12x+C (i-C iyi-constant). Ama-x-coordinate eziphakeme neziphansi zasendaweni (x=−2, 2) ayanqunywa, kodwa inani eliphakeme lasendaweni f(−2)=16+C linqunywa kuphela uma i-C isinqunyiwe. Ukunquma i-C, udinga inani lika-f (inani lomsebenzi). Ulwazi nge-derivative lufana nalolo esinalo kakade.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.prompt: Unikezwe ulwazi olwengeziwe lokuthi inani eliphansi lasendaweni lika-f lingu-−10. Thola inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lika-f bese ubhala ukuthi walithola kanjani.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa uphawu lwe-derivative ukunquma ukuthi inani eliphansi lasendaweni lenzeka kuliphi inani lika-x.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.1: Faka leyo x ebalweni lika-f(x) bese wakha isibalo ku-constant C.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqale wathola amanani ka-x lapho kwenzeka khona amanani aphakeme naphansi asendaweni?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usebenzise inani eliphansi lasendaweni ukunquma iqembu elingaguquki?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.0: Singabhala f(x)=x³−12x+C (i-C iyi-constant). Inani eliphansi lasendaweni lise-x=2, futhi f(2)=C−16=−10, ngakho C=6. Inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lise-x=−2, futhi f(−2)=16+C=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.1: Ukuhlanganisa i-f' akunquli iqembu elingaguquki, kodwa ukusebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi inani eliphansi lasendaweni lingu-−10 kunquma iqembu elingaguquki libe ngu-6. Inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lenzeka ku-x=−2, futhi f(−2)=−8+24+6=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.prompt: Imisebenzi emibili ye-cubic f no-g inezi-derivative ezifanayo, futhi f(0)−g(0)=6. Liyini inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lika-f lisuswe inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lika-g?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.0: Uma f'=g', bhala ukuthi kwenzekani uma uhlukanisa u-f(x)−g(x).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi leso sihlukanisi siyashintsha ngo-x noma siyi-constant.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi izi-derivative ezilinganayo zisho amanani aphakeme asendaweni alinganayo. Uma amaqembu angaguquki ehlukile, osayizi bamanani anqamulayo nabo bayahluka.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.c: Ungeze umehluko wamaqembu angaguquki kabili. Endaweni ephakeme, umehluko usangu-6.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.explain: Uma f'=g', khona-ke f(x)−g(x) iyi-constant, futhi njengoba f(0)−g(0)=6, f(x)−g(x)=6 kuwo wonke ama-x. Inani eliphakeme lasendaweni lenzeka ku-x ofanayo kokubili, ngakho umehluko wamanani aphakeme asendaweni nawo ungu-6.

n-m-h2-diff-11.title: Ukwenza ukungalingani okubambe ku-x>0
n-m-h2-diff-11.topic: Ukufakazela ukungalingani: ukukhawulela isikhawu nomgomo wokulingana
n-m-h2-diff-11.goal: Thola inani eliphansi kakhulu usebenzisa ukuhlukanisa ukuze wakhe wena ngokwakho ukungalingani okuhlangabezana nemigomo, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani ukukhawulela indawo kushintsha umphumela.
n-m-h2-diff-11.material: U-a uyinombolo ephelele eyipositive futhi u-k uyinombolo ephelele. Sifuna ukukhetha u-a no-k ukuze ukungalingani x³+k≥3a²x kuhlale kubambe ku-x eyipositive, futhi ukulingana kubambe kwenye i-x eyipositive. (3a²x kusho 3 izikhathi a isikwele izikhathi x.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.0: Ukuguqula ukungalingani kube umgomo ngenani eliphansi kakhulu lomsebenzi owodwa
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.1: Ukwakha icala lapho ukulingana kubamba khona
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ukuthi yini eshintshayo uma isikhawu sishintsha
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.0: Amanani anqamulayo namanani aphansi kakhulu usebenzisa ama-derivative
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.prompt: Uma sivumela h(x)=x³−3a²x+k, ngumuphi umqondo we-h(x) ku-x>0 lo mgomo oguquka ube yiwo?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda usho ukuthi "ukungalingani kuhlala kubambe" njengesitatimende ngenani elincane kakhulu lika-h(x).
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.1: Isho ukuthini "kukhona x lapho ukulingana kubamba" ngalelo nani elincane kakhulu?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.a: Uma inani elikhulu kakhulu lingu-0, khona-ke h(x)≤0, ngakho ukungalingani kuya ngakolunye uhlangothi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.b: Khona-ke kukhona x ene-h(x)<0, ngakho ukungalingani kuyehluleka.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.c: Lokho kubheka umqondo we-h', hhayi we-h. Ukungalingani kumayelana namanani ka-h.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.explain: Ukuze h(x)≥0 ibambe njalo ku-x>0, inani eliphansi kakhulu kufanele libe ngu-0 noma ngaphezulu, futhi ukuze kube nge-x lapho ukulingana kubamba khona, inani eliphansi kakhulu kufanele libe ngu-0 ncamashi.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.prompt: Faka amapheya amathathu (a, k) ahlangabezana nemigomo, anamanani amathathu ahlukile ka-a. (a iyinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-10.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.0: Thola i-x eyipositive lapho h'(x)=0, bese uhlola uphawu lwe-h' ezinhlangothini zombili zayo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inani lika-h kuleyo x ngo-a no-k, bese uthola u-k owenza libe ngu-0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c1: U-a uyinombolo egcwele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-10, futhi u-k nawo uyinombolo egcwele.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c1: U-a kufanele abe yinombolo egcwele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-10, futhi u-k kufanele abe yinombolo egcwele nawo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani elincane kakhulu luka-h ku-x>0 lingu-0 ngqo.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani elincane kakhulu luka-h(x) ku-x>0 aliyona u-0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.explain: h'(x)=3x²−3a²=3(x−a)(x+a), futhi ku-x>0, u-h ushintsha usuka ekwehleni uye ekukhuleni ku-x=a, ngakho unenani elincane kakhulu u-h(a)=k−2a³. Uma leli nani lingu-0, ukungalingani kuhlala kusebenza futhi ukulingana kusebenza ku-x=a. Ngakho k=2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ngomusho owodwa ngamunye ukuthi kwenzekani uma u-k mncane kuno-2a³ nalapho u-k mkhulu kuno-2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi inani luka-h ku-x=a lishintsha kanjani ngo-k, usebenzisa u-k=2a³ njengesethenjwa.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ukungalingani ukuhlala kusebenza nokulingana ukusebenza kuyizinto ezihlukile.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Uma u-k mncane kuno-2a³, u-h unegethivu ku-x=a, ngakho ukungalingani kuyahluleka. Uma u-k mkhulu kuno-2a³, inani elincane kakhulu likhulu kuno-0, ngakho ukungalingani kuyasebenza, kodwa akukho u-x lapho ukulingana kusebenza khona.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Uma k<2a³, inani elincane kakhulu lingaphansi kuka-0, ngakho kukhona u-x lapho ukungalingani kungasebenzi. Uma k>2a³, kuhlala kusebenza, kodwa inani elincane kakhulu likhulu kuno-0, ngakho akukho u-x oyiphozithivu lapho ukulingana kusebenza khona.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.prompt: Ingabe kukhona ipheya (a, k) lapho ukungalingani okufanayo x³+k≥3a²x kusebenza hhayi ku-x oyiphozithivu kuphela kodwa kuwo wonke u-x wangempela?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.0: Linganisela uphawu luka-h(x) uma u-x eyinombolo enegethivu encane kakhulu, njengo-−10 noma u-−100.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umphumela ohloliwe ezinombolweni eziphozithivu kuphela unwebeka ngokuzenzakalelayo ezinombolweni ezinegethivu yini.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.a: Cha. Uma u-x eba mncane kakhulu (onegethivu), uhlangothi lwesokunxele luba ngaphansi kuka-3a²x
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.b: Yebo. Ngo-k=2a³ otholwe ngenhla, kusebenza kuwo wonke u-x wangempela
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.b: Uhlole kuphela u-k=2a³ ku-x>0 futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi kusebenza ku-x<0 yini. Kuyahluleka uma u-x eyinombolo enegethivu encane kakhulu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.c: Yebo. Uma ukhetha u-k omkhulu ngokwanele, kusebenza kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.c: Uma u-x eba mncane kakhulu (onegethivu), u-x³ wehla ngokushesha kakhulu kuno-k, ngakho kuyahluleka noma wenza u-k abe mkhulu kangakanani.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.d: Cha. Uma ufaka u-x=0, ukungalingani sekuvele kuyahluleka
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.d: Uma x=0, sidinga u-k≥0, futhi njengoba k=2a³>0, kuyasebenza.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.explain: U-h(x)=x³−3a²x+k uya ku-−∞ njengoba u-x eba nenegethivu nakakhulu. Ngakho noma ukhetha u-k kanjani, kukhona u-x onu-h(x)<0. Ngoba sikhawulele ku-x oyiphozithivu, ipheya (a, k) elanelisa isimo laliyikhona.

n-m-h2-explog-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esabala umsuka wesikwele usebenzisa imithetho yama-exponent
n-m-h2-explog-01.goal: Thola umugqa wokuqala ophosile esixazululweni esisebenzisa imithetho yama-exponent, futhi uhlole izimo lapho lowo mthetho ungasetshenziswa khona ukuthola inani elilungile.
n-m-h2-explog-01.material: UHayun wathola inani lika-√((−3)²) usebenzisa imithetho yama-exponent. (U-(−3)² uyisikwele sika-−3, futhi ukuphakamisa ngamandla u-1/2 kusho into efanayo nokuthatha umsuka wesikwele. Ake sivumelane ukuthi i-exponent engxenyeni ichazwa kuphela uma isisekelo siphozithivu.)
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isixazululo kuze kube sekugcineni nokuthola umugqa wokuqala ophosile
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.2: Ukuhlola izimo lapho umthetho usebenza khona
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaHayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngaphakathi kwamabhrekhethi, bala inani ngqo kuqala, futhi uliqhathanise nomphumela wokugcina kaHayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hamba ngemigqa eyodwa ngeyodwa futhi uhlole ukuthi emgqeni muphi amanani amabili aqala ukuhluka.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 ngowokuqala ophosile. U-(a^m)^n=a^(mn) one-exponent engxenyeni ngumthetho wesisekelo esiphozithivu, kodwa isisekelo u-−3 sinegethivu. Empeleni, ((−3)²)^(1/2)=9^(1/2)=3. Imigqa 3 no-4 ukubala okulandela umugqa 2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inani elilungile, futhi usebenzise uphawu lwesisekelo ukuchaza ukuthi kungani umugqa lapho uHayun asebenzise khona umthetho wama-exponent wawungenakusetshenziswa.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bala u-(−3)² kuqala, bese uphakamisa leli nani ngamandla angu-1/2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.1: Funda kabusha isivumelwano mayelana nokuthi isisekelo kwakufanele sibe yinombolo yohlobo luni uma kusetshenziswa umthetho.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uthole u-(−3)²=9 kuqala bese uthola inani u-3?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Usho ukuthi umthetho wama-exponent ungasetshenziswa kuphela uma isisekelo siphozithivu?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ungasho ukuthi kungani u-−3 kaHayun engenakwenzeka njengenani lomsuka wesikwele?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.0: √((−3)²)=√9=3. U-(a^m)^n=a^(mn) wama-exponent engxenyeni ungasetshenziswa kuphela uma isisekelo siphozithivu, kodwa lapha isisekelo u-−3 sinegethivu, ngakho kwakungenakusetshenziswa, futhi ukusisebenzisa noma kunjalo kunika inani eliphosile u-−3.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.1: Kuqala, (−3)²=9, futhi umsuka wesikwele oyiphozithivu ka-9 ungu-3, ngakho inani ngu-3. UHayun wasebenzisa umthetho noma isisekelo sinegethivu, ngakho uphawu lwaphuma luhlukile.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.2: Impendulo: 3. Uphawu lomsuka wesikwele linika inani elingu-0 noma ngaphezulu, ngakho alikwazi ukuba ngu-−3. Inkinga ukuthi umthetho wama-exponent engxenyeni wasetshenziswa enombolweni enesisekelo esinegethivu.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.prompt: Khetha wonke u-(a, m, n) lapho izinhlangothi zombili zika-(a^m)^n=a^(mn) zichazwe futhi zinenani elifanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ngenketho ngayinye, bala uhlangothi lwesokunxele nolwesokudla ngokwehlukana, futhi uqale ngokuhlola ukuthi zombili zinenani.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.1: Uma zombili zinenani, qhathanisa ukuthi ziyalingana yini. Cabanga ngokwehlukana icala lapho i-exponent iyinombolo egcwele nalapho iyingxenye.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.a: Uhlangothi lwesokunxele ((−3)²)^(1/2) ngu-3, futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla (−3)^1 ngu-−3. Kunge-exponent engxenyeni, ngakho umthetho awusebenzi.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.b: Uphuthelwe ukuthi ngama-exponent ezinombolo ezigcwele ezinhlangothini zombili umthetho uyasebenza noma isisekelo sinegethivu. Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-729.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.c: Uphuthelwe ukuthi uma isisekelo siphozithivu, umthetho uyasebenza noma ngama-exponent engxenyeni. Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-25.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.d: Uhlangothi lwesokunxele (−4)^(1/2) alichazwanga. Kufanele uqale ngokuhlola ukuthi zombili izinhlangothi zichazwe yini.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.e: Uphuthelwe ukuthi i-exponent enegethivu nayo iyinombolo egcwele, ngakho umthetho uyasebenza. Zombili izinhlangothi zingu-1/64.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.explain: U-(−3, 2, 3) uyasebenza ngoba 9³=729=(−3)⁶, u-(5, 1/2, 4) uyasebenza ngoba (√5)⁴=25=5², futhi u-(−2, 3, −2) uyasebenza ngoba (−8)^(−2)=1/64=(−2)^(−6). Ku-(−3, 2, 1/2), amanani ayahluka, u-3 no-−3, futhi ku-(−4, 1/2, 2), uhlangothi lwesokunxele alichazwanga. Umehluko oyinhloko ngukuthi ama-exponent ezinombolo ezigcwele angasetshenziswa uma isisekelo singesona u-0, futhi ama-exponent engxenyeni angasetshenziswa uma isisekelo siphozithivu.

n-m-h2-explog-02.title: Amanani ka-x lapho i-logarithm enamaletha esisekelweni nasembikweni ichazwa khona
n-m-h2-explog-02.goal: Thola wena amanani ka-x lapho i-logarithm enu-x kokubili esisekelweni nasembikweni ineqondo khona, futhi uhlele izimo eyodwa ngeyodwa ukuthola uhla luka-x.
n-m-h2-explog-02.material: I-logarithm u-log_a N inenani kuphela uma isisekelo u-a nombiko u-N kwanelisa izimo ezithile. Kulokhu, bheka inkulumo u-log_{x−1}(5−x), enu-x kokubili esisekelweni nasembikweni. (Isisekelo siyi-x−1 futhi umbiko ngu-5−x.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.1: Ukuhlunga ukuthi kungani amanani ahlulekile angavunyelwe
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlanganisa izimo ozitholile zibe uhla olulodwa
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.prompt: Thola futhi ufake amanani amathathu ahlukile ka-x lapho u-log_{x−1}(5−x) anenani. (Amadesimali ayavunyelwa.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka inani ku-x futhi ubhale ukuthi isisekelo u-x−1 nombiko u-5−x kuba yini ngakunye.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi isisekelo nombiko kokubili kuyizingamani ezivunyelwe incazelo ye-logarithm. Uma uthola inani elingavunyelwe, qopha ukuthi yiliphi elibangele.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Isisekelo u-x−1 singu-1. Isisekelo asikwazi ukuba ngu-1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.explain: Isibonelo, x=3 unika u-log_2 2, x=4 unika u-log_3 1, no-x=1.5 unika u-log_{0.5} 3.5; kuwo wonke, isisekelo siphozithivu futhi asingu-1, futhi umbiko uphozithivu. U-x=2 akavunyelwe ngoba isisekelo singu-1, u-x=0 ngoba isisekelo sinegethivu, no-x=5 ngoba umbiko ungu-0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isizathu esilungile sokuthi kungani u-log_{x−1}(5−x) engenalo inani uma u-x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-x=2 esisekelweni u-x−1 nasembikweni u-5−x futhi ubhale inani ngalinye.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlela ngokwehlukana amanani angenakuba yisisekelo namanani angenakuba ngumbiko, futhi uwaqhathanise nala manani.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.b: Uma u-x=2, u-x−1 akanegethivu. Faka inani bese ubona.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.c: Uma u-x=2, u-5−x ungu-3. Faka inani bese ubona.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.d: Uma u-x=2, u-5−x akanegethivu. Faka inani bese ubona.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.explain: Uma u-x=2, isisekelo singu-1 futhi umbiko ungu-3. U-1 ophakanyiswe ngamandla noma yimaphi ungu-1, ngakho awukwazi ukuba ngu-3, okusho ukuthi u-log_1 3 akanalo inani. Yingakho isisekelo kungafanele sibe ngu-1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala uhla luka-x lapho u-log_{x−1}(5−x) eba nenqondo khona.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala izimo ezimbili zesisekelo nesimo esisodwa sombiko ngokwehlukana njengokungalingani.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.1: Dweba izimo ezintathu emgqeni wezinombolo, uthole lapho zidlulelana khona, futhi ekugcineni uhlole ukuthi akukho nani elishiyiwe ekudlulelaneni.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.0: Kusuka ezimweni zesisekelo u-x−1>0 no-x−1≠1, x>1 no-x≠2. Kusuka esimweni sombiko u-5−x>0, x<5. Ngakho 1<x<5 no-x≠2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.1: U-x kufanele abe mkhulu kuno-1 futhi mncane kuno-5, kodwa u-2 kufanele ashiywe. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ukufaka u-2 kwenza isisekelo sibe ngu-1.

n-m-h2-explog-03.title: Isisho sokuthi 'log x²=2 log x' sihlala sisebenza
n-m-h2-explog-03.goal: Hlola uhla lapho isakhiwo se-logarithm sisebenza khona, uthole isibonelo esiphikisayo sesisho, futhi ulungise inkulumo noma wengeze isimo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.material: UMina uthe lokhu: "U-log x²=2 log x yisakhiwo se-logarithm, ngakho kusebenza kunoma yimuphi u-x." (U-log yi-logarithm evamile.)
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.1: Ukuqhathanisa uhla lapho izinhlangothi zombili zichazwe khona
n-m-h2-explog-03.prereq.0: Isakhiwo se-logarithm u-log a^n=n log a
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha u-x phakathi kwalokhu okulandelayo okukhombisa ukuthi isisho sikaMina asilungile.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ngo-x ngamunye, bala uhlangothi lwesokunxele u-log x² nolwesokudla u-2 log x ngokwehlukana, futhi uqale ngokuhlola ukuthi zombili zinenani.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.1: Uma zombili zinamanani, qhathanisa ukuthi ziyalingana yini. Bheka nokuthi uhlangothi oluthile alunalo inani yini.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.a: U-log 100²=4 no-2 log 100=4, okulinganayo, ngakho akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.b: Uthole icala lapho uhlangothi lwesokunxele lunenani kodwa olwesokudla alichazwanga ngoba umbiko wayo unegethivu.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.c: Noma u-x emncane kuno-1, u-log 0.01=−2 no-2 log 0.1=−2 ayalingana. I-logarithm ukuba nenegethivu kuhlukile ekuboneni ingachazwa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.d: Zombili izinhlangothi zilingana no-0, ngakho akuyona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.explain: Uma u-x=−10, uhlangothi lwesokunxele u-log (−10)²=log 100=2 lunenani, kodwa uhlangothi lwesokudla u-2 log (−10) alichazwanga ngoba umbiko wayo unegethivu. Ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi izinkulumo ezimbili ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa inkulumo kaMina, noma uyibhale ngesimo ku-x lapho isebenza khona, futhi ubhale ukuthi kungani uyilungisa ngaleyo ndlela.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qhathanisa izimpawu zombiko ezinhlangothini zesokunxele nesokudla uma u-x eyiphozithivu nalapho u-x enegethivu.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi umbiko wesokunxele u-x² uthatha inani liphi noma u-x enegethivu, futhi uthole inombolo eyiphozithivu engasetshenziswa kwesokudla esikhundleni sika-x.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Uhlole ukuthi uhlangothi lwesokudla luchazwa uma u-x enegethivu?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uhlole ngenani e-1 ukuthi inkulumo yakho elungisiwe isebenza nalapho u-x enegethivu?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.0: Kufanele ilungiswe ibe ngu-log x²=2 log|x| (x≠0). Uma u-x enegethivu, u-log x akachazwanga, kodwa u-x² uphozithivu, ngakho u-log x² uchazwa.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.1: U-log x²=2 log x usebenza kuphela uma u-x>0. Uma u-x enegethivu, umbiko osohlangothini lwesokudla unegethivu, ngakho awunalo inani.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.2: Uma u-x engesiye u-0, log x² = 2 log|x|. Uma usebenzisa inani eliphelele, umbiko uhlala uphozithivu.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.prompt: Khetha uhla luka-x lapho u-log (x−1)²=2 log (x−1) usebenza khona.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.0: Thola u-x lapho uhlangothi lwesokunxele luchazwa khona no-x lapho uhlangothi lwesokudla luchazwa khona.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.1: Phakathi kuka-x lapho zombili zichazwa khona, thola uhla lapho izinkulumo zinika empeleni inani elifanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.a: Ihlanganisa nohla lapho uhlangothi lwesokudla luchazwa khona.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.b: Uhlangothi lwesokunxele luchazwa ku-x≠1, kodwa uhlangothi lwesokudla aluchazwanga ku-x<1.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.d: Uma x<1, umbiko u-x−1 osohlangothini lwesokudla unegethivu, ngakho awuchazwanga.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.explain: Uhlangothi lwesokudla u-2 log (x−1) luchazwa kuphela uma u-x−1>0, okungukuthi, x>1, futhi kuleso simo lulingana nohlangothi lwesokunxele. Ku-x<1 uhlangothi lwesokudla alukho, ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi ziyalingana.

n-m-h2-explog-04.title: Iyiphi enkulu, u-log₂3 noma u-log₃4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.goal: Lungisa isinqumo sakho ngosayizi be-logarithm njengoba uthola ulwazi oluningi, futhi uqhathanise ama-logarithm amabili ngaphandle kwekhalkhuletha usebenzisa isethenjwa esiphakathi.
n-m-h2-explog-04.material: Ngaphandle kwekhalkhuletha, sifuna ukuthola ukuthi iyiphi enkulu, u-log_2 3 noma u-log_3 4. Ulwazi luvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. (U-log_2 3 yi-logarithm ka-3 enesisekelo esingu-2.)
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.prompt: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo esisekelwe kulokho okwaziyo okwamanje kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma kuvela ulwazi olusha, cabanga ukuthi ugcina noma ushintsha isinqumo sakho.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.1: Uma kokubili isisekelo ne-argument kuhlukile, cabanga ukuthi kuyavumelekile yini ukwahlulela ngokubheka eyodwa kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.info: log_2 3 ngu-x ogculisa 2^x=3, futhi log_3 4 ngu-x ogculisa 3^x=4. Njengoba 2<3<4, log_2 3 iphakathi kuka-1 no-2, futhi njengoba 3<4<9, log_3 4 nayo iphakathi kuka-1 no-2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukwazi kuphela ukuthi zombili ziphakathi kuka-1 no-2 akusivumeli ukuthi sinqume ukulandelana. Sidinga ibhentshimakhi ephakathi enembe kakhudlwana.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: log_2 3: isisekelo sincane, ngakho cishe kuzodinga i-exponent enkulu ukuze kufike ku-3
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Usebenzise umqondo wokuthi uma isisekelo sincane, i-exponent kufanele ibe nkulu. Isinyathelo phambili, kodwa asiqinisekisiwe.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: log_3 4: i-argument 4 inkulu kuno-3, ngakho cishe i-logarithm izoba nkulu
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ubheke i-argument kuphela. Ushiye ukuthi nesisekelo siyashintsha.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Angiqiniseki okwamanje: sazi kuphela ukuthi zombili ziphakathi kuka-1 no-2
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lesi yisinqumo sokuthi kudingeka ibhentshimakhi enembe kakhudlwana.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Asikale ngebhentshimakhi ephakathi engu-3/2. 2^(3/2)=√8≈2.83 incane kuno-3, ngakho log_2 3 inkulu kuno-3/2. 3^(3/2)=√27≈5.20 inkulu kuno-4, ngakho log_3 4 incane kuno-3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wahlulele ngokuphambene nolwazi olusha. Bheka futhi ukuthi iyiphi enkulu kuno-3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uhlukanise amanani amabili ngo-3/2 phakathi kwawo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Amanani amabili asezinhlangothini ezihlukile zika-3/2, ngakho awakwazi ukulingana.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukulinganisela ngendlela efanayo, log_2 3≈1.585, log_3 4≈1.262, log_4 5≈1.161, no-log_5 6≈1.113.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: log_n(n+1) ishintsha kanjani njengoba n iba nkulu?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Njengoba n+1>n, log_n(n+1) ihlala inkulu kuno-1, futhi inani layo liyancipha futhi lisondele ku-1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ubheke i-argument kuphela. Isisekelo naso siyakhula.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Iyancipha, kodwa ayikaze yehle ngaphansi kuka-1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ubheke ukuthambekela kwamanani nokuthi i-argument inkulu kunesisekelo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Iyancipha futhi ekugcineni ihlela ngaphansi kuka-1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uma i-argument inkulu kunesisekelo, i-logarithm ihlala inkulu kuno-1.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni besingakwazi ukunquma ngoba zombili ziphakathi kuka-1 no-2, kodwa uma sifaka ibhentshimakhi ephakathi engu-3/2, ukulandelana kwanqunywa. Uma izinombolo ezimbili zibukeka zihlukile komunye nomunye, thola inombolo yereferensi engabekwa phakathi kwazo bese uqhathanisa ngayinye nayo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.prompt: Khombisa, usebenzisa u-3/2 futhi ngaphandle kwekhalkhuleyitha, ukuthi log_2 3>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ungahlulela usayizi we-log_2 3 uma uqhathaniswa no-3/2 ngokuqhathanisa amandla amabili ka-2. Beka u-2^(3/2) no-3 kwi-exponent efanayo.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ngendlela efanayo, qhathanisa u-log_3 4 no-3/2. Yenza isikwele izinhlangothi zombili bese uqhathanisa izinombolo eziphelele.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ukhombisile ukuthi kungani u-log_2 3 mkhulu kuno-3/2 ngokuqhathanisa izinombolo eziphelele?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombisile futhi ukuthi kungani u-log_3 4 mncane kuno-3/2?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uhlanganise imiphumela emibili waphetha ngo-log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.0: 2^(3/2)=√8 incane kuno-3, ngakho log_2 3>3/2, futhi 3^(3/2)=√27 inkulu kuno-4, ngakho log_3 4<3/2. Ngakho log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.1: Qhathanisa ngokwenza isikwele izinhlangothi zombili. Njengoba 3^2=9>8=2^3, log_2 3>3/2, futhi njengoba 4^2=16<27=3^3, log_3 4<3/2. Ngakho log_2 3 inkulu.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.2: Ukuqhathanisa u-log_2 3 no-1.5: 2^3=8<9=3^2, ngakho mkhulu kuno-1.5. Ku-log_3 4, 3^3=27>16=4^2, ngakho mncane kuno-1.5. Ngakho eyokuqala inkulu.

n-m-h2-explog-06.title: Ukwakha umsebenzi we-exponential y=aˣ+b ukuze uvumelane nezimo ezinikeziwe
n-m-h2-explog-06.goal: Yakha wena umsebenzi we-exponential ografu yawo idlula ephoyintini futhi ihlangana ne-x-axis, bese uhlulela izimo usebenzisa indawo ye-asymptote ne-x-intercept.
n-m-h2-explog-06.material: Asakhe igrafu ye-y=a^x+b (a iyinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-10, no-b iyinombolo ephelele). Sihlulela sisebenzisa kuphela ifomula nezimo, ngaphandle kokudweba isithombe.
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.1: Ukuthola isibonelo esidlula ephoyintini kodwa esiphula esinye isimo
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.prompt: Faka amapheya amabili ahlukile (a, b) ukuze igrafu ye-y=a^x+b idlule ephoyintini (2, 7) futhi ihlangane ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala isimo sokudlula ephoyintini (2, 7) njengesibalo bese uthola ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha u-a, uthole u-b, bese uhlola ukuthi leyo grafu ihlangana ne-x-axis yini. Uma ingahlangani, shintsha u-a.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a iyinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a kufanele ibe yinombolo yemvelo kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c4: I-asymptote y=b iphansi kwe-x-axis, ngakho igrafu ihlangana ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Igrafu ayihlangani ne-x-axis. Hlola indawo ye-asymptote y=b negrafu.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.explain: Kusuka ku-a²+b=7, b=7−a². Isibonelo, a=3 inika b=−2 futhi a=4 inika b=−9; uma b<0, i-asymptote y=b iphansi kwe-x-axis, ngakho igrafu ihlangana ne-x-axis. Ku-a=2, b=3, ngakho igrafu idlula ephoyintini (2, 7) kodwa ilala ngaphezulu kuka-y=3 kuphela.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.prompt: Igrafu eyenziwe ngo-a=2, b=3 idlula ephoyintini (2, 7) kodwa ayigculisi izimo. Bhala isizathu.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.0: Bheka i-asymptote yalenigrafu nokuthi igrafu ilala ngaphezulu noma ngaphansi kwayo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.1: Thola ibanga lamanani u-y=2^x+3 angawathatha, uqale ebangeni le-2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi inani lika-y lihlala likhulu kuno-3?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi, ngakho, u-y akakwazi ukuba ngu-0?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.0: 2^x ihlala inhle, ngakho 2^x+3 ihlala inkulu kuno-3. Ngakho u-y akakwazi ukuba ngu-0, futhi igrafu ayihlangani ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.1: I-asymptote yalenigrafu ngu-y=3, futhi igrafu ilala ngaphezulu kwayo kuphela. Ngakho ayihlangani ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.2: y=2^x+3 ihlala ithatha amanani amakhulu kuno-3, ngakho ayifinyeleli ku-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.prompt: Ku-a>1, khetha isimo ku-b ukuze igrafu ye-y=a^x+b ihlangane ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ibanga le-a^x, bese uthola ukuthi ibanga lika-y liba yini uma wengeza u-b kulo.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi b kufanele ibe yini ukuze u-0 abe ngaphakathi kwaleli banga.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.a: Uma b=0, khona-ke y=a^x, ehlala inhle, ngakho ayihlangani ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.b: Uma b inhle, igrafu ilala ngaphezulu kuka-b, ngakho ayihlangani ne-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.c: Ihlanganisa nelicala lapho b inhle. Hlola icala lapho i-asymptote iphezulu kwe-x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.d: Wawazi ukuthi amanani e-y=a^x+b wonke makhulu kuno-b, ngakho b kufanele ingabi nhle ukuze u-0 afakwe.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.explain: Amanani e-a^x wonke ayizinombolo ezingempela ezinkulu kuno-0, ngakho amanani e-a^x+b wonke ayizinombolo ezingempela ezinkulu kuno-b. Ukuze u-0 abe kuleli banga, b<0 iyadingeka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-asymptote y=b iphansi kwe-x-axis.

n-m-h2-explog-08.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esibale izinombolo ngama-common logarithm
n-m-h2-explog-08.goal: Thola umugqa onephutha esixazululweni esisebenzisa ama-common logarithm ukuthola inani lamadijithi, bese uhlola ukuthi inani lamadijithi lishintsha kanjani emanini omkhawulo.
n-m-h2-explog-08.material: USeoyeon usebenzise ama-common logarithm ukuthola ukuthi u-3^50 unamadijithi amangaki. (log 3=0.4771, futhi 3^50 ngu-3 ephindwe kane-50.)
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala onephutha esixazululweni sikaSeoyeon.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa leso siphumo eceleni kwengxenye eyiphelele ye-logarithm, bese ubona ukuthi isiphetho sesi-4 sikaSeoyeon silungile yini.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.0: Ukuthola inani lamadijithi ka-3^50, thatha i-common logarithm yezinhlangothi zombili.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-4 ungowokuqala ohamba kabi. I-10^23 ngu-1 olandelwa ngamaqanda angu-23, onamadijithi angu-24. Ngakho u-N onokuthi 10^23≤N<10^24 unamadijithi angu-24, futhi kumele ufake u-1 engxenyeni eyiphelele 23 ukuze uthole inani lamadijithi. Umugqa wesi-5 uyisiphumo esilandela emugqeni wesi-4.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala inani elilungile lamadijithi ka-3^50, futhi ubhale ukuthi yisiphi isinqumo sikaSeoyeon esidinga ukulungiswa nokuthi kanjani.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala inani lamadijithi e-10^1, 10^2, 10^3 bese uthola umehluko phakathi kwe-exponent nenani lamadijithi.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa iphethini oyitholile ku-N onokuthi log N=23.855.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthe u-1 kumele wengezwe engxenyeni eyiphelele?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uthe u-N unamadijithi amangaki uma ungaphansi kwe-10^23 futhi ungaphansi kwe-10^24?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.0: Njengoba log 3^50=23.855, 10^23≤3^50<10^24. I-10^23 inamadijithi angu-24, ngakho u-3^50 unamadijithi angu-24. Kumele wengeze u-1 engxenyeni eyiphelele 23.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.1: I-10 emandleni e-23 inamadijithi angu-24, ngakho u-3^50 naye unamadijithi angu-24. USeoyeon ubhale ingxenye eyiphelele ngqo njengenani lamadijithi, kodwa kwakufanele engeze u-1.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.2: Ingxenye eyiphelele ngu-23, futhi inani lamadijithi ngu-23+1=24.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwezinombolo ezilungile N ezinama-common logarithm anikeziwe ngezansi, khetha zonke ezinamadijithi angu-8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-N ngamunye njengohla phakathi kwamandla e-10. Isibonelo, uma log N=7.2, ukuphakathi kwamaphi amandla amabili?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.1: Uma i-logarithm iyinombolo eyiphelele, bhala ncamashi ukuthi u-N ungawaphi amandla e-10, bese ubala amadijithi.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.a: Ubusazi ukuthi uma i-logarithm iyinombolo eyiphelele, N=10^7, onamadijithi angu-8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.b: N=10^8 unamadijithi angu-9. Uma ingxenye eyiphelele ingu-8, inani lamadijithi ngu-9.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.c: Lesi yisinqumo sokungeza u-1 engxenyeni eyiphelele 7 ukuze kutholakale amadijithi angu-8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.d: 6.99 inengxenye eyiphelele 6, ngakho inamadijithi angu-7. Ukusondela ku-7 kwehlukile ekubeni ngaphezu noma kulingana no-7.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.explain: Uma ingxenye eyiphelele ye-log N ingu-n, bese u-N unamadijithi angu-n+1. Uma log N=7.0, bese N=10^7, onamadijithi angu-8, futhi uma kungu-7.2, bese 10^7≤N<10^8, ngakho unamadijithi angu-8. 6.99 inikeza amadijithi angu-7 futhi 8.0 inikeza angu-9.

n-m-h2-explog-10.title: Ukuthola amapheya alungile lapho i-log(a+b)=log a+log b iyiqiniso
n-m-h2-explog-10.goal: Hlola ngokwakha izibonelo wena ukuthi iqiniso elivamile elithi "i-logarithm yesamba akuyona isamba se-logarithm" linezimo ezihlukile yini, bese uhlela isimo njengefomula.
n-m-h2-explog-10.material: log(a+b)=log a+log b yisibalo esivamise ukungabi yiqiniso. Kodwa phakathi kwezinombolo ezilungile a no-b, ingabe likhona ipheya lapho siyiqiniso? (log i-common logarithm.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.1: Ukushintsha isamba se-logarithm sibe yi-logarithm yomphumela
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.0: Isici se-logarithm log a+log b=log ab
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.prompt: Faka amapheya amathathu ahlukene ezinombolo ezilungile a, b lapho i-log(a+b)=log a+log b iyiqiniso. (Ipheya elinika no-b lishintshiwe libalwa njengepheya elifanayo. Amadesimali avumelekile.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hlanganisa isamba se-logarithm ohlangothini lwesokudla sibe i-logarithm eyodwa bese uyiqhathanisa nohlangothi lwesobunxele.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi ama-argument kumele abe yini uma ama-logarithm amabili elingana, bese ukhetha u-a uthole u-b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c1: a no-b kumele bobabili babe balungile.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c2: a+b no-ab kuyalingana, ngakho i-log(a+b)=log a+log b iyiqiniso.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c2: a+b no-ab kwehlukile, ngakho ama-logarithm amabili awalingani.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.explain: Njengoba log a+log b=log ab, isibalo siyiqiniso uma log(a+b)=log ab, okungukuthi, uma a+b=ab. (2, 2), (3, 1.5), no-(5, 1.25) konke kuyasebenza. Sisebenzise iqiniso lokuthi ama-logarithm amabili alingana kuphela uma ama-argument awo elingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.prompt: Bhala njengefomula ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b obukhona emapheyeni owatholile, bese ubhala ukuthi kungani obo budlelwano benza izisho ezimbili zilingane.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.0: Kupheya ngalinye owatholile, bala a+b no-ab bese uzibhala eceleni komunye nomunye.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.1: Hlanganisa i-log a+log b ibe i-logarithm eyodwa bese ubhala ukuthi i-argument iyini.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale i-log a+log b=log ab?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthe uma ama-logarithm elingana, nama-argument alingana?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.0: Njengoba log a+log b=log ab, ukuze log(a+b)=log ab kudingeka a+b=ab. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma ama-logarithm amabili elingana, ama-argument awo ayalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.1: Isamba nomphumela ka-a no-b kumele kulingane (ab=a+b). Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isamba se-logarithm silingana ne-logarithm yomphumela wama-argument, futhi uma ama-logarithm elingana, ama-argument awo ayalingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.2: Kwanele ukuthi (a−1)(b−1)=1. Ukuwuvula kunikeza ab−a−b+1=1, ngakho ab=a+b, futhi log a+log b=log ab=log(a+b).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isitatimende esilungile mayelana nezinombolo ezilungile a, b lapho i-log(a+b)=log a+log b iyiqiniso.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.0: Uma a ingaphezu kuka-1, thatha u-b ube lilungile bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ngu-ab noma a+b okukhulu.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.1: Phakathi kwamapheya afeza a+b=ab, qhathanisa osayizi ba-a no-b omunye nomunye.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.a: Oyedwa ku-a no-b angaba ngaphansi kuka-1
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.a: Uma a≤1, bese ab≤b<a+b, ngakho a+b ayikwazi ukulingana no-ab.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.b: Ubusazi ukuthi uma a≤1 noma b≤1, umphumela uba mncane kunesamba, ngakho abakwazi ukulingana.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.c: Uma bobabili bencane kuno-1, umphumela mncane kakhulu kunesamba.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.d: Oyedwa ku-a no-b kumele abe ngu-2
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.explain: Uma a≤1, bese ab≤b<a+b, ngakho a+b ayikwazi ukulingana no-ab. Okufanayo kuyasebenza uma b≤1. Ngakho emapheyeni asebenzayo, a no-b bobabili bakhulu kuno-1. Njengoba (a−1)(b−1)=1, uma oyedwa esondela ku-1, omunye uba mkhulu.

n-m-h2-limit-01.title: Sidinga ukwazi ini ukuze sisho ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka (continuous)?
n-m-h2-limit-01.goal: Hlunga ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi oludingekayo futhi olwanele ukuphetha ngokuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka ku-x=a, nquma wena ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka yini, bese uhlela leso silinganiso ngamazwi akho.
n-m-h2-limit-01.material: Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi umsebenzi f uqhubeka ku-x=1 yini. Umkhawulo wesobunxele yinani f(x) elisondela kulo njengoba x isondela ku-1 isuka ohlangothini lapho x incane kuno-1, futhi umkhawulo wesokudla yinani elisondela kulo isuka ohlangothini lapho x inkulu kuno-1. Cabanga ukuthi singaphetha yini ngokuthi "uyaqhubeka" uma sazi ingxenye yolwazi kuphela.
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa ulwazi olusivumela ukuthi siphethe nolungenele
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwenani lomsebenzi, umkhawulo wesobunxele, nomkhawulo wesokudla
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.1: Ulwazi lokuhlukanisa amanani omsebenzi namanani omkhawulo
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ucezu olulodwa lolwazi, phakathi kwalokhu okulandelayo mayelana no-f, olukuvumela ukuthi uqiniseke ukuthi f iyaqhubeka ku-x=1 uma wazi kuphela lolo cezu olulodwa.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale lokho okufanele ukuhlole ukuze usho ukuthi iyaqhubeka, bese uphawula ukuthi ukukhetha ngakunye kugculisa konke yini.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa "inani liyachazwa" no-"leli nani lilingana nenani lomkhawulo" njengezingcezu zolwazi ezihlukile.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.a: f(1)=3, futhi f(x) isondela ku-3 njengoba x isondela ku-1 isuka ohlangothini olukhulu
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.a: Ubheke umkhawulo oyedwa wohlangothi olulodwa kuphela. Asikazi inani uma sisondela ohlangothini olunye.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.b: f(1)=3, futhi imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla kokubili ikhona futhi ilingana
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.b: Uyazi ukuthi umkhawulo ukhona, kodwa awukwazi ukusho ukuthi leli nani lomkhawulo lilingana no-f(1)=3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.c: f(1)=3, futhi imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla kokubili ingu-3
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.d: Imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla kokubili ingu-3, futhi f(1) ichazwe njengenani elithile
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.d: Uma wazi kuphela ukuthi f(1) ichaziwe, awukwazi ukusho ukuthi leli nani lingu-3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.explain: Ukuze kuqhubeke, f(1) kufanele ichazwe, umkhawulo njengoba x→1 kufanele ukhona, futhi leli nani lomkhawulo kufanele lilingane no-f(1). Ukukhetha c kugculisa konke okuthathu. Ukukhetha a kunomkhawulo wohlangothi olulodwa kuphela, b akuxhumanisi umkhawulo no-f(1), futhi d akazi inani lika-f(1), ngakho asikwazi ukusho ukuthi lilingana nenani lomkhawulo.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha yonke eyalemisebenzi emine eqhubeka ku-x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kumsebenzi ngamunye, thola ngokulandelana inani lomsebenzi ku-x=1, umkhawulo wesobunxele, nomkhawulo wesokudla, bese uzihlela ethebuleni.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kusibalo esiyingxenyana, senze lula ku-x≠1, bese uthola inani njengoba x isondela ku-1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.b: Njengoba x→1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 isondela ku-2, kodwa f₂(1)=1, ngakho inani lomkhawulo nenani lomsebenzi kuyahluka.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.c: Uma kungekho nani lomsebenzi ku-x=1, asikwazi ukukubiza ngokuthi kuyaqhubeka noma umkhawulo ukhona.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.explain: f₁ ilingana no-x+1 ku-x≠1, ngakho umkhawulo wayo ungu-2, futhi f₁(1)=2 iyahambisana. Ku-f₄, umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-2, umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-3·1−1=2, futhi f₄(1)=2, ngakho konke kuyalingana. Ku-f₂, inani lomkhawulo elingu-2 nenani lomsebenzi elingu-1 kuyahluka, futhi f₃ ayinayo f₃(1).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.prompt: Ku-s2, imisebenzi engaqhubeki yasuswa ngezizathu ezihlukile. Ngamazwi akho, hlela lokho okufanele ukuhlole ukuze usho ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka ku-x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala futhi ukuthi u-f₂ no-f₃ ngamunye basuswe kuluphi into.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.1: Uma izizathu zokwenqatshelwa zihlukile, bala ukuthi mingaki izinto okudingeka uzihlole ukuze uzisuse zonke.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho zonke izimo ezintathu ngaphandle kokushiya noma yisiphi?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe izilinganiso zakho zihlanganisa izizathu zokuthi u-f₂ no-f₃ benqatshelwe?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.0: f iyaqhubeka ku-x=a uma f(a) ichaziwe, umkhawulo ukhona ngoba imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla iyalingana njengoba x→a, futhi leso simo somkhawulo silingana no-f(a).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.1: Okokuqala, inani lomsebenzi kufanele likhona. Okwesibili, umkhawulo kufanele ukhona, okusho ukuthi imikhawulo evela ezinhlangothini zombili iyalingana. Okwesithathu, leso simo somkhawulo kufanele silingane nenani lomsebenzi.

n-m-h2-limit-02.title: Ukuhlola isitatimende sokuthi impande ikhona nge-Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: i-Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.goal: Uma usebenzisa i-Intermediate Value Theorem, ungabheki izimpawu kuphela: hlola ukuthi izimo zethiyori ziyagculiseka, bese ukhombisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi isitatimende siyamanga.
n-m-h2-limit-02.material: U-Seojin wayefuna ukuthola ukuthi isibalo 1/x=0 sinempande engempela ebangeni (−1, 2) yini, ngakho wasetha u-f(x)=1/x futhi wasebenza kanje.
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.1: Ukuthola umugqa lapho isimo sethiyori singekho
n-m-h2-limit-02.prereq.0: Imisebenzi eqhubekayo nesitatimende se-Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sika-Seojin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlukanisa umugqa ngamunye ube "ukubala" noma "isinqumo esisebenzisa ithiyori."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumugqa osebenzisa ithiyori, qhathanisa izimo ithiyori ezidingayo nalokho okuhloliwe, ngalunye.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.2: Ngokwe-Intermediate Value Theorem, kukhona c phakathi kuka-−1 no-2 onokuthi f(c)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa wesi-3 uyiphutha lokuqala. I-Intermediate Value Theorem ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma i-f iqhubeka esikhaleni esivaliwe [−1, 2], kodwa i-f(x)=1/x ayichazwanga ku-x=0, okungaphakathi kwalesi sikhala. Izibalo emigqeni 1 no-2 zilungile, futhi umugqa wesi-4 ulandela nje isiphetho esingalungile somugqa wesi-3.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.prompt: Khombisa ukuthi isiphetho sikaSeojin asilungile. Bhala ukuthi yisiphi isimo umsebenzi okumele usifeze ukuze i-Intermediate Value Theorem isetshenziswe, kungani i-f(x)=1/x ingasifezi, nokuthi izimpande zangempela ze-1/x=0 ziyini ngempela.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-theorem ngesimo esithi "uma ..., bese ..." bese ubala ukuthi zingaki izimo ezilandela ngemva kwe-"uma."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi isizinda se-f(x)=1/x silahlekelwe yiphoyinti elithile phakathi kuka-−1 no-2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombile ukuthi u-x=0 ungaphakathi kwesikhala?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.0: I-Intermediate Value Theorem ingasetshenziswa kuphela uma i-f iqhubeka ku-[−1, 2]. Kodwa i-f(x)=1/x ayichazwanga ku-x=0, ngakho ayiqhubeki. Eqinisweni, akukho x ofeza i-1/x=0, ngakho ayikho impande yangempela.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.1: Ukusebenzisa i-theorem, umsebenzi kumele uqhubeke esikhaleni, kodwa i-1/x iyaphuka ku-x=0, ngakho ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa. Ngenxa yokuthi inombolo ephezulu ngu-1, akukho x lapho i-1/x iyi-0, ngakho lesi sibalo asinasixazululo.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.prompt: Gcina i-f(−1)<0<f(2) injengoba injalo. Khetha isimo okumele sengezwe ukuze kuphetheke ngokuqinisekile ukuthi i-f(x)=0 inempande esikhaleni (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi igrafu eziqhayisayo noma ephukayo ngaphakathi kwesikhala ingeqa u-0 ingadluli kuyo yini.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.1: Nquma ukuthi inketho ngayinye ikhuluma ngemiphetho noma ngesikhala sonke.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.a: Noma i-f iqhubeka kuphela ezinhlangothini ezimbili, ukuphuka maphakathi kwesikhala kungakwenza ushiye impande.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.b: Ukuthi amanani ayizinombolo eziphelele akunasixhumanisi nokuthi impande ikhona yini.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.c: i-f iqhubeka kuyo yonke iphoyinti lesikhala esivaliwe [−1, 2]
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.d: i-f(x) ayiyona i-0 ku-x ngamunye esikhaleni (−1, 2)
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.d: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ayikho impande, ngakho eqinisweni liphikisana nesiphetho.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.explain: I-Intermediate Value Theorem idinga ukuqhubeka kusikhala sonke esivaliwe. Ngalesi simo, u-0 kumele wenzeke phakathi kwamanani omkhawulo anezimpawu eziphikisanayo.

n-m-h2-limit-04.title: Umkhawulo womsebenzi oyinhlanganisela: ukuhlola isimangalo sikaMina
n-m-h2-limit-04.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: umkhawulo womsebenzi oyinhlanganisela
n-m-h2-limit-04.goal: Usebenzisa isibonelo, qinisekisa ukuthi umkhawulo womsebenzi oyinhlanganisela ushintsha kuye ngohlangothi lapho umsebenzi wangaphakathi usondela ku-0 khona, bese uchaza ukuthi isimangalo siyiqiniso noma asilona, unikeza izizathu.
n-m-h2-limit-04.material: Chaza umsebenzi f ngo-f(t)=1 (t>0), f(0)=0, f(t)=−1 (t<0). Njengoba t→0, umkhawulo wesobunxele −1 nomkhawulo wesokudla 1 wehlukile, ngakho umkhawulo we-f awukho. Cabanga ukuthi umsebenzi g usondela ku-0 njengoba x→0. UMina uthi, "Khona-ke umkhawulo womsebenzi oyinhlanganisela f(g(x)) njengoba x→0 nawo awukho." (Cabangela u-x kuphela onokuthi g(x)≠0.)
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.2: Ukuhlela ukuthi kufanele kubhekwe ini lapho kunqunywa ukuthi umkhawulo ukhona yini
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinketho ezilandelayo ze-g(x) lapho umkhawulo we-f(g(x)) njengoba x→0 ukhona.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-0.1, −0.1, 0.01, −0.01 esikhundleni sika-x bese ubheka uphawu lwe-g(x).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uphawu lwe-g(x) sesinqunyiwe, hlola ukuthi inani le-f(g(x)) linqunywa njengenani elilodwa yini.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.b: Uma x>0 bese g>0, futhi uma x<0 bese g<0, ngakho i-f(g(x)) iguqulana phakathi kuka-1 no-−1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.d: Uphawu luka-g lushintsha ngophawu luka-x, ngakho i-f(g(x)) iguqulana phakathi kuka-1 no-−1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.explain: g(x)=x² (x≠0) ihlala ilungile, ngakho f(g(x))=1 futhi umkhawulo ngu-1. g(x)=−x⁴ (x≠0) ihlala ingelona, ngakho f(g(x))=−1 futhi umkhawulo ngu-−1. x³ no-2x kushintsha uphawu, ngakho umkhawulo awukho.

n-m-h2-limit-05.material: Ku-f(x)=sin(π/x) (x≠0), ufuna ukuthola ukuthi i-f(x) isondela kunani luni njengoba x isondela ku-0 ngokungenamkhawulo. Engeza amanani kuthebula elilodwa ngesikhathi bese wenza isinqumo. (Sebenzisa i-sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, sin(3π/2)=−1.)

n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ukuthi amanani ahlala efana kuyinkomba yokuthi umkhawulo ukhona.

n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kungu-1: ngoba inani elibonwe ngokunjena ngu-1
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulandele inani lakamuva kuphela. U-0 obonwe ngaphambili naye uvela ku-x oseduze no-0, ngendlela efanayo.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kunzima ukusho ukuthi linani elilodwa: ngoba kuvele u-0 no-1 ku-x oseduze no-0
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ekugcineni, yini ongayisho ngomkhawulo we-f(x) njengoba x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuye ngokuthi u-x ukhethwa kanjani eduze no-0, i-f(x) ithatha amanani angu-0, 1, no-−1, ngakho ayikwazi ukuthiwa isondela kunani elilodwa. Umkhawulo awukho.

n-m-h2-limit-06.title: Ukubhala incazelo "yegrafu ephukile" ka-Seoyun
n-m-h2-limit-06.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: ukuqhubeka endaweni yomsebenzi
n-m-h2-limit-06.goal: Hlela ukuthi umbono wokuthi "igrafu ephukile isho ukunqamuka" ulungile nini nokuthi uyaphuthwa nini, bese uchaza kabusha ngamagama afanele umfowenu noma udadewenu osesikoleni esiphakathi, uxhumanisa nendawo yomsebenzi.
n-m-h2-limit-06.material: Umfowenu noma udadewenu osesikoleni esiphakathi uSeoyun uthe, "Igrafu ye-f(x)=1/x iphukile ku-x=0, ngakho ungumsebenzi onqamukayo. Umsebenzi oqhubekayo owodwa ongawudweba ungasisusanga usiba." Ufuna ukuchazela uSeoyun lapho lokhu kuphosa khona.
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.1: Ukuqonda ubuhlobo phakathi kokuphuka kwegrafu nendawo yomsebenzi
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha incazelo ukuze ifanele olalelayo
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha yonke imisebenzi elandelayo eqhubekayo kuyo yonke iphoyinti lendawo yayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale indawo yomsebenzi, bese usebenza ngalolu hlelo: kuphoyinti ngalinye endaweni, hlola ukuthi inani lomkhawulo lilingana nenani lomsebenzi yini.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sho ukuthi indawo lapho igrafu ibukeka iphukile iyiphoyinti elingaphakathi noma elingaphandle kwendawo yomsebenzi.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.r.d: Ku-x=0 umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-0, umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-1, futhi inani lomsebenzi lingu-1, ngakho umsebenzi awuqhubeki ku-x=0, iphoyinti elisendaweni.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.explain: Kuwo wonke amaphoyinti ka-x≠0, isisho eduze kwalelo phoyinti se-1/x no-x/|x| siyisisho esilula ku-x (1/x, noma amaconstant 1 no-−1), ngakho ziqhubeka kuphoyinti ngalinye lendawo. |x| iqhubeka kuyo yonke inombolo yangempela. k ayiqhubeki ku-x=0, okungowendawo, ngoba imikhawulo yayo yesobunxele neyesokudla iyahluka.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.prompt: Bhala incazelo ongayithumela kuSeoyun emshweni emi-3 kuya kwemi-4. USeoyun usesikoleni esiphakathi futhi angase ezwe amagama afana nokuthi "umkhawulo" na"indawo yomsebenzi" okokuqala. Kufanele ihlanganise ukuthi kungani ukuphuka kwe-1/x kungafani nokuba ngumsebenzi onqamukayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala, ngamagama uSeoyun angawaqonda, ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka u-x=0 ku-1/x.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi "igrafu iphukile" no"inani lizinda ngokuzumayo endaweni enenani" kusho into efanayo yini.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngamagama umfundi wesikole esiphakathi angawaqonda?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhombe isizathu sokuphuka ngokunembile (ngaphandle kwendawo yomsebenzi)?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.0: Seoyun, i-1/x ayinalo nhlobo inani ku-x=0, ngakho igrafu ibukeka iphukile lapho. Ukuqhubeka kubuza, kuphoyinti ngalinye elinenani, ukuthi inani liyaphuka eduze kwalelo phoyinti yini. Noma kuphi lapho i-1/x inenani ayiphuki, ngakho ungumsebenzi oqhubekayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.1: Awukwazi ukufaka u-0 ku-1/x, ngakho akukho phoyinti legrafu kuleyo ndawo nhlobo. Umsebenzi oqhubekayo ngumsebenzi onenani lomkhawulo elilingana nenani lomsebenzi kuwo wonke amaphoyinti achazwe kuwo, ngakho i-1/x, engaphuki emaphoyintini anamanani, nayo ingumsebenzi oqhubekayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.2: Seoyun, awukwazi ukufaka u-0 ku-1/x. Ngakho akukho phoyinti legrafu ku-x=0 nhlobo. Akukho kuphuka noma kuphi lapho igrafu idwetshiwe, ngakho ungumsebenzi oqhubekayo.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.3: Seoyun, awukwazi ukuhlukanisa ngo-0, akunjalo? Ngakho i-1/x ayidwetshwa nje ku-0. Lapho idwetshwe khona akukho kuphuka okuzumayo, ngakho siyibiza ngomsebenzi oqhubekayo.

n-m-h2-limit-07.title: Ukwakha wena ngokwakho ukuqhubeka kwesamba semisebenzi emibili
n-m-h2-limit-07.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: isamba semisebenzi eqhubekayo
n-m-h2-limit-07.goal: Hlola indlela yesici sokuthi isamba semisebenzi eqhubekayo siyaqhubeka, bese wakha wena ngokwakho ipheya yemisebenzi lapho isamba siqhubeka kodwa ngayinye ayiqhubeki, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
n-m-h2-limit-07.material: Wafunda ukuthi uma imisebenzi emibili u-f no-g iqhubeka ku-x=0, khona-ke u-f+g naye uqhubeka ku-x=0. Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi izinguqulo ezahlukene ezigudluzwe zalesi sici zonke ziyiqiniso yini.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.prompt: Kimisebenzi emibili u-f no-g, khetha konke okulandelayo okuhlala kuyiqiniso.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.0: Esitatimendeni ngasinye, hlukanisa ukucabanga nesiphetho, bese ukhomba ukuthi sinendlela efanayo nesici owasifunda noma siphambene.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ungahlola izitatimende eziphambene ngemisebenzi emibili elula yesinyathelo.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.a: Uma u-f no-g beqhubeka ku-x=0, khona-ke u-f+g uqhubeka ku-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.b: Uma u-f+g eqhubeka ku-x=0, khona-ke u-f no-g bobabili baqhubeka ku-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.b: Lesi yisimangalo sendlela ephambene. Cabanga ukuthi u-f no-g bangakwazi yini ukumboza ukunqamuka komunye nomunye.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.c: Uma u-f no-g bengaqhubeki ku-x=0, khona-ke u-f+g akaqhubeki ku-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.r.c: Cabanga ukuthi ukunqamuka okubili kungashabalala yini uma kuhlanganiswa.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.o.d: Uma u-f no-g beqhubeka ku-x=0, khona-ke u-f·g uqhubeka ku-x=0
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s1.explain: Isamba nomveli wemisebenzi eqhubekayo kuyaqhubeka, ngakho a no-d ziyiqiniso. Ku-b no-c, kunamacala lapho zingabambi khona. Ku-s2, zakhe wena izibonelo ezinjalo bese uhlola.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.prompt: Ngama-constant amabili u-p no-q, yakha imisebenzi f(x)=1 (x≥0), f(x)=p (x<0) no-g(x)=1 (x≥0), g(x)=q (x<0). Faka amapheya amabili ahlukile (p, q) lapho u-f no-g bobabili bengaqhubeki ku-x=0 kodwa u-f+g eqhubeka ku-x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala umkhawulo wesobunxele, umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi lika-f+g ku-x=0 ngo-p no-q.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ubuhlobo phakathi kuka-p no-q obenza wonke amanani amathathu alingane, bese ukhetha ipheya engenawo u-p=1 noma u-q=1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Umkhawulo wesobunxele ka-f+g uhluke enanini lomsebenzi.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.explain: Ku-x=0, umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi lika-f+g kungu-1+1=2, futhi umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-p+q. Ngakho u-f+g uqhubeka uma p+q=2. Uma p=1 noma q=1, omunye wemisebenzi usuqhubeka kakade, ngakho lawo ayasuswa.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza emshweni owodwa noma emibili ukuthi kungani u-f+g eqhubeka nakuba u-f no-g bengaqhubeki ngamunye.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala umehluko phakathi komkhawulo wesobunxele nenani lomsebenzi lika-f ku-x=0, nomehluko ofanayo ka-g.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka iziyo ezimbili.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale usayizi wokungafani komsebenzi ngamunye njengesisho?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubonise ukuthi ukungafani kuba ngu-0 uma kuhlanganiswa?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Ku-x=0, u-f weqa ngo-p−1 ezansi no-g ngo-q−1, kodwa uma behlanganiswa bayahambisana, ngakho umkhawulo wesobunxele ka-f+g ungu-2, futhi umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi nakho kungu-2, ngakho uyaqhubeka.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Ukufaka imikhawulo yesobunxele kunika p+q=2, ngakho umkhawulo wesobunxele, umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi lika-f+g konke kulingana no-2. Ukungafani kwemisebenzi emibili kuyahlangana bese kushabalala.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.prompt: Usebenzisa uhlaka olufanayo njengo-s2 (1 ku-x≥0, p noma q ku-x<0), ufuna ukwakha isibonelo lapho "umveli f·g uqhubeka ku-x=0 kodwa u-f no-g bobabili abaqhubeki." Yimuphi umgomo ofanele?
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala uthole umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi womveli f·g ku-x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala umkhawulo wesobunxele ngo-p no-q, bese wenza isibalo esithi silingana nenani langaphambilini.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.a: Ulande umgomo wesamba. Kumveli, umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-pq.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.c: Awuhlolanga ukuthi umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi lomveli kungu-1·1=1.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.r.d: p=q kuphela akunikezi pq=1. Isibonelo, uma p=q=2, khona-ke pq=4.
n-m-h2-limit-07.s.s3.explain: Ku-x=0, umkhawulo wesokudla nenani lomsebenzi lika-f·g kungu-1·1=1, futhi umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-pq. Ngakho uyaqhubeka uma pq=1. Uma p≠1, khona-ke q=1/p≠1, ngakho yomibili imisebenzi ayiqhubeki (isibonelo, p=2, q=1/2).

n-m-h2-limit-08.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo somkhawulo ohilela u-|x−1|
n-m-h2-limit-08.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: imikhawulo yezisho ezinamanani aphelele
n-m-h2-limit-08.goal: Qaphela ukuthi kufanele ucabangele izimpawu ngaphambi kokukhansela esishweni esinenani eliphelele, bese ulungisa isixazululo ngokuthola imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h2-limit-08.material: UHyunwoo wathola inani le-lim_{x→1} (x²−1)/|x−1| ngokulandelayo. (|x−1| yinani eliphelele lika-x−1.)

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.line.1: Ukukhansela u-x−1 kunani eliphezulu nesihlukanisi kunika u-x+1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho njengoba x→1, u-x+1 usondela ku-2.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 uyiphutha lokuqala. Isihlukanisi siyi-|x−1|, hhayi u-x−1, ngakho ku-x<1, |x−1|=−(x−1). Ngakho awukwazi nje ukukhansela u-x−1 esihlukanisini no-x−1 kunani eliphezulu. Imigqa 3 no-4 iyisiphumo sokulandela lesi sisho esingalungile.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa isixazululo sikaHyunwoo ngokuthola umkhawulo wesobunxele nomkhawulo wesokudla ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ku-x<1, khansela futhi wenze isisho sibe lula, bese uthola inani laso njengoba u-x esondela ku-1. Sebenzisa indlela efanayo ku-x>1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa amanani amabili bese uhlola ukuthi ahlangabezana nomgomo wokuthi umkhawulo ukhona yini.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale kabusha u-|x−1| ngokuhlukile ku-x<1 nasku-x>1?
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uphethe ngokuthi akukho mkhawulo ngoba imikhawulo emibili iyahluka?
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.model.0: Uma x>1, khona-ke |x−1|=x−1, ngakho ukukhansela kunika u-x+1, futhi umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-2. Uma x<1, khona-ke |x−1|=−(x−1), ngakho kuba ngu-−(x+1), futhi umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-−2. Imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla iyahluka, ngakho umkhawulo awukho.

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.prompt: Khetha esisodwa kulokhu okulandelayo esinomkhawulo okhona njengoba x→1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.0: Enkethweni ngayinye, qala uhlole ukuthi isisho esingaphakathi kwenani eliphelele sishintsha uphawu eduze kuka-x=1 yini.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi, uma uphawu lungashintshi, ungasisusa nje yini isiphawu senani eliphelele.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.a: Lesi yisisho esivela enkingeni esebenzisiwe. Imikhawulo yesobunxele neyesokudla iyahluka.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.c: Eduze kuka-x=1, u-x+1 uyipositive, ngakho |x²−1|=|x−1|(x+1), futhi umkhawulo wesobunxele ungu-−2 kanti owesokudla ungu-2, ohlukile.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.d: Inani eliphezulu lisondela ku-2 kanti isihlukanisi sisondela ku-0, ngakho ku-x>1 likhula ngaphandle komkhawulo kanti ku-x<1 lehla ngaphandle komkhawulo. Umkhawulo awukho.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.explain: Eduze kuka-x=1, x+1>0, ngakho |x+1|=x+1, futhi (x²−1)/|x+1|=x−1, ngakho umkhawulo ungu-0. Okubalulekile ukuthi isisho esingaphakathi kwenani eliphelele sishintsha uphawu eduze kuka-1 yini.

n-m-h2-limit-09.title: Ukungalingani nemikhawulo: ukuhlola isimangalo ka-Ayun
n-m-h2-limit-09.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: ubudlelwano bokulandelana bemikhawulo
n-m-h2-limit-09.goal: Sebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo ukubona ukuthi kwenzekani ekungalingani okuqinile uma uthatha imikhawulo, bese uchaza ukuthi isimangalo siyiqiniso noma amanga nokuthi siyini isiphetho esilungile.
n-m-h2-limit-09.material: U-Ayun uthi lokhu okulandelayo. "Uma f(x)<g(x) kuwo wonke ama-x(≠0) aseduze no-x=0 futhi yomibili imikhawulo lim f(x) no-lim g(x) ikhona, khona-ke imikhawulo nayo iyanelisa lim f(x) < lim g(x). Ukungalingani kuhlala kunjalo."
n-m-h2-limit-09.thinking.1: Ukuchaza ukuthi kungani ukungalingani kuba buthaka
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ipheya (f, g) esebenza njengesibonelo esiphikisayo esibonisa ukuthi isimangalo sika-Ayun singamanga. (njengoba x→0)

n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.b: Inelisa ukucabanga futhi imikhawulo inelisa −1<1, okuvumelana nesimangalo sika-Ayun, ngakho asisona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.r.d: x<x+1 iyabamba futhi imikhawulo inelisa 0<1, okuvumelana nesimangalo sika-Ayun, ngakho asisona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s1.explain: f(x)=0 no-g(x)=x² banelisa f(x)<g(x) ku-x≠0, kodwa yomibili imikhawulo ilingana no-0. Kunelisa ukucabanga futhi kuhluleka esiphethweni, ngakho siyisibonelo esiphikisayo.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kwenzekani, emkhawulweni, ekungalinganini f(x)<g(x) njengoba u-x esondela ku-0. Chaza futhi emshweni owodwa, usebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo, ukuthi kungani lokho kwenzeka.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa isibonelo esiphikisayo owasikhetha ku-s1, bhala ukuthi kwenzekani ku-g(x)−f(x) njengoba u-x esondela ku-0.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kwenzekani ebudlelwaneni bokulandelana bemikhawulo emibili uma lowo mehluko uba mncane ngokungenamkhawulo.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho emshweni ukuthi ukungalingani kushintsha kanjani?

n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s2.model.1: Ukuthatha imikhawulo kungenza ilingane. Isibonelo, u-0 uhlala ungaphansi kuka-x², kodwa zombili zinomkhawulo ongu-0.
