n-m-h2-limit-10.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo sokuthola u-a ukuze g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) iqhubeke
n-m-h2-limit-10.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: ukuqhubeka komsebenzi womveli
n-m-h2-limit-10.goal: Thola futhi ulungise isixazululo esishiya icala elikhethekile lapho amaphoyinti amabili okunqamuka evumelana, bese uhlola ukuthi kungani umsebenzi uqhubeka lapho evumelana.
n-m-h2-limit-10.material: Kumsebenzi f(x)=x+2 (x<0), f(x)=x−2 (x≥0), inkinga ukuthola wonke amanani e-constant a ukuze g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) iqhubeke kuwo wonke inombolo yangempela u-x. Bheka isixazululo sika-Eunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.thinking.0: Ukuthola lokho isixazululo esikuthathile njengokumisiwe ngaphandle kokukusho
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sika-Eunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ngomugqa ngamunye, thola lokho isixazululo esikuthatha njengokumisiwe ngamaphoyinti amabili u-0 no-a.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.1: Zama amanani akhethekile ka-a futhi uhlole ukuthi izisho zesixazululo zisasebenza yini.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.0: U-f(x) akaqhubeki ku-x=0 kuphela, futhi u-f(x−a) akaqhubeki ku-x=a kuphela.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.1: Ukuze u-g aqhubeke ku-x=0, sidinga u-f(−a)=0, ngakho a=2 noma a=−2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.2: Ukuze u-g aqhubeke ku-x=a, sidinga u-f(a)=0, ngakho a=2 noma a=−2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 ngumsebenzi wokuqala ongalungile. "Ukuze u-g aqhubeke ku-x=0, sidinga u-f(−a)=0" kuyiqiniso kuphela uma u-f(x−a) eqhubeka eduze no-x=0. Uma a=0, bese u-f(x−a)=f(x) naye akaqhubeki ku-x=0, ngakho lesi sitatimende asisebenzi. Umugqa 3 uthatha ukucabanga okufanayo, futhi umugqa 4 ngumphumela.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.prompt: Thola inani elilahlekile ka-a esixazululweni sika-Eunwoo, futhi uhlole ukuthi u-g empeleni uqhubeka kulelo nani usebenzisa umkhawulo wesokunxele, umkhawulo wesokudla, nenani lomsebenzi. Ekugcineni, bhala wonke amanani ka-a.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.0: Phula ukucabanga ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi: bhala ukuthi yiluphi u-a owenza u-0 no-a babe yiphoyinti elifanayo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kulowo u-a, bhala kabusha u-g njengenkulumo, bese uthola futhi uqhathanise umkhawulo wawo wesokunxele, umkhawulo wesokudla, nenani lomsebenzi ku-x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ubhale u-g njengenkulumo ethile uma a=0?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uthole umkhawulo wesokunxele, umkhawulo wesokudla, nenani lomsebenzi?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.0: Uma a=0, amaphoyinti amabili okungaqhubeki ahlangana ephoyinteni e-1 u-x=0, futhi u-g(x)=f(x)·f(x). Ku-x=0 umkhawulo wesokunxele ungu-2²=4, umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-(−2)²=4, futhi u-g(0)=4, ngakho u-g uyaqhubeka. Ngakho impendulo ngu-a=−2, 0, 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.1: Isixazululo sithathe ukuthi amaphoyinti okungaqhubeki u-0 no-a ahlukile. Uma a=0, bese u-g uyisikwele sika-f(x), futhi umkhawulo wesokunxele u-4, umkhawulo wesokudla u-4, nenani lomsebenzi u-4 ayalingana, ngakho u-g uyaqhubeka. Ngakho a=−2, 0, 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.prompt: Khetha isizathu esingcono sokuthi kungani u-g(x)=f(x)f(x) eqhubeka ku-x=0 uma a=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala umkhawulo wesokunxele, umkhawulo wesokudla, nenani lomsebenzi luka-f ku-x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ukuthi la manani amathathu ashintsha kanjani uma wenza isikwele.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.a: Ngoba imikhawulo yesokunxele neyesokudla luka-f ihluka ngophawu kuphela, ngakho iba alingana uma yenziwa isikwele
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.b: Ngoba imikhawulo yesokunxele neyesokudla luka-f iyinani elifanayo
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.b: Ku-x=0, u-f unomkhawulo wesokunxele engu-2 nomkhawulo wesokudla engu-−2, ahlukile.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.d: Ngoba ukwenza isikwele nanoma yimuphi umsebenzi kuwenza uhlale uqhubeka
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.d: Kunemisebenzi engaqhubeki uma yenziwe isikwele. Isibonelo: umkhawulo wesokunxele u-2, umkhawulo wesokudla u-3.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.explain: Ku-x=0, umkhawulo wesokunxele luka-f ungu-2, umkhawulo wesokudla ungu-−2, futhi u-f(0)=−2. Ukwenza isikwele kwenza umkhawulo wesokunxele ube ngu-4, umkhawulo wesokudla ube ngu-4, nenani lomsebenzi libe ngu-4, konke kulingana, ngakho kuyaqhubeka. Ukungaqhubeki kunyamalala ngokwenziwa isikwele kuphela uma izinhlangothi ezimbili zihluka ngophawu nje.

n-m-h2-limit-11.title: Ingabe kukhona isikhathi esifanayo nendawo efanayo? Inkinga yomgwaqo wentaba
n-m-h2-limit-11.topic: Imikhawulo nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi: ukusebenzisa i-Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-11.goal: Chaza wena umsebenzi omusha oqhathanisa izimo ezimbili, usebenzise i-Intermediate Value Theorem ukukhombisa ukuba khona, futhi uhlole isimo itiyori eside sidinga (ukuqhubeka).
n-m-h2-limit-11.material: Umuntu uqala ngezansi kwentaba ngo-8 ekuseni futhi ufika esicongweni ngo-6 ntambama ngomgwaqo ofanayo. Ngakusasa umuntu uqala esicongweni ngo-8 ekuseni futhi ufika ezansi kwentaba ngo-6 ntambama ngomgwaqo ofanayo. Ezinsukwini zombili umuntu angaphumula noma ashintshe isivinini endleleni, kodwa kunomgwaqo o-1 kuphela. Ake u-u(t) abe yindawo ngosuku lokuqala ngesikhathi u-t no-d(t) abe yindawo ngosuku lwesibili, lapho indawo ikalwa ibanga elisuka ezansi kwentaba (0 ezansi, u-D esicongweni). Ingabe kufanele kube khona isikhathi lapho umuntu useqhelweni elifanayo ezinsukwini zombili?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukuguqula "indawo efanayo ngesikhathi esifanayo" ibe yisibalo futhi usebenzise i-Intermediate Value Theorem. Ngumuphi walowa msebenzi omusha ofanelekile?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala umcimbi ofuna ukuwuthola njengesibalo esithi "u-u(t) ulingana no-d(t)."
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.1: Thola, phakathi kwezinketho, indlela yokuguqula lesi sibalo sibe yifomu elithi "umsebenzi othile = 0."
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.a: Ku-t=8 no-t=18 inani lingu-D kokubili, ngakho akukho shintsho lophawu.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.c: U-h(t)=0 wenzeka uma oyedwa wabo bobabili engu-0, okungasho ukuthi izindawo ezimbili ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.d: Kunezikhathi lapho u-d(t)=0, ngakho akuchazwanga, futhi uma kulingana inani lingu-1 nje, hhayi u-0.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.explain: Indawo efanayo isho u-u(t)=d(t), okungukuthi, u-u(t)−d(t)=0. Uma sibeka u-h(t)=u(t)−d(t), bese h(8)=0−D<0 no-h(18)=D−0>0, ngakho izimpawu ziphambene.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa u-h, bhala incazelo yokuthi kungani kufanele kube khona isikhathi lapho umuntu useqhelweni elifanayo ezinsukwini zombili. Faka amanani ka-h eziphetheni ezimbili zesikhawu, isizathu sokuthi u-h angathathwa njengoqhubekayo, nethiyori oyisebenzisayo.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala amanani ka-u no-d ngesikhathi sokuqala nangesikhathi sokugcina, futhi uthole amanani ka-h.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.1: Ukusebenzisa ithiyori ku-h, sho emagameni ukuthi indawo kufanele ishintshe kanjani ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.model.0: Ake u-h(t)=u(t)−d(t). Bese h(8)=0−D=−D<0 no-h(18)=D−0=D>0. Umuntu akathuthuki ngokuphazima, ngakho indawo ishintsha ngaphandle kwezikhala, futhi u-u, d, no-h baqhubeka. Nge-Intermediate Value Theorem kukhona u-c onu-h(c)=0, futhi bese u-u(c)=d(c).
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.model.1: Ukubeka u-h=u−d, kuyinani elinegethivu u-−D ekuqaleni futhi inani eliphozithivu u-D ekugcineni. Indawo ishintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngaphandle kwezikhala, ngakho u-h uwumsebenzi oqhubekayo, futhi nge-Intermediate Value Theorem kukhona u-c phakathi kuka-8 no-18 onu-h(c)=0, ngakho kukhona isikhathi lapho umuntu useqhelweni elifanayo ngesikhathi esifanayo.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi ngosuku lokuqala umuntu wasebenzisa idivayisi ethuthela ngokuzumayo endaweni yesicongo ngesikhathi esithile (ngakho indawo ishintsha ngesikhala). Singasasho yini ukuthi kufanele kube khona isikhathi esiseqhelweni elifanayo ngesikhathi esifanayo?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi igrafu ka-h(t) ibukeka kanjani uma indawo igxuma.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi, uma igrafu igxuma, ingagxuma ngaphezu kuka-0 ngaphandle kokudlula kuwo noma izimpawu eziphetheni ezimbili ziphambene yini.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.a: Yebo: ngoba izimpawu eziphambene zika-h eziphetheni ezimbili zihlala zanele
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.a: Izimpawu zodwa azanele. Uma ukuqhubeka kuphuka, ithiyori ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.b: Cha: ngoba ngosuku lokuthuthelwa, umuntu akakwazi ukufinyelela endaweni efanayo
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.b: Akukho sisekelo sokusho ukuthi akakwazi ukufinyelela endaweni efanayo. Bangase bahlangane noma kunjalo.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.c: Akunakushiwo ukuthi kufanele kube khona oyedwa: ngoba uma ukuqhubeka kuphuka, i-Intermediate Value Theorem ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.d: Yebo: ngoba umuntu uhambe isikhathi esilingana ezinsukwini zombili
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.d: Ukuthi isikhathi esithathiwe sifana akunakho ukuxhumana okuqondile nokuba khona kwendawo evamile.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.explain: Ukuze ithiyori iqinisekise, u-h kufanele aqhubeke. Uma indawo igxuma, u-h ungagxuma ngaphezu kuka-0. Isibonelo, uma ngosuku lokuqala indawo igxuma isuka ku-0 iye ku-D futhi ngosuku lwesibili igxuma isuka ku-D iye ku-0 ngasikhathi sinye, izindawo ezimbili zingase zingalingani nanini.

n-m-h2-trig-06.title: Ukwenza unxantathu onezinhlangothi ezigcwele nengeli e-1 engu-60°
n-m-h2-trig-06.goal: Sebenzisa u-cos60°=1/2 emthethweni we-cosine ukumisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinhlangothi zikanxantathu onengeli engu-60°, futhi wakhe onxantathu abangafani abanamanani obude bezinhlangothi onke ayizinombolo ezigcwele.
n-m-h2-trig-06.material: Kunxantathu u-ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB futhi ∠C=60°. Ufuna ukwakha unxantathu onobude bezinhlangothi ezintathu bonke bayizinombolo zemvelo.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha ubudlelwano obulungile phakathi kuka-a, b, c uma ∠C=60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala umthetho we-cosine njengoba unjalo, bese ufaka inani lika-cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.1: Faka u-a=b=c=1 (unxantathu olinganayo) esibalweni ngasinye ukuhlola ukuthi siphi esilungile.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.a: Ku-−2ab cosC womthetho we-cosine, uthathe u-cos60° njengo-1. Hlola futhi inani lika-cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.b: Uphawu lwabhalwa ngokuphambene. Cabanga ukuthi iyiphi ingeli enika lolu phawu.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.c: Ufake u-cos60°=1/2 ku-−2ab cosC futhi wabala.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.d: Wabhale ubudlelwano bukanxantathu oqondile. Hlola ukuthi u-∠C uyingeli elungile yini.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.explain: Umthetho we-cosine ngu-c²=a²+b²−2ab cosC futhi cos60°=1/2, ngakho c²=a²+b²−ab. Uma uphawu lwalungu-+ab, bese u-∠C=120°, futhi uma c²=a²+b², bese u-∠C=90°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.prompt: Yenza onxantathu abangu-2 abangafani abanu-∠C=60° futhi zonke izinhlangothi ezintathu ziyizinombolo zemvelo (ngu-40 ubuningi), futhi ufake u-a, b, c. (Khipha unxantathu olinganayo, u-a no-b akumele babe nesihlukanisi esivamile ngaphandle kuka-1, futhi onxantathu abahluka ngokushintshanisa u-a no-b kuphela babalwa njengonxantathu ofanayo.)
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha u-a o-1 bese ushintsha u-b abe ngu-1, 2, 3, ... ngenkathi ubala u-a²+b²−ab.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi umphumela uyisikwele senombolo yemvelo ethile yini.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Izinombolo ezintathu ziyizinombolo zemvelo ezingu-40 ubuningi.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Izinombolo ezintathu kufanele zibe yizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-40.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c2: U-c² akalingani no-a²+b²−ab, ngakho u-∠C akangu-60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Uma a=b, unxantathu ulinganayo. Onxantathu abalinganayo bayakhishwa.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Isihlukanisi esivamile sika-a no-b ngu-1 kuphela.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c4: U-a no-b banesihlukanisi esivamile esikhulu kuno-1, ngakho lona unxantathu ofanayo okhuliswe kunxantathu omncane.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala emisho eyodwa noma emibili ukuthi uthole kanjani lowo nxantathu.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Lungisa inani elilodwa luka-a, bese ucabanga ukuthi lithini inani olibalile ngenkathi ushintsha u-b.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sho ukuthi leli nani kufanele libe yinombolo yini ukuze libe ngu-c².
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Uhlole ukuthi inani elibaliwe liyisikwele esigcwele yini?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Ngilungise u-a=3 futhi ngabala u-a²+b²−ab ngenkathi ngishintsha u-b. Uma b=8, kwakungu-49, inombolo yesikwele. Ngakho c=7.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngifake u-a no-b ngokulandelana ebudlelwaneni u-c²=a²+b²−ab futhi ngafuna amacala lapho umphumela uyisikwele esigcwele.

n-m-h2-trig-08.title: Ukuphakama kwenqaba ebonwa kumaphoyinti amabili
n-m-h2-trig-08.goal: Qonda ukuthi ukuba nengeli nebanga akusho ukuthi kunenani elilodwa kuphela: sebenza izilungiselelo ezimbili ezingenzeka ngokubala, bese ubhala kabusha inkinga ngesimo esinquma elilodwa kuphela.
n-m-h2-trig-08.material: Inqaba imi emhlabathini othe xaxa. Isisekelo senqaba u-P namaphoyinti u-A no-B asemgqeni o-1, futhi AB=20 m. Ingeli yokukhuphuka iye phezulu kwenqaba ingu-30° kusukela ku-A no-45° kusukela ku-B. Ungananaza ukuphakama kwamehlo. USeoyun uthe, "Sinazo zombili izingeli nebanga, ngakho ukuphakama kwenqaba kunqunywa ngokukhethekile," futhi uHajun wathi, "Kungacatshangwa ngenye indlela."
n-m-h2-trig-08.thinking.0: Wahlulele ukuthi mingaki impendulo olunqunywa ulwazi olunikeziwe
n-m-h2-trig-08.prereq.1: Ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphakama nebanga kunxantathu oqondile
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isinqumo esilungile mayelana nokuthi isitatimende sikabani esiyiso.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba zonke izilungiselelo ezingenzeka uma u-A, B, no-P besemgqeni o-1.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.1: Kusilungiselelo ngasinye, hlola ukuthi ungakwazi ukuveza amabanga asuka ku-P aya ku-A nasuka ku-P aya ku-B ngokuya ngokuphakama u-h yini.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.a: USeoyun: Kunezingeli ezimbili zokukhuphuka nebanga, ngakho ukuphakama kunqunywa ngokuqinisekile ngokukhethekile
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.a: Noma kubonakala sengathi kunolwazi oluningi, kufanele uhlole ngokwehlukana ukuthi umumo unqunywa ngokukhethekile yini.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.b: UHajun: Asazi ibanga eliya esisekelweni senqaba, ngakho ukuphakama akunqunywa nganoma yiluphi uhlobo
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.b: Lokhu kukhuluma ngokweqile ukuthi akunqunywa. Bala ukuthi izingeli zikuvumela yini ukunciphisa ibe ibanga elilodwa.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.c: UHajun: Ukuphakama kuhluka kuye ngokuthi amaphoyinti amabili asohlangothini olufanayo noma ezinhlangothini eziphambene zesisekelo senqaba
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.c: Ukhombe ukuthi isitatimende esinikeziwe asinquni isilungiselelo ngokukhethekile.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.d: USeoyun: Izingeli ezimbili zokukhuphuka ziyahluka, ngakho u-A no-B ngokuqinisekile basezinhlangothini eziphambene zesisekelo senqaba
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.d: Wenze isiphetho sezindawo kusuka eqinisweni lokuthi izingeli ziyahluka. Cabanga ukuthi, noma ohlangothini olufanayo, iphoyinti eliseduze libona phezulu ngengeli enkulu yini.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.explain: Uma bohlangothini olufanayo, ingeli yokukhuphuka esuka ephoyinteni eliseduze u-B (45°) inkulu, futhi noma bezinhlangothini eziphambene, izingeli zingabhekwa njengo-30° no-45°. Izimo ezimbili ziyenzeka futhi ukuphakama kuyahluka nakho (kubalwe esinyathelweni esilandelayo), ngakho inkinga kufanele isho isilungiselelo e-1. Lokho akusho ukuthi ukubala akunakwenzeka. Uma isilungiselelo sinqunyiwe, ukuphakama kuyanqunywa.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.prompt: Ake ukuphakama kube ngu-h. Thola ① ukuphakama u-h1 uma u-A no-B bohlangothini olufanayo lwesisekelo u-P, no-② ukuphakama u-h2 uma u-P ephakathi kuka-A no-B (ezinhlangothini eziphambene), futhi ufake ngamunye ngamadesimali amabili. (ku-m)
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuphakama njengo-h futhi uveze u-PA no-PB ngokuya ngo-h usebenzisa onxantathu abaqondile.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi umehluko wamabanga amabili ungu-20 uma bohlangothini olufanayo, futhi isamba singu-20 uma bezinhlangothini eziphambene.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Ohlangothini olufanayo, PA−PB=20. Misa isibalo ngo-PA=√3·h no-PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Ezinhlangothini eziphambene, PA+PB=20. Misa isibalo ngo-PA=√3·h no-PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.explain: Uma ingeli esuka ku-A ingu-30°, PA=h÷tan30°=√3·h, futhi uma ingeli esuka ku-B ingu-45°, PB=h. Ohlangothini olufanayo, PA−PB=20, ngakho h=20÷(√3−1)=10(√3+1)≈27.32. Ezinhlangothini eziphambene, PA+PB=20, ngakho h=20÷(√3+1)=10(√3−1)≈7.32.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha lenkinga ngokwengeza umusho owodwa kuphela ukuze ukuphakama kunqunywe ngokukhethekile.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula futhi ukuthi zingaki izilungiselelo ezazingenzeka.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala umusho o-1 okhetha esisodwa kuzo.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ufunde umusho owengeziwe ukuhlola ukuthi unquma isilungiselelo ngokukhethekile?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usho ubudlelwano bezindawo ba-A, B, no-P?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.0: Engeza umusho o-1 othi u-A no-B bohlangothini olufanayo lwesisekelo u-P senqaba.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.1: Isisekelo senqaba u-P siphakathi kuka-A no-B.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.3: Sitshelwa ukuthi ibanga elisuka ku-A liya esisekelweni senqaba u-P lingu-20√3 m.

n-m-h2-integ-06.title: Ukuthola yonke imigqa ehlanganisa indawo efanayo ne-parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.topic: Indawo phakathi kwe-parabola nomugqa: uphawu nokuhlukanisa ngenhla naphansi
n-m-h2-integ-06.goal: Qonda ukuthi kufanele ukhiphe inkulumo engezansi enkulumweni engenhla ukuthola indawo, nokuthi icala le-slope enegethivu kufanele liphathwe ngendlela efanayo, futhi uthole yonke imigqa efinyelela isimo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.material: Kunei-parabola u-y=x² nomugqa u-y=mx odlula kumvelaphi (m≠0, u-m uyinombolo egcwele). Amagrafu amabili ahlangana ku-x=0 no-x=m. Ake u-S(m) abe yindawo yesifunda esizunguzwe.
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuthi yiliphi eliphezulu nesikhawu, usebenzisa igrafu
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.1: Ukuhlola isiqondiso se-definite integral (umkhawulo ophansi, umkhawulo ophezulu) nophawu
n-m-h2-integ-06.prereq.1: Indawo phakathi kwamakhebula amabili (inkulumo engenhla − inkulumo engezansi)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha inkulumo elungile ye-definite integral ye-S(−2) uma u-m=−2.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.0: Uma m=−2, dweba amagrafu amabili futhi uqale ngokumaka ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti amabili okuhlangana nokuthi yiliphi igrafu eliphezulu phakathi kwawo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi kwenzekani enanini le-definite integral uma umkhawulo ophansi mkhulu kunomkhawulo ophezulu noma uma i-integrand inegethivu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.a: ∫₀^{−2}(−2x−x²)dx: hlanganisa kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-−2, ukhiphe inkulumo engezansi enkulumweni engenhla
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.a: Umkhawulo ophansi (0) mkhulu kunomkhawulo ophezulu (−2), ngakho uphawu lwenani luyajika. Indawo ayikwazi ukuba nenegethivu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.b: ∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx: hlanganisa kusuka ku-−2 kuya ku-0, ukhiphe inkulumo engezansi enkulumweni engenhla
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.b: Leli yifomu elilungile, lisuka ekugcineni kwesokunxele liye ekugcineni kwesokudla futhi libhale inkulumo engenhla − inkulumo engezansi.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.c: ∫_{−2}^{0}(x²+2x)dx: hlanganisa kusuka ku-−2 kuya ku-0, ukhiphe inkulumo yomugqa enkulumweni ye-parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.c: Kulesi sikhawu umugqa uphezu kwe-parabola. Uma ukhipha inkulumo engenhla enkulumweni engezansi, inani linegethivu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.d: ∫₀²(−2x−x²)dx: hlanganisa kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-2, ukhiphe inkulumo ye-parabola enkulumweni yomugqa
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.d: Uma m=−2, amagrafu amabili ahlangana ku-x=0 no-x=−2. Isikhawu asikho ohlangothini lwesokudla lwe-x-axis.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.explain: Uma m=−2, amagrafu amabili ahlangana ku-x=−2 no-x=0, futhi ku-−2<x<0 umugqa u-y=−2x uphezu kwe-parabola u-y=x². Ngakho S(−2)=∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx=4/3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka izinombolo ezigcwele ezimbili ezihlukile u-m ukuze u-S(m)=9/2. (−30≤m≤30, m≠0)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.0: Uma u-m eyiphozithivu, qala ngokuthola u-S(m) njengenkulumo ka-m.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.1: Uma u-m enegethivu, dweba igrafu futhi uqhathanise ukuthi uthola inkulumo efanayo yini.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c1: U-m kufanele abe yinombolo egcwele engeyona u-0 kusuka ku-−30 kuya ku-30.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c2: U-S(m) akangu-9/2. Qala ngokuthola u-S(m) njengenkulumo ka-m ku-m>0.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.explain: Uma m>0, S(m)=∫₀ᵐ(mx−x²)dx=m³/6. Uma m<0, ucabanga ngokulinganisa nge-y-axis ngo-−m=|m|, S(m)=|m|³/6. Ngakho |m|³=27, okungukuthi, m=3 noma m=−3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani umfundi othole inani e-1 ku-m>0 angacabanga ukuthi kukhona omunye umugqa onendawo efanayo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.0: Dweba amagrafu ka-m=3 no-m=−3 epulaneni elifanayo lamakhodi futhi ubone ukuthi ahlobana kanjani.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi i-axis yokulinganisa ye-parabola u-y=x² iyini.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Usho ukuthi kwenzekani endaweni uma igrafu ijikiswa nge-y-axis?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Usho ukuthi indawo iphozithivu noma uphawu lwe-slope luhlukile?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.0: Uma ubonisa isimo esizunguzwe ngu-y=x² nomugqa u-y=3x nge-y-axis, uthola isimo esizunguzwe ngu-y=x² no-y=−3x. Isimo nosayizi kuyafana, ngakho indawo iyafana, futhi u-m=−3 uyimpendulo nawo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.1: Noma i-slope inegethivu, indawo iphozithivu. Indawo inqunywa inani eliphelele luka-m, njengo-|m|³/6, ngakho u-m=3 no-m=−3 banika indawo efanayo.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.2: I-parabola ilinganisa nge-y-axis, ngakho ukushintsha kuphela uphawu lwe-slope yomugqa kujika nje isimo kusuka kwesokunxele kuya kwesokudla futhi kushiye usayizi wawo unjalo. Ngakho i-slope enegethivu u-−3 nayo iyenzeka.

n-m-h2-trig-01.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esathola ukuthi igrafu yahanjiswa kangakanani
n-m-h2-trig-01.goal: Esixazululweni esithola ukuthi igrafu yesimo y=a sin(bx−c) ihanjiswe kangakanani isuka kugrafu ye-y=a sin bx, thola ulungise umugqa onephutha, bese uhlola inani elilungisiwe ngqo.
n-m-h2-trig-01.material: UJiyun uxazulule ukuthi igrafu ye-y=2sin(3x−π/2) iyigrafu ye-y=2sin3x ehanjisiwe kanjani, ngezansi. (π ngu-pi futhi ama-engeli aku-radians. 2sin3x kusho u-2 ephindwe ngo-sine ka-3x.)
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.0: Ukulandela isixazululo umugqa nomugqa ukuze uthole umugqa onephutha
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.1: Ukukhipha i-coefficient ka-x ukuze ufunde ukuhanjiswa
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.0: Isikhathi nenani elikhulu nelincane le-y=a sin bx
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa igrafu ohlangothini lwe-x kusho ukushintsha u-x ngo-x−m
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ongalungile esixazululweni sikaJiyun.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola umugqa nomugqa ukuthi ngabe umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngempela emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.1: Vula isisho esikhishiwe ngezinto futhi ngomthetho we-distributive bese usiqhathanisa nesisho ngaphambi kokukhipha izinto.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.1: Inani elikhulu kakhulu li-2 futhi elincane kakhulu li-−2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho le grafu iyigrafu ye-y=2sin3x eyathuthwa nge-π/2 ohlangothini lwe-x.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa we-3 awulungile. Ukwandisa u-3(x−π/2) kunika u-3x−3π/2, ohluke ku-3x−π/2. Njengoba 3x−π/2=3(x−π/6), ukuthuthwa kungu-π/6. Umugqa we-4 uyisiphetho esilandela umphumela ongalungile womugqa we-3, futhi imigqa ye-1 ne-2 ilungile.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umugqa ongalungile bese ubhala indlela nenani elilungile lokuthuthwa, kanye nendlela eyodwa owahlola ngayo ukuthi inani lilungile.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kusukela ku-3x−π/2, cabanga ukuthi iyiphi inombolo okufanele ibe phambi kwamabhulakethe ukuze kwakheke u-x−(ukuthuthwa).
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.1: Wandisa isisho esibhalwe ngokuthuthwa owakuthola bese uhlola ukuthi siba ngu-3x−π/2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: uma wenza izinto ze-3x−π/2 njengo-..., uthola ...
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uwandise wena ngokwakho isisho esilungisiwe?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ungasho ukuthi kungani kufanele wenze izinto ngo-3?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.0: Ku-3x−π/2, qala ukhiphe u-3 ukuze uthole u-3(x−π/6). Ngakho u-y=2sin3x wathuthelwa kwesokudla ngo-π/6. Ukuhlola: ukwandisa u-3(x−π/6) kunika u-3x−π/2, okufana nesisho sokuqala.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.1: Kufanele ukhiphe i-coefficient 3 ka-x ukuze uthole isimo u-x−(ukuthuthwa). Njengoba π/2÷3=π/6, kuwukuthuthwa nge-π/6 ohlangothini oluyipositive lwe-x. Ukufaka u-x=π/6 kunika u-3x−π/2=0, ngakho sin0=0, okuhambisana no-y=2sin3x ongu-0 ku-x=0.

n-m-h2-trig-02.title: Siyisiphi isikhawu esifushane kakhulu lapho u-sin²x uphinda khona?
n-m-h2-trig-02.goal: Hlola isimangalo esithi "isikhathi sijikelezo sika-sin x singu-2π, ngakho u-sin²x naye unesikhathi sijikelezo esingu-2π" ngokuhlola isibalo sesikhawu sokuphinda, bese usho isikhathi sijikelezo esincane kakhulu esiyipositive ngezizathu.
n-m-h2-trig-02.material: USeoyeon uthe, "Isikhathi sijikelezo sika-sin x singu-2π, ngakho isikhathi sijikelezo sika-y=sin²x naso singu-2π," futhi uMinho wathi, "Leso asisona isikhawu esifushane kakhulu." Lapha, isikhathi sijikelezo sisho u-p omncane kakhulu oyipositive lapho f(x+p)=f(x) ibambe kuwo wonke u-x. (sin²x isikwele sika-sin x.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa isikhawu esiphindayo nesikhawu esincane kakhulu
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izitatimende ezilungile mayelana no-f(x)=sin²x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.0: Esitatimendeni ngasinye, faka amanani athile afana no-0 noma u-π/2 esikhundleni sika-x bese uqhathanisa ukuthi izinhlangothi ezimbili ziyalingana yini.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qala ubhale ukuthi sin(x+π) uhlobene kanjani no-sin x, bese ubheka ukuthi kwenzekani uma ukwenza isikwele.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.a: Isikhathi sijikelezo sika-sin x singu-2π, ngakho isikhawu esifushane kakhulu lapho u-sin²x uphinda khona kufanele nakho kube ngu-2π
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuthatha isikhathi sijikelezo somsebenzi wokuqala njengesikhawu esifushane kakhulu somsebenzi omusha. Hlola ukuthi ukwenza isikwele kususa uphawu.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.b: Kuwo wonke u-x, sin²(x+π)=sin²x, ngakho ngemva kokuthuthela nge-π igrafu iphinda ngesimo esifanayo
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.b: Lesi yisinqumo esenziwe ngemva kokubhala ukuthi sin(x+π) uhlobene kanjani no-sin x nokubheka umphumela osikwele.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.c: Kuwo wonke u-x, sin²(x+π/2)=sin²x, ngakho ngemva kokuthuthela nge-π/2 igrafu iphinda ngesimo esifanayo
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.c: Awuhlolanga ngokufaka amanani athile ka-x. Isibonelo, bala izinhlangothi zombili ku-x=0.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.d: Kuwo wonke u-x, sin²(x+2π)=sin²x, ngakho ngemva kokuthuthela nge-2π igrafu iphinda ngesimo esifanayo
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.d: Awuphuthelwanga ukuthi u-2π naye uyisikhawu esiphindayo. Kodwa ukuthi siyisifushane kakhulu kufanele kuhlolwe ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.explain: sin(x+π)=−sin x, ngakho sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Ngakho u-π naye uyisikhawu esiphindayo, futhi u-2π, izikhathi ezimbili u-π, naye. Kodwa ku-x=0, sin²0=0, futhi sin²(π/2)=1, ngakho u-π/2 akasona isikhawu esiphindayo. U-2π uyisikhawu esiphindayo kodwa akusona esifushane kakhulu.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala isikhathi sijikelezo esincane kakhulu esiyipositive sika-y=sin²x, bese uchaza ngezizathu ukuthi yini ewushiyekile esitatimendeni sikaSeoyeon. (Izizathu: okungenani okukodwa kwalokhu: ukubhala kabusha isisho noma amanani egrafu.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bala amanani ka-sin²x ku-x=0 no-x=π/2, bese uthola isikhawu lapho amanani aba lingana khona.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi ungabhala yini u-sin²x njengesisho esiqukethe u-cos2x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: isikhathi sijikelezo esincane kakhulu esiyipositive sika-y=sin²x singu-... ngoba ...
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale kabusha isisho njengo-sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 noma wafaka amanani ka-x ngqo?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi u-2π uyisikhawu esiphindayo kodwa akusona esifushane kakhulu?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ubambelele ezincazelweni zegama elithi "esincane kakhulu"?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.0: sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 futhi isikhathi sijikelezo sika-cos2x singu-π, ngakho isikhathi sijikelezo sika-sin²x singu-π. U-2π kaSeoyeon naye unikeza amanani afanayo ngemva kokuthuthela kangako, kodwa akusona isikhawu esincane kakhulu.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.1: sin(x+π)=−sin x, ngakho ukwenza isikwele kunika sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Ngakho isikhathi sijikelezo esincane kakhulu singu-π noma ngaphansi, futhi igebe eliphakathi kuka-x=π/2 no-3π/2, lapho u-sin²x engu-1, lingu-π, ngakho u-π uyincane kakhulu. U-2π uyisikhawu esiphindayo, kodwa akusona esincane kakhulu.

n-m-h2-trig-03.title: Uma tan(α+β)=1, u-α+β ungakanani?
n-m-h2-trig-03.goal: Landela ukuthi isinqumo sokuthi inani elilodwa le-tan libonakala linquma i-engeli sishintsha kanjani lapho kufika ulwazi mayelana nobubanzi be-engeli, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
n-m-h2-trig-03.material: Kuma-engeli α no-β, tanα=1/2 futhi tanβ=1/3. Ulwazi lwembulwa kancane kancane, ngakho nquma usebenzisa kuphela lokho okwaziwayo kuze kube manje. (tan(α+β) ngu-(tanα+tanβ)÷(1−tanα·tanβ).)
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.2: Ukusebenzisa amanani e-trigonometry kanye nobubanzi be-engeli
n-m-h2-trig-03.prereq.1: Ubuhlobo phakathi kwama-engeli anenani le-tan elifanayo (isikhathi sijikelezo π)
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lwembulwa kancane kancane. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha isinqumo usebenzisa kuphela ulwazi kuze kube manje.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, qala ubhale ububanzi lapho u-α+β angaba khona.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi mangaki ama-engeli anenani le-tan elingu-1 abubanzini obunjalo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Inani eliphezulu lingu-1/2+1/3=5/6 futhi isihlukanisi singu-1−1/6=5/6, ngakho tan(α+β)=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Lokhu kuthatha isamba sama-tan njengo-tan wesamba. Bheka futhi ukuthi isihlukanisi sefomula yokuhlanganisa sibhalwa kanjani.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hlola esimeni sefomula yokuhlanganisa ukuthi umveli usetshenziswa kuphi.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ufake amanani ngqo kufomula futhi wabala inani eliphezulu elingu-5/6 nesihlukanisi esingu-1−1/6=5/6.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.info: U-α no-β bobabili ngama-engeli abukhali (amakhulu kuno-0° futhi amancane kuno-90°).
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Isamba sama-engeli amabili abukhali sikhulu kuno-0° futhi sincane kuno-180°. Kububanzi obunjalo, u-45° kuphela i-engeli enenani le-tan elingu-1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Usebenzise ukuthi isamba siphakathi kuka-0° no-180° nokuthi ngaphakathi kwaso kunengeli eyodwa kuphela enenani le-tan elingu-1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi u-α+β ungaba mkhulu kuno-180°. Bala ububanzi besamba sama-engeli amabili abukhali.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kunama-engeli amaningi anenani le-tan elifanayo, kodwa awusebenzisanga ububanzi obunikeziwe.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Umgomo ushintshile. tanα=1/2 no-tanβ=1/3 basafana, u-α uyi-engeli ekhwadrenti yesithathu (enkulu kuno-180° futhi encane kuno-270°), futhi u-β uyi-engeli ebukhali.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.after: U-α+β mkhulu kuno-180° futhi mncane kuno-360°. Kububanzi obunjalo, u-225° kuphela i-engeli ene-tan 1. Nakuba inani le-tan lifana, impendulo iyashintsha lapho ububanzi be-engeli bushintsha.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ubheke kuphela inani le-tan elingu-1 bese usebenzisa kabusha i-engeli yangaphambilini.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kubonakala sengathi ucabanga ukuthi, ngoba ububanzi bushintshile, ayinakunqunywa. Bala ukuthi mangaki ama-engeli abubanzini obusha ane-tan 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.reflect: Inani le-tan(α+β)=1 belifana, kodwa kuye ngolwazi mayelana nobubanzi be-engeli laba ngu-45° kwelinye icala nango-225° kwelinye. I-engeli ayinqunywa ngenani lomsebenzi we-trigonometry kuphela; ububanzi be-engeli nabo buyadingeka.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani ukwazi ukuthi tan(α+β)=1 akunqumi u-α+β ngokuhlukile, nokuthi ulwazi mayelana nobubanzi be-engeli lwenzani.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.0: Thola ubhale i-engeli engeyona u-45° enenani le-tan elingu-1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa inani lama-engeli ongawakhetha ngaphandle kolwazi lobubanzi nalapho lukhona.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: ama-engeli anenani le-tan elifanayo ... Uma kunobubanzi, ...
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe unikeze isibonelo sama-engeli anenani le-tan elifanayo (u-45° no-225°)?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi ububanzi busikhawulela kanjani abakhethwa babe munye?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.0: Ama-engeli anenani le-tan elingu-1 akuyona u-45° kuphela kodwa aphinda njalo ngo-180°, njengo-225°, ngakho i-engeli ayinqunywa ngokuhlukile. Uma kunobubanzi, njengesibukhali noma ikhwadrenti yesithathu, kusala umkhethwa oyedwa kuphela ngaphakathi kwabo.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.1: I-tan inikeza inani elifanayo ngezikhawu ezingu-180°, ngakho kunani elingu-1 kuphela awukwazi ukusho ukuthi ngu-45° noma u-225°. Udinga ukwazi ukuthi i-engeli ibubanzini obuphi ukuze ukhethe elilodwa kwamabili.

n-m-h2-trig-04.title: Ukuthola ubude bezinhlangothi ezintathu ezakha unxantathu ongaphezu kwe-engeli engu-90°
n-m-h2-trig-04.goal: Usebenzisa umthetho we-cosine, bhala umgomo wokuthi i-engeli ephambene nohlangothi olude kakhulu ibe ngaphezu kwe-90°, ngenkathi uhlola nomgomo wokuthi unxantathu ukhona ngempela, bese wakha onxantathu abahlukile abangaphezu kwe-90°.
n-m-h2-trig-04.material: Ufuna ukwenza unxantathu one-engeli engaphezu kwe-90° lapho ubude bezinhlangothi ezintathu bonke bungamanani adalwa. Vumela c ibe ubude bohlangothi olude kakhulu no-a no-b zibe ezinye izinhlangothi ezimbili, bese usebenzisa umthetho we-cosine ukuhlola uphawu lwe-cosC=(a²+b²−c²)÷(2ab), i-cosine ye-engeli C ephambene no-c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.0: Ukusebenzisa uphawu lomthetho we-cosine ukuhlukanisa uhlobo lwe-engeli
n-m-h2-trig-04.prereq.1: Umgomo wokuthi unxantathu wakheke ngobude bezinhlangothi ezintathu
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.prompt: UMinsu uthe, "Uma a=3, b=4, c=9, khona-ke c²=81 mkhulu kuno-a²+b²=25, ngakho cosC<0, futhi kunonxantathu one-engeli engaphezu kwe-90° onezinhlangothi ezingu-3, 4, 9." Usinquma kanjani lesi sitatimende?
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ungakwazi yini ukwenza unxantathu ngezinduku ezintathu zobude obungu-3, 4 no-9.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ngempela inani le-cosC bese uliqhathanisa nobubanzi bamanani i-cosine engawathatha.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. 9²>3²+4², ngakho i-engeli ephambene nohlangothi olude kakhulu ingaphezu kwe-90°
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.a: Ubheke kuphela uphawu lwenani le-cosine futhi awuhlolanga ukuthi unxantathu ungakhiwa ngempela yini.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.b: Akulungile. 3+4<9, ngakho unxantathu awukwazi ukwakhiwa ngezinhlangothi zalobu bude
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.b: Ngaphambi kokuthola inani le-cosine, uqale wahlola ukuthi izinhlangothi ezintathu zakha unxantathu yini.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.c: Akulungile. Uma 9²>3²+4², i-engeli ephambene nohlangothi olude kakhulu iyi-engeli engu-90°
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.c: Uxubanise icala le-engeli engu-90° nelecala le-engeli engaphezu kwe-90°. Ku-3, 4, 5, qhathanisa u-5² no-3²+4².
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.d: Kulungile. 3, 4, 9 ziyizinde ezihlukile, ngakho kungaba unxantathu one-engeli engaphezu kwe-90°
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuhluka kobude akunamsebenzi nokuthi unxantathu ukhona yini.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.explain: cosC=(9+16−81)÷24 ilingana no-−56÷24<−1, ngakho ayikwazi ukuba yinani le-cosine. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi 3+4<9, ngakho akukho unxantathu owakhiwa yizinhlangothi ezintathu. Ukuze kube nengeli engaphezu kwe-90°, isikwele sohlangothi olude kakhulu kufanele sibe sikhulu kunesamba sezikwele zezinye ezimbili, futhi ngesikhathi esifanayo uhlangothi olude kakhulu kufanele lube ngaphansi kwesamba sezinye ezimbili.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola onxantathu abangu-3 abahlukile abangaphezu kwe-90° obude bezinhlangothi zabo bonke bungamanani adalwa angeqi ku-20 bese ufaka ubude bezinhlangothi ezintathu. (Onxantathu abahluka ngokulandelana kuphela babhekwa njengonxantathu ofanayo.)
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe uhlangothi olude kakhulu c, bese ukhetha u-a no-b ebubanzini lapho u-a+b ukhulu kuno-c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ezinombolweni ezintathu ozikhethile, bala u-c² no-a²+b² bese uziqhathanisa, futhi uqhathanise no-a+b no-c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Izinombolo ezintathu ziyizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Izinombolo ezintathu kufanele ziyizinombolo zemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Uhlangothi olude kakhulu lufushane kunesamba sezinye ezimbili, ngakho unxantathu uyakhiwa.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Uhlangothi olude kakhulu lulingana noma lude kunesamba sezinye ezimbili, ngakho akukho unxantathu owakhiwayo.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Isikwele sohlangothi olude kakhulu sikhulu kunesamba sezikwele zezinye ezimbili, ngakho unxantathu one-engeli engaphezu kwe-90°.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Isikwele sohlangothi olude kakhulu asikhulu kunesamba sezikwele zezinye ezimbili, ngakho akusona unxantathu one-engeli engaphezu kwe-90°.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.explain: (3, 4, 6) inayo 6²=36>3²+4²=25 no-3+4>6. (4, 5, 8) inayo 64>41 no-9>8, futhi (5, 6, 10) inayo 100>61 no-11>10. (3, 4, 9) inelisa umgomo wesikwele kodwa 3+4<9, ngakho akusona unxantathu.

n-m-h2-trig-05.title: Udinga ukwazi ini ukuze uthole irediyasi yombuthano okhawulela unxantathu?
n-m-h2-trig-05.goal: Hlukanisa ukuthi unxantathu unqunywa ngokuhlukile kokuthi inani olifunayo linqunywa ngokuhlukile, khetha ulwazi olunquma irediyasi yombuthano okhawulela unxantathu, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
n-m-h2-trig-05.material: Kunxantathu ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB, futhi u-A, B, C ngama-engeli emaphethelweni. Ufuna ukwazi irediyasi R yombuthano okhawulela unxantathu. Ucezu ngalunye lolwazi lunikezwa njengezinombolo ezithile, futhi kuthathwa ukuthi unxantathu onjalo ukhona ngempela.
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.2: Ukubona ukuthi inani lingafana ngisho nonxantathu ababili
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha wonke amacala alandelayo lapho lolo lwazi kuphela lunquma inani le-R ngokuhlukile.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.0: Emthethweni we-sine a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R, bhala ukuthi uthola isisho esinjani uma kunepheya eyodwa okungenani yohlangothi ne-engeli yaso ephambene.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kucezu ngalunye lolwazi, hlola ukuthi kunepheya yohlangothi ne-engeli ehambisanayo yini, futhi uma kungekho, ukuthi ingenziwa ngomthetho we-cosine yini.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.a: Osayizi bama-engeli amathathu u-A, B, C

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kuthatha ukuthi i-sine ihla kuphela ezingelini ze-acute. Qhathanisa amanani e-sine ka-30° no-75°.

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.b: Uqhathanise umphumela obaliwe nohla lwamanani e-sine, kusuka ku-−1 kuya ku-1 kuhlanganisiwe.

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kuthatha ukuthi inani alikwazi ukuba yinani le-sine nje ngoba lingeyona i-rational. U-sin45°=√2/2 naye akayona i-rational.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.d: I-sine ka-45° ne-sine ka-30° ayikwazi ukwengezwa komunye nomunye
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.d: Lokhu kuthatha ukuthi ukwengeza uqobo kuvinjelwe. Akukho sizathu sokuthi azikwazi ukwengezwa. Kufanele wahlulele ngomphumela.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.explain: U-(√2+1)/2 ungu-1.207 cishe, omkhulu kuno-1. Inani le-sine liphakathi kuka-−1 no-1 kuhlanganisiwe, ngakho ukubala kumele kuphosile endaweni ethile. Noma ungayazi ifomula, ungaqaphela iphutha kusukela kuhla lwamanani kuphela. Ifomula elungile ngu-sin75°=sin45°cos30°+cos45°sin30°.

n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokuthola into e-1 uHarin ayenze kahle futhi uyivume.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bese ubhala isenzo e-1 uHarin angasizama ngqo (ukuhlola uhla lwamanani, ukufaka ingeli elula, njll.).
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uvumile lokho uHarin akwenze kahle (ukuhlukanisa ku-45° no-30°)?

n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.prompt: Ake u-v₀ abe yisivinini ku-t=0 no-x₀ indawo. Faka amapheya amathathu ahlukile ezinombolo ezigcwele (v₀, x₀) ukuze indawo ku-t=3 ibe ngu-10. (−20≤v₀≤20, −20≤x₀≤20)

n-m-h2-integ-01.title: Ingabe inani le-definite integral nendawo engaphansi kwegrafu kuyinto efanayo?
n-m-h2-integ-01.goal: Qonda ukuthi i-definite integral "yindawo enophawu," ebala ingxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis njengengelona, wakhe icala lapho i-definite integral iyi-0 kodwa indawo ingeyona i-0, bese uchaza isizathu nokuthi indawo ithola kanjani.
n-m-h2-integ-01.material: Kunegrafu ye-f(x)=x²−2x, i-x-axis, nesikhala 0≤x≤3. UHajun uthe, "∫₀³ f(x)dx=0, ngakho indawo phakathi kwegrafu ne-x-axis nayo iyi-0," futhi uSeoa uthe, "Angicabangi ukuthi indawo iyi-0." (∫₀³ yi-definite integral kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-3.)
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa igrafu ibe yizingxenye ezingenhla nezingaphansi kwe-x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isinqumo esilungile mayelana nendawo phakathi kwegrafu ne-x-axis kulesi sikhala.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dweba igrafu ye-f(x)=x²−2x bese uphawula lapho iphezu kwe-x-axis nalapho ingaphansi kwayo ngaphakathi kwesikhala.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thola ama-x-coordinate amaphoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis, hlukanisa isikhala kuleyo maphoyinti, bala i-definite integral engxenyeni ngayinye ngokwehlukana, bese uqhathanisa izimpawu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.a: Indawo iyi-0: ngoba inani le-definite integral yindawo phakathi kwegrafu ne-x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.a: Uthathe inani le-definite integral nendawo njengento efanayo. Ingxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis ibalwa njengengelona ku-definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.b: Indawo iyi-0: ngoba igrafu ihlangana ne-x-axis endaweni ngaphakathi kwesikhala
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.b: Iphoyinti lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis liyiphoyinti nje futhi alenzi indawo ibe yi-0. Izimo ezinhlangothini zombili zalelo phoyinti zinendawo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.c: Indawo ayiyona i-0: ngoba ingxenye engenhla nengxenye engezansi zinamanani anezimpawu ezihlukile futhi ayakhansela
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ngokuthi amanani alungile nangelona angakhansela kanjani ngaphakathi kwe-definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.d: Akwaziwa: ngoba inani le-definite integral kuphela alisho lutho ngesimo segrafu
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.d: Lapha i-f(x) inikeziwe, ngakho singahlola ngqo isimo segrafu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x²−2x=x(x−2) ingaphansi kwe-x-axis ku-0≤x≤2, ngakho ∫₀² f=−4/3, futhi iphezu ku-2≤x≤3, ngakho ∫₂³ f=4/3. Ziyahlangana zibe ngu-0, kodwa indawo iyi-4/3+4/3=8/3. I-definite integral "yindawo enophawu," ebala ingxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis njengengelona.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.prompt: Ku-f(x)=x(x−a), faka amapheya amabili ahlukene ezinombolo eziphelele ezilungile (a, b) lapho i-definite integral ∫₀ᵇ f(x)dx=0. (1≤a≤20, 1≤b≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.0: Vula i-∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx bese uyibhala njengesisho ku-a no-b.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thola ukuthi yibuphi ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-a no-b obenza lesisho sibe ngu-0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a no-b bayizinombolo eziphelele ezilungile ngaphakathi kohla.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kumele bayizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-20.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani le-∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx aliyona i-0. Vula futhi ubale i-b³/3−ab²/2.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.explain: ∫₀ᵇ x(x−a)dx=b³/3−ab²/2=b²(2b−3a)/6, ngakho iyi-0 uma 2b=3a. Khona-ke b=1.5a ikhulu kuno-a, ngakho isikhala [0,b] siqukethe ingxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis (0<x<a) nengxenye engenhla kwayo (a<x<b). Ngakho nakuba i-definite integral iyi-0, indawo ayiyona i-0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.prompt: Khetha elilodwa kumapheya owenze manje bese uchaza ukuthi kungani i-definite integral iyi-0 kodwa indawo ingeyona i-0, nokuthi indawo ithola kanjani kulesi sikhala.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.0: Usebenzisa elinye lamapheya owawenzile ngaphambilini, bala ama-definite integral engxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis nengxenye engaphezulu kwayo ngokuhlukile bese ubheka izimpawu.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi indawo, njengobude, ayikwazi ukuba yinegative, bese ucabanga ukuthi ingxenye engezansi kufanele iphathwe kanjani.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.placeholder: isb., I-definite integral ... ngoba ingxenye ... , futhi indawo ...
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe usho ukuthi ingxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis ibalwa kanjani ngaphakathi kwe-definite integral?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi njengoba indawo ingeke ibe yinegative, uhlukanise isikhawu lapho uphawu lushintsha khona?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.0: I-definite integral yengxenye engaphansi kwe-x-axis iyinegative futhi leyo yengxenye engaphezulu iyipositive, ngakho uma ihlanganiswa iyahambisana ibe ngu-0. Endaweni, ingxenye engezansi nayo kufanele ibalwe njengepositive, ngakho hlukanisa isikhawu endaweni lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis, thola inani ngalinye, bese ufaka amanani aphelele alo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.1: I-definite integral iyindawo enophawu, ngakho inani eliphezulu nenani eliphansi (elinegative) lisamba libe ngu-0. Indawo yangempela ibala kokubili njengepositive, ngakho thola ngokuhlukile ngokuhlukanisa ku-[0,a] no-[a,b], bese uzifaka.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.2: Uma uhlukanisa isikhawu kabili endaweni lapho igrafu ihlangana khona ne-x-axis, i-definite integral eyodwa iyipositive futhi enye iyinegative. Nakuba isamba sazo singu-0, indawo ingu-|ingxenye enegative|+|ingxenye eyipositive|, okukhulu kuno-0.

n-m-h2-integ-04.title: Ukuthola umgomo wenani eliphansi lasendaweni lomsebenzi omiswe nge-definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-04.topic: Ukuhlukanisa namanani anqamulayo yemisebenzi emiswe nge-definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-04.goal: Sebenzisa iqiniso lokuthi ukukhula nokwehla namanani anqamulayo komsebenzi F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt omiswe nge-definite integral kunqunywa uphawu lwe-f(x), ukwakha izibonelo lapho inani eliphansi lasendaweni liyipositive bese uthola umgomo.
n-m-h2-integ-04.material: f(t)=(t−a)(t−b) (a no-b yizinombolo eziphelele ezine-0<a<b) no-F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt. (∫₀ˣ iyi-definite integral kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-x.)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.1: Ukuhlukanisa indawo yenani elinqamulayo nosayizi walo
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.1: Ukukhula, ukwehla namanani anqamulayo yemisebenzi ye-cubic
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.prompt: Ku-x>0, ku-x muphi u-F(x) angaba nenani elinqamulayo?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.0: Khumbula ukuthi uthola msebenzi muni uma uhlukanisa umsebenzi omiswe nge-definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.1: Uma uhlola uphawu lwe-F' kububanzi ngabunye be-x, ungasho ukuthi i-F ikhula kuphi nokuthi yehla kuphi.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.a: I-x lapho i-f(x) inenani elinqamulayo: i-F inenani elinqamulayo endaweni efanayo ne-f
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukukhula nokwehla kwe-F kunqunywa uphawu lwe-f, hhayi inani lika-f. Izindawo zamanani anqamulayo e-f azinalo uhlobo lwamanani anqamulayo e-F.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.b: I-x lapho f(x)=0 futhi uphawu lwe-f(x) lushintsha ezinhlangothini zombili
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.b: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi njengoba F'(x)=f(x), amanani anqamulayo enzeka lapho uphawu lwe-F' lushintsha khona.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.c: I-x lapho F(x)=0: inani elinqamulayo lenzeka lapho igrafu inqamula i-x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.c: Izindawo lapho i-F ingu-0 nezindawo lapho kwenzeka khona amanani anqamulayo yizindaba ezihlukile.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.d: x=0: inani le-F liqala ukushintsha endaweni lapho ukuhlanganisa kuqala khona
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.d: F(0)=0 liyinani nje, futhi x=0 akusiyo indawo lapho ukukhula nokwehla kushintsha khona.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.explain: Njengoba F'(x)=f(x)=(x−a)(x−b), i-F ikhula ku-x<a, yehla ku-a<x<b, bese ikhula ku-x>b. Ngakho i-F inenani eliphakeme lasendaweni ku-x=a nenani eliphansi lasendaweni ku-x=b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.prompt: Emapheyeni ezinombolo eziphelele (a, b) ane-0<a<b≤20, faka amapheya amathathu ahlukile lapho inani eliphansi lasendaweni le-F(x) liyipositive.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala unqume i-x lapho i-F inenani eliphansi lasendaweni, bese ubhala inani le-F kuleyo x ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.1: Wandisa ubale ∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt bese usebenza umgomo wokuthi uphawu luyipositive.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a no-b kufanele kube yizinombolo eziphelele ezine-0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani eliphansi lasendaweni aliyona ipositive. Bhala inani le-F ku-x lapho inani eliphansi lasendaweni lenzeka khona ngo-a no-b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.explain: Inani eliphansi lasendaweni lenzeka ku-x=b, futhi F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t²−(a+b)t+ab)dt=b³/3−(a+b)b²/2+ab²=b²(3a−b)/6. Njengoba b²>0, inani eliphansi lasendaweni liyipositive uma 3a−b>0, okusho ukuthi b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kuyiphi ihlobo phakathi kuka-b no-a emapheyeni owathole, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani leli hlobo lidingeka ngokubala inani eliphansi lasendaweni.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qala unqume ukuthi inani eliphansi lasendaweni lise-a noma lise-b, bese ubala i-definite integral kuze kufike kuleyo x.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.1: Esishweni owasibala, hlukanisa izici ezihlala ziyipositive nezo uphawu lwazo olungashintsha.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.placeholder: isb., b ... kuno-... ka-a. Inani eliphansi lasendaweni ..., ngakho ...
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqale wanquma i-x lapho kwenzeka khona inani eliphansi lasendaweni bese ubala inani lalo?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho ukuthi yiliphi isici esinquma uphawu lwenani eliphansi lasendaweni?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.0: b kufanele ibe ngaphansi kwezikhathi ezi-3 ka-a. Inani eliphansi lasendaweni lenzeka ku-x=b, futhi F(b)=b²(3a−b)/6, futhi njengoba b² ihlala iyipositive, 3a−b kufanele ibe yipositive. Ngakho b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.1: Uma b<3a, inani eliphansi lasendaweni liyipositive. Ukubala F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt kunika b²(3a−b)/6, futhi uphawu lwayo lunqunywa ngu-3a−b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.2: Kwanele ukuthi 3a>b. Thola inani F(b)=b^2(3a-b)/6 ku-x=b, lapho inani eliphansi lasendaweni lenzeka khona, bese uthola umgomo wokuthi liyipositive: 3a-b>0.

n-m-h2-integ-03.title: Uma kubuyele lapho kwaqale khona, ingabe akuzange kunyakaze?
n-m-h2-integ-03.topic: Isivinini nebanga: ushintsho esikhundleni nebanga elihanjiwe
n-m-h2-integ-03.goal: Qonda, ngokubuyekeza isinqumo sakho njalo lapho ulwazi lwembulwa, ukuthi i-definite integral yesivinini iwushintsho esikhundleni futhi ihlukile ebangeni elihanjiwe, bese uchaza ukuthi ibanga lithola kanjani.
n-m-h2-integ-03.material: Ulwazi mayelana nephoyinti u-P elihamba emgqeni wezinombolo lwembulwa kancane kancane. Ushintsho esikhundleni iyi-integral yesivinini, futhi ibanga elihanjiwe liyisamba sazo zonke izinde ezimbozwe ngempela.
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.0: Ukubuyekeza isinqumo sakho njalo lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.2: Ukuhlukanisa isikhawu lapho uphawu lwesivinini lushintsha khona
n-m-h2-integ-03.prereq.0: Ubuhlobo phakathi kwesivinini nesikhundla (ushintsho esikhundleni = i-definite integral yesivinini)
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isinqumo usebenzisa kuphela ulwazi olwembuliwe.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo lapho ulwazi olusha lubonakala, cabanga ukuthi "ushintsho esikhundleni" no"bude obumbozwe" kusho into efanayo yini.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ukunyakaza kwephoyinti kuhluke kanjani lapho uphawu lwesivinini lushintsha khona.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Sithole ushintsho esikhundleni sephoyinti u-P, eliqale ku-t=0, kuze kufike ku-t=6, futhi kwakungu-0. Okusho ukuthi, ku-t=6, u-P usendaweni lapho aqale khona.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kulolu lwazi kuphela, singasho yini ukuthi ibanga u-P alihambile lingu-0?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ushintsho esikhundleni liyinani elinendlela (linophawu), ngakho lingaba ngu-0 nakuba iphoyinti liphume futhi labuya.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Singasho kanjalo: isikhundla sifanayo, ngakho ibanga elihanjiwe nalo lingu-0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uthathe ushintsho esikhundleni nebanga elihanjiwe njengento efanayo. Nakuba liphume futhi labuya, ushintsho lungu-0.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Asikwazi ukusho kanjalo: uma liphume futhi labuya, ibanga alingu-0 nakuba ushintsho lungu-0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucabange ukuthi ushintsho olungu-0 alusho kuphela ukuthi "akunyakazanga."
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Singasho kanjalo: uma i-definite integral ingu-0, isivinini kufanele sibe ngu-0 njalo
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nakuba i-definite integral ingu-0, kungaba nezikhawu lapho isivinini siyipositive zixutshwe nezikhawu lapho siyinegative.

n-m-h2-seq-02.title: Uma isinyathelo se-induction silungile, ingabe isitatimende nasso silungile?
n-m-h2-seq-02.topic: Ingqondo ye-mathematical induction: isinyathelo se-induction nesinyathelo sokuqala
n-m-h2-seq-02.goal: Qonda, ngenkathi ubuyekeza isinqumo sakho njengoba ulwazi lwembulwa, ukuthi ku-mathematical induction u-"isinyathelo se-induction" siyisitatimende esinemibandela nje futhi isiphetho sima kuphela uma icala lokuqala liqinisekisiwe.
n-m-h2-seq-02.material: UJia ufuna ukukhombisa nge-induction ukuthi "P(n): 2+4+6+⋯+2n = n²+n+3" kusebenza kunoma yiyiphi inombolo yemvelo u-n. Lokho akuhloliwe kuvezwa ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi.
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.0: Ukubuyekeza isinqumo isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.1: Ukuqonda incazelo yesimo esinemibandela esithi "uma ..., bese okulandelayo nako ..."
n-m-h2-seq-02.thinking.2: Ukuhlukanisa lokho ukuhlola ngakunye kwezimbili ku-induction okwenza
n-m-h2-seq-02.prereq.1: Ifomu le-mathematical induction (ukuhlola icala lokuqala nesinyathelo esisuka ku-k siye ku-k+1)
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isikhathi ngasinye lapho kuvela ulwazi olusha, cabanga ukuthi isinqumo sakho kufanele sishintshe yini.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi u-"uma P(k), bese P(k+1)" ungaba yiqiniso noma u-P(k) engelona iqiniso yini.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Isinyathelo se-induction sihloliwe. Cabanga ukuthi u-P(k) uyasebenza futhi wengeze u-2(k+1) ezinhlangothini zombili; uhlangothi lwesokudla luba ngu-k²+k+3+2(k+1) = (k+1)²+(k+1)+3, ngakho kunoma yiyiphi inombolo yemvelo u-k, u-"uma u-P(k) usebenza, bese u-P(k+1) usebenza" ulungile.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ngalolu lwazi kuphela, singasho ukuthi u-"P(n) usebenza kunoma yiyiphi inombolo yemvelo u-n"?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Isinyathelo se-induction yisitatimende esinemibandela u-"uma P(k), bese P(k+1)." U-P kufanele asebenze empeleni endaweni ethile ukuze aqhubeke kusuka lapho.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Singasho kanjalo: ngoba isinyathelo esisuka ku-k siye kokulandelayo sihloliwe kunoma yimuphi u-k
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Isinyathelo se-induction sabhalwa ngokucabanga u-"uma kusebenza," ngakho udinga icala lapho kusebenza khona empeleni endaweni ethile.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Asikwazi ukunquma okwamanje: ngoba icala lokuqala lapho kusebenza khona alikahlolwa
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucabange ngeqiniso lokuthi ukuhlola okwehlukile kwecala lokuqala kuyadingeka.

n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Isinyathelo ukuba silungile nesitatimende ukuba yiphutha kuyizinto ezihlukile. Akukabikho bufakazi bokuthi kuyiphutha.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Manje icala lokuqala selihloliwe. Ku-n=1, uhlangothi lwesokunxele lungu-2 futhi uhlangothi lwesokudla lungu-1+1+3 = 5.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngalolu lwazi olwengeziwe, isinqumo sakho siyini?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Uma u-P(1) eyiphutha, indlela esuka ku-1 iye ku-2, 3, … ivinjiwe kusukela ekuqaleni. Noma isinyathelo se-induction silungile, akulandeli ukuthi u-P(2) uyiqiniso.

n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala izinto ezimbili okufanele uzihlole ukukhombisa ukuthi "kusebenza kunoma yiyiphi inombolo yemvelo u-n" nge-induction, futhi uchaze ngemisho eyodwa noma emibili ukuthi iyiphi kuzo eyawa esimweni sikaJia.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ucabanga nge-induction njengomgqa wama-domino, bhala ngokwehlukana ukuthi ukuwisa i-domino yokuqala nokuqhubeka kuhambisana nani.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka futhi umphumela wokuhlola uJia akwenzile okuhambisana ne-domino yokuqala.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Usho ukuthi ukuhlola ngakunye kwezimbili kuqinisekisani?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Uqaphele ukuthi iliphi elilahlekile noma eliphosile esixazululweni sikaJia?
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.model.0: Kuqala, kufanele uhlole ukuthi isitatimende sisebenza yini uma n=1. Okwesibili, kufanele ukhombise ukuthi uma u-P(k) usebenza, u-P(k+1) usebenza. UJia wenza okwesibili kahle, kodwa ku-n=1 sinu-2≠5, ngakho okokuqala kuyiphutha.
n-m-h2-seq-02.s.s2.model.1: Udinga ukubheka izinto ezimbili: ukuthi icala lokuqala (P(1)) liyiqiniso yini, nokuthi isinyathelo esisuka ku-k siye ku-k+1 sisebenza yini. KuJia, u-P(1) akasebenzi, ngakho ukuqala kuyawa.

n-m-h2-integ-07.title: Uma i-derivative ye-constant ingu-0, ingabe u-k naye ungu-0?
n-m-h2-integ-07.topic: Inani le-definite integral lingu-constant: izibalo zomsebenzi eziqukethe i-definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-07.goal: Qonda ukuthi i-definite integral u-∫₀¹ f(t)dt iyi-constant engahlobene no-x kodwa inani layo alingu-0 futhi kufanele libalwe kusuka encazelweni, futhi ubhale incazelo emnene kumfundi omncane owenze iphutha elifanayo.
n-m-h2-integ-07.material: Lesi yisixazululo sikaHaeun sokuthola umsebenzi u-f(x) onelisa isimo u-f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹ f(t)dt. (U-∫₀¹ yi-definite integral kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-1.)
n-m-h2-integ-07.thinking.2: Ukuchaza iphutha ngenkathi ucwenga isixazululo somunye umuntu
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala ophosile esixazululweni sikaHaeun.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye ulandela ngempela kowandulela, nokuthi umugqa ngamunye unesizathu esanele.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.hint.1: Buyela ekutheni u-k wachazwa kanjani, futhi ucabange ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka u-f(x) otholwe ekugcineni encazelweni.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.0: U-∫₀¹ f(t)dt yinani elingaqukethe u-x, ngakho uma lenziwa libe ngu-k, f(x)=x²+2k.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.1: Ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili maqondana no-x kunika u-f'(x)=2x, ngakho u-k uyanyamalala uma uhlukaniswa.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.line.2: U-k uyi-constant futhi i-derivative ye-constant ingu-0, ngakho k=0.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 ngowokuqala ophosile. Kuyiqiniso ukuthi i-derivative ye-constant ingu-0, kodwa lokho akusho ukuthi inani le-constant lingu-0. Inani luka-k kufanele linqunywe kusuka encazelweni k=∫₀¹ f(t)dt. Ukufaka u-f(t)=t²+2k kunika u-k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, ngakho k=−1/3 no-f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi indlela eqondile kakhulu yokuqinisekisa ukuthi impendulo kaHaeun u-f(x)=x² iphosile?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.0: Faka u-f(x)=x² ezinhlangothini zombili zesibalo sokuqala u-f(x)=x²+2∫₀¹ f(t)dt.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi ukuhlola ngakunye "kuhlala kuphuma kulungile noma impendulo iphosile."
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.a: Hlukanisa u-f(x)=x² maqondana no-x futhi uhlole ukuthi u-f'(x)=2x
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.a: Isixazululo sikaHaeun sesivele sanelisa lesi simo. Lokhu kuhlola akuveli iphutha.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.b: Hlola kuphela ukuthi u-f(0)=0, futhi ubone ukuthi uyavumelana no-k=0 kusuka ku-f(0)=0+2k esibalweni sokuqala
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.b: Uma u-f(0)=0, kubukeka kuhambisana no-k=0, ngakho akukho kuphikisana okuvelayo. Ngaphandle uma uhlola u-k ngenani le-definite integral, awukwazi ukubamba iphutha.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.c: Faka u-f(x)=x² ku-∫₀¹ f(t)dt, bala inani, futhi uliqhathanise no-k=0
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kuhlola kubala inani le-definite integral ngqo futhi kubona ukuthi liyavumelana nencazelo ka-k yini.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.o.d: Hlola ukuthi ukusebenzisa elinye ihlamvu esikhundleni sika-k kunika isixazululo esifanayo yini
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.r.d: Ukushintsha igama lehlamvu akushintshi ingqondo yesixazululo.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s2.explain: Uma u-f(x)=x², bese u-∫₀¹ t²dt=1/3, ngakho u-k kwakufanele abe ngu-1/3, kodwa uHaeun wathi u-k=0. Lezi ezimbili azivumelani, ngakho u-f(x)=x² akanelisi isimo sokuqala.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala inothi elifushane kuHaeun. Faka into e-1 ayenze kahle, ukuthi kungani umugqa ophosile uphosile, nesihluthulelo sesixazululo esilungile nomphumela waso.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.0: Thola into e-1 eyayilungile esixazululweni sikaHaeun, futhi uqagele ukuthi umugqa ophosile wawuvela kukuphi ukucabanga.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala phansi inkulumo edingekayo ukulungisa umugqa ophosile (inkulumo ebhala u-k njenge-definite integral).
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uqale ngokusho ngokuqondile ukuthi kwenziwe kahle ini?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uchaze ukuthi u-"i-derivative ye-constant ingu-0" no-"inani le-constant lingu-0" kuhlukile?
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.0: Haeun, ukwenza i-definite integral ibe ngu-k kwakungumbono omuhle! Kodwa u-"i-derivative ye-constant ingu-0" kusho ukuthi umphumela wokuhlukanisa ungu-0, hhayi ukuthi inani luka-k lingu-0. Kufanele uthole u-k kusuka encazelweni yawo, k=∫₀¹(t²+2k)dt=1/3+2k, ngakho k=−1/3, futhi f(x)=x²−2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.1: Kwakuhle kakhulu ukuthi uqale ngokwenza inani elingahlobene no-x libe ngu-k. Kodwa u-k eyi-constant, ukuze i-derivative yawo ibe ngu-0, kuyinto ehlukile ku-k enenani elingu-0. Uma ubala i-definite integral ngqo, ukuxazulula u-k=1/3+2k kunika u-k=-1/3, ngakho f(x)=x²-2/3.
n-m-h2-integ-07.s.s3.model.2: Haeun, umsebenzi omuhle. Uma ufaka u-f(x)=x² owawutholile ekugcineni ku-∫₀¹ f(t)dt, uthola u-1/3, ongavumelani no-k=0. Kufanele ubale inani le-definite integral ukunquma u-k, bese k=−1/3 no-f(x)=x²−2/3.

n-m-h2-integ-08.title: Uma sinquma maphakathi nesikhawu, indawo nayo ihlukana yaba ngu-hhafu?
n-m-h2-integ-08.goal: Hlola futhi uchaze, ngokubala kwe-definite integral nesibonelo osenza wena, ukuthi ukunquma maphakathi nesikhawu akuhlukanisi indawo ngo-hhafu, nokuthi indawo yokunquma ishintshelwa ohlangothini lapho umsebenzi mkhulu khona.
n-m-h2-integ-08.material: Kunesimo esizunguzwe ngumugqa u-y=2x, i-x-axis, nemigqa emibili u-x=1 no-x=7. USua uthe, "Uma udweba umugqa oqondile ku-x=4, maphakathi nesikhawu u-1≤x≤7, indawo ihlukaniswa ngo-hhafu," futhi uDohyeon wathi, "Ake sihlole nge-definite integral."
n-m-h2-integ-08.thinking.1: Ukuthola umthetho ovamile kusuka ezibonelweni eziningana
n-m-h2-integ-08.prereq.1: Ukuthola amanani anelisa isibalo phakathi kwezinombolo ezigcwele
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.prompt: Umugqa oqondile u-x=4 uhlukanisa kanjani indawo yesimo?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuphakama kwengxenye yesokunxele nengxenye yesokudla yesimo ngo-x=4 njengomugqa wokuhlukanisa.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bala futhi uqhathanise ama-definite integral engxenye ezimbili, u-∫₁⁴ 2x dx no-∫₄⁷ 2x dx.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.a: Ihlukaniswa ngo-hhafu: ngoba izikhawu zesokunxele nesokudla zinobubanzi obufanayo
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.a: Noma ububanzi bufana, uma ukuphakama kuhlukile, izindawo ziyahluka. Esikhaweni sesokudla umugqa uphezulu.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.b: Ihlukaniswa ngo-hhafu: ngoba ungumugqa, ngakho ukuphakama kuqhubeka kunoma yisiphi isikhawu
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.b: Ukuphakama kuka-y=2x kushintsha ngo-x. Ukuphakama kuqhubeka kuphela ku-y=constant.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.c: Ayihlukaniswa ngo-hhafu: ngoba ingxenye yesokudla iphansi, ngakho ingxenye yesokunxele inendawo enkulu
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.c: Umugqa uba phezulu uya kwesokudla, ngakho uhlangothi lwesokudla lunendawo enkulu.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.o.d: Ayihlukaniswa ngo-hhafu: ngoba ukuphakama kwenyuka kuya kwesokudla, ngakho ingxenye yesokudla inkulu
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.r.d: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi indawo eningi iqoqeka ohlangothini lapho ukuphakama kukhulu khona.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s1.explain: ∫₁⁴ 2x dx=16−1=15 no-∫₄⁷ 2x dx=49−16=33. Isokunxele singu-15 futhi isokudla singu-33, ngakho ayihlukaniswa ngo-hhafu, futhi isokudla sikhulu.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.prompt: Faka izintathu ezimbili ezihlukile zezinombolo ezigcwele (a, b, k) ukuze umugqa oqondile u-x=k uhlukanise ngqo indawo phakathi kuka-y=2x, i-x-axis, nemigqa emibili eqondile u-x=a no-x=b ngo-hhafu. (1≤a<k<b≤50)
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ama-definite integral engxenye yesokunxele nengxenye yesokudla ka-x=k ngokuya ngo-a, b, k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yenza lula isibalo esithi amanani amabili alingana futhi uzame izinhlanganisela zezinombolo ezigcwele.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Izindawo ezisohlangothini lwesokunxele nolwesokudla luka-x=k ziyalingana.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Indawo yesokunxele nendawo yesokudla akulingani. Veza u-∫ₐᵏ 2x dx no-∫ₖᵇ 2x dx ngokuya ngo-a, b, k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s2.explain: ∫ₐᵏ 2x dx=k²−a² no-∫ₖᵇ 2x dx=b²−k², ngakho k²−a²=b²−k², okungukuthi, 2k²=a²+b². Isibonelo, (1, 7, 5) unika u-25−1=24=49−25.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.prompt: Ezintathu owazitholile, u-k mkhulu noma mncane kunesilinganiso (esiphakathi) sika-a no-b? Chaza ukuthi kungani, uxhumanisa nesimo sika-y=2x.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.0: Kuthathu ngalunye owalithola, thola isilinganiso (a+b)/2 futhi uqhathanise no-k.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.hint.1: Khumbula ukuthi uhlangothi luni olunendawo enkulu uma unquma maphakathi.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.placeholder: isb., k ... kunaphakathi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ...
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uqhathanise izindawo zengxenye yesobunxele neyesokudla maphakathi?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe usho, ngesizathu, ukuthi indawo yokuhlukanisa ngesigamu ihambe ngakuphi?
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.0: k inkulu kunesilinganiso. Umugqa uya phezulu ngakwesokudla, ngakho uma unquma maphakathi, indawo yesokudla inkulu. Ngakho ukuze uhlukanise indawo ibe ngamaqembu amabili alinganayo, kufanele uhambise umugqa wokunquma ngakwesokudla sendawo ephakathi.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.1: Ku-(1,7,5), isilinganiso singu-4 kodwa k=5, ngakho k inkulu. Indawo eningi iqoqeka ohlangothini lapho ukuphakama kukhulu, ngakho umugqa wokuhlukanisa ngesigamu uhanjiswe ngakwesokudla.
n-m-h2-integ-08.s.s3.model.2: I-k ehlukanisa ngesigamu iseceleni kwesokudla sephoyinti eliphakathi lika-a no-b. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi y=2x iphezulu ngakwesokudla, ngakho uma unquma maphakathi, ingxenye yesokudla inkulu.

n-m-h2-integ-09.material: Kukhona ijika y=x³−3x nejika y=x³−3x+4, okuyileli jika elinyuselwe phezulu ngo-4. Sifuna ukuthola indawo phakathi kwamajika amabili ebangeni 0≤x≤3. (Kuleli banga, ijika lokuqala lineyingxenye eyehlela ngaphansi kwe-x-axis.)

n-m-h2-seq-03.title: Ubufakazi bokuthi u-2ⁿ mkhulu kuno-n²: inkinga ikuphi?

n-m-h2-seq-03.material: U-Seoyun ufakazele nge-mathematical induction ukuthi "2ⁿ > n² kuyo yonke inombolo yemvelo n." (2ⁿ ngu-2 emandleni ka-n, futhi 2ᵏ⁺¹ ngu-2 emandleni ka-(k+1).)

n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Esibalweni noma ekungalingani ukuthi umugqa ngamunye uthi, faka 1, 2, 3, … endaweni ka-k bese uhlola ukuthi empeleni kuyasebenza yini.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngo-n omncane ukuthi isiphetho sobufakazi silungile ngempela yini, futhi uma siyamanga, landela emuva ukuze uthole ukuthi yimuphi umugqa owenze lokho kwenzeke.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s1.line.0: P(n): 2ⁿ > n². Ku-n=1, 2 > 1, ngakho P(1) iyasebenza.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho 2ᵏ⁺¹ > (k+1)², okungukuthi, P(k+1) nayo iyasebenza. Nge-induction, 2ⁿ > n² kuyo yonke inombolo yemvelo n.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 4 uyiphutha lokuqala. k²−2k−1 ≥ 0 ayisebenzi kuyo yonke inombolo yemvelo k. Uma k=1 ingu-−2, futhi uma k=2 ingu-−1. Isebenza kusukela ezinombolweni zemvelo 3 nangaphezulu. Isiphetho emugqeni 5 silandela umugqa 4. Empeleni, 2ⁿ > n² ayisebenzi ku-n=2, 3, 4.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s2.prompt: Ukukulungisa kube ubufakazi obulungile, nquma ibanga lika-n lapho 2ⁿ>n² isebenza khona, bhala ukuthi liyiphi icala okufanele lihlolwe njengecala lokuqala, nokuthi yisiphi isimo ku-k isinyathelo se-induction esingasisebenzisa.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bala u-2ⁿ no-n² ku-n=1 kuya ku-6, yenza ithebula, bese uthola u-n wokuqala lapho 2ⁿ ihlala inkulu.
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Thola u-k lapho ukungalingani emugqeni onephutha kuqala ukusebenza, bese ucabanga ukuthi ungasetha icala lokuqala ku-k noma ngaphezulu yini.

n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ukhethe icala lokuqala ngaphakathi kwebanga lapho isinyathelo sisebenza khona?
n-m-h2-seq-03.s.s2.model.0: 2ⁿ>n² isebenza kusukela ku-n=5. Qala ngo-n=5, lapho 32>25, futhi ukungalingani kwesinyathelo k²−2k−1≥0 kuyasebenza ku-k≥3, ngakho isinyathelo singasetshenziswa ku-k≥5.

n-m-h2-seq-04.s.s1.o.d: a₄ = 6 kuphela: ngoba a₄=a₂×r² no-r²≥0, ngakho a₄ inophawu olufanayo no-a₂

n-m-h2-seq-09.title: Uma isamba siqhubeka nokukhula, ingabe amathemu naye aqhubeka nokukhula?
n-m-h2-seq-09.topic: Isamba Sₙ se-sequence nokukhula noma ukwehla kwethemu aₙ
n-m-h2-seq-09.goal: Zakhele wena izibonelo eziphikisayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-Sₙ ekhulayo yehlukile ku-aₙ ekhulayo, bese uchaza ukukhula noma ukwehla kwe-Sₙ usebenzisa izimpawu zamathemu.
n-m-h2-seq-09.material: Ithemu yokuqala a nomehluko ovamile d we-arithmetic sequence {aₙ} bayizinombolo eziphelele, futhi Sₙ=a₁+a₂+⋯+aₙ. UMina uthe, "Uma isamba siqhubeka nokukhula, njengo-S₁<S₂<⋯<S₆, bese i-sequence {aₙ} nayo iyaqhubeka nokukhula."
n-m-h2-seq-09.thinking.1: Ukubona ngesisho ukuthi ukukhula kwesamba kuyini
n-m-h2-seq-09.thinking.2: Ukuhumusha isimo sibe yizinganinginingi nokuthola isibonelo
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.prompt: Isitatimende esithi S₁<S₂<S₃<S₄<S₅<S₆ sitshelani ngempela ngo-{aₙ}?
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Veza umehluko we-Sₖ₊₁ ne-Sₖ usebenzisa i-aₖ₊₁.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yini okumele ibe lungile ukuze lowo mehluko ube lungile.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.o.a: a₁<a₂<⋯<a₆, okungukuthi, amathemu nawo ayaqhubeka nokukhula
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kuthatha ukukhula kwesamba nokukhula kwamathemu njengento efanayo. Ukuhlola ukuthi ukukhula okubili kufana yini, thola i-Sₖ₊₁−Sₖ.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.r.b: Isamba esilungile kuphela asikutsheli ukuthi isamba sehle yini ndawana thize maphakathi.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.r.c: Noma d ingalungile, isamba siyakhula inqobo nje uma amathemu elungile.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s1.explain: Sₖ₊₁ = Sₖ + aₖ₊₁, ngakho Sₖ<Sₖ₊₁ kufana no-aₖ₊₁>0. Ngakho S₁<S₂<⋯<S₆ kusho ukuthi a₂ kuya ku-a₆ zonke zilungile. Noma amathemu eba mancane (noma umehluko ovamile ungelona), isamba siyaqhubeka nokukhula inqobo nje uma elungile.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.prompt: Faka ama-arithmetic sequence amabili noma ngaphezulu ahlukene, njenge-(ithemu yokuqala a, umehluko ovamile d), akhombisa ukuthi isitatimende sikaMina asilungile. Kunezimo ezintathu. Amathemu ayehla (d<0), S₁<S₂<⋯<S₆ iyiqiniso, futhi kusukela endaweni thize isamba siyehla ngempela, ukuze S₁₂<S₁₁. (a no-d bayizinombolo eziphelele)
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi ukuze a₂ kuya ku-a₆ zonke zibe zilungile, kwanele yini ukuthi encane kakhulu, a₆=a+5d, ibe lungile.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha u-d oyedwa bese unquma uhla luka-a ngezinganinginingi ezimbili.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Umehluko ovamile awulungile, ngakho amathemu ayehla.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Amathemu kumele ehle, ngakho d kumele ibe ngelungile.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.ok.c3: a₂ kuya ku-a₆ zilungile, ngakho S₁<⋯<S₆.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.fail.c3: a₂, a₃, …, a₆ azilungile zonke. Hlola kuze kufike ku-a₆=a+5d.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.fail.c4: a₁₂ ayiyona engelona, ngakho S₁₂<S₁₁ ayiyona iqiniso.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.explain: Ku-(6, −1) amathemu angu-6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, −1, … futhi S₁ kuya ku-S₆ ziqhubeka nokukhula, kodwa a₁₂=−5<0, ngakho S₁₂<S₁₁. Ku-(3, −1), a₆=−2, ngakho S₆<S₅, futhi ku-(20, −1), a₁₂=9 ilungile, ngakho S₁₂ nayo inkulu kuno-S₁₁.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Ku-sequence oyitholile, chaza ukuthi kungani isamba siqala sikhule bese sehla, usebenzisa ubudlelwano phakathi kokushintsha kwesamba namathemu.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi i-S₇ iba nkulu noma incane kune-S₆ uma a₇ ilungile nalapho ingelona.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: isamba siyakhula noma siyehla ngoba ...
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uhlukanise ukuthi isamba siyakhula uma ithemu ilungile futhi siyehla uma ingelona?
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.because.model.0: Isamba sishintsha njalo ngokungeza ithemu entsha. Uma leyo themu ilungile, isamba siyakhula, futhi uma ingelona, isamba siyehla. Noma amathemu eba mancane, isamba siyaqhubeka nokukhula inqobo nje uma elungile, futhi uma ithemu isingelona, isamba siyehla.
n-m-h2-seq-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Njengoba Sₖ₊₁=Sₖ+aₖ₊₁, isamba siyakhula uma ithemu engeziwe aₖ₊₁ ilungile futhi siyancipha uma ingelona. Umehluko ovamile awulungile, ngakho ngesinye isikhathi ithemu iba ngelona futhi isamba siyehla.

n-m-h2-seq-07.title: Kungani ukukhipha u-3 kunika ukulandelana kwe-geometric?
n-m-h2-seq-07.goal: Qonda ukuthi kungani, ekuxazululeni i-recurrence, ukukhipha inani elingashintshi kuyiguqula ibe ukulandelana kwe-geometric, bese uchaza futhi kumngane wesikole esiphakeme ukuze isizathu sibonakale.
n-m-h2-seq-07.material:
Ilebhu ikhulisa amabhaktheriya. Ekuqaleni kunamabhaktheriya angu-5, futhi njalo ngehora inani liphindaphindeka kabili bese kukhishwa angu-3. Kunani aₙ ehoreni n (ngo-a₁=5 ehoreni lokuqala), aₙ₊₁ = 2aₙ − 3. Nawu umbhalo wesixazululo womfundi omkhulu.
Umbhalo: Kusuka ku-x = 2x − 3, x = 3. Ngakho aₙ₊₁ − 3 = 2(aₙ − 3). Vumela bₙ = aₙ − 3. Khona-ke b₁ = 2 futhi bₙ = 2ⁿ. Ngakho aₙ = 2ⁿ + 3.
n-m-h2-seq-07.thinking.0: Ukuthola ukuthi umugqa ngamunye wesixazululo wenzani
n-m-h2-seq-07.thinking.1: Ukubhala kabusha isixazululo esingenazizathu ukuze izizathu zibonakale
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.prompt: Isitatimende esithi "x = 2x − 3, ngakho x = 3" enothini sifuna ini?
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-3 esikhundleni sika-aₙ ku-recurrence bese ubala ukuthi i-aₙ₊₁ iba yini.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa lowo mphumela nalokho okutholayo uma ufaka elinye inani (isibonelo, 5).
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.a: a₁ inikezwe njengo-5. Bheka futhi lapho u-3 wavela khona.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.b: x=3 inombolo eyodwa nje, hhayi isisho esincike ku-n.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.o.c: Ukuthola inani elihlala linjalo ngisho nangemva kwehora elilodwa
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ngeqiniso lokuthi uma aₙ=3 bese aₙ₊₁=2·3−3=3, ngakho linani elingashintshi.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.r.d: I-common ratio ngu-2. Hlola ukuthi u-3 akayona i-common ratio.
n-m-h2-seq-07.s.s1.explain: Isixazululo x=3 ku-x=2x−3 yinombolo engashintshi uma ifakwa ku-recurrence, ngoba uma aₙ=3 bese aₙ₊₁=3. Ukukhipha leli nani kuyasusa ingxenye engashintshi, kusale "ukuphindwa kabili" kuphela, ngakho kuba yi-geometric sequence.
